title: Sr. Software Developer
description:
The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. You will experience these qualities of passion, pride and aspiration in many ways — from a rich set of career development programs to support of community service projects to social events that foster fun and relationship building across our global community.
  
  
**The Role**
The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. Founded more than 30 years ago by the best and brightest engineers at MIT, we continue to tackle the most complex challenges in process manufacturing. Our aspenONE software enables our customers to achieve operational excellence by increasing capacity, improving margins, and reducing costs, while becoming more energy efficient, ensuring safety, and shrinking their carbon footprint. This is a place where people are fiercely passionate about technology and have a desire to make a difference through the application of engineering and software technologies to solve real business problems. As a Software Developer with focus on software packaging and deployment, you will build and maintain software deployment solutions for our aspenONE software and push the deployment technology to make it easier for our customers to adopt our latest technologies. Based in our Pune, India office you will collaborate closely with other members of geographically dispersed Products teams, coordinating closely with colleagues focused on delighting customers via delivering robust products.
  
  
**Your Impact**
We are seeking an experienced Senior Installation Developer with 4–7 years of professional software development experience to design, develop, test, and maintain reliable software installation and deployment solutions across Windows, Linux, and containerized environments.
  
  
The ideal candidate will have strong programming and problem-solving skills, solid knowledge of installation and deployment technologies, and a strong understanding of software development practices. The candidate should be able to independently design and implement installation solutions, troubleshoot complex issues, and collaborate effectively with development, QA, DevOps, and other cross-functional teams in an Agile development environment.
  
  
The successful candidate should also be able to effectively leverage AI-assisted development tools to improve development efficiency, accelerate coding and troubleshooting, enhance testing and documentation, and improve software quality while applying appropriate engineering judgment to validate AI-generated solutions.
  
  

* Design, develop, test, and maintain software installation and deployment solutions for Windows, Linux, and containerized environments.
* Utilize Windows Installer, InstallShield, and related installation technologies to deliver reliable, scalable, and maintainable installation solutions.
* Develop and maintain installation tools, automation, and scripts using C#, C++, PowerShell, and Bash.
* Apply sound software design and development practices to ensure installation solutions are maintainable, extensible, testable, and reliable.
* Participate in the full software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, technical design, implementation, code review, testing, deployment, troubleshooting, and maintenance.
* Develop and maintain automated tests and validation processes to improve installation quality and prevent regressions.
* Leverage AI-assisted development tools to improve efficiency in coding, scripting, debugging, testing, code review, troubleshooting, refactoring, and technical documentation.
* Evaluate and validate AI-generated code and technical recommendations to ensure correctness, security, performance, maintainability, and compliance with established engineering standards.
* Collaborate with developers, QA, DevOps, architects, and other cross-functional teams to define installation and deployment requirements, designs, and strategies.
* Work with container technologies, such as Docker and Kubernetes, to support modern application and deployment environments.
* Integrate installation and deployment processes with version control systems such as Git and Perforce and automated CI/CD pipelines.
* Support installation and configuration requirements involving SQL and NoSQL database technologies.
* Participate in technical design reviews, code reviews, and knowledge-sharing activities within the development team.
* Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve complex installation and deployment issues through effective root-cause analysis and sustainable solutions.
* Follow Agile development practices and established software engineering standards to deliver high-quality solutions in a timely manner.
* Identify opportunities to leverage AI, automation, and modern development tools to simplify installation and deployment processes and improve engineering productivity.

What You'll Need
  
  

* 4–7 years of professional software development experience, with experience in software installation, deployment, build, or related technologies.
* Strong programming and coding skills, with the ability to independently design, develop, test, debug, and maintain installation and deployment solutions.
* Strong proficiency in C# and/or C++, with experience using PowerShell and Bash for scripting and automation.
* Strong knowledge of Windows and/or Linux operating systems, including software installation, configuration, upgrade, and deployment concepts.
* Solid experience with Windows Installer technology, InstallShield, or comparable software installation and packaging technologies.
* Solid understanding of software engineering principles, object-oriented design, software design patterns, and maintainable software development practices.
* Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance.
* Experience with software testing practices, including unit testing, integration testing, automated testing, debugging, and defect resolution.
* Experience leveraging AI-assisted software development tools to improve coding, debugging, testing, code review, troubleshooting, documentation, and overall development efficiency.
* Ability to critically evaluate and validate AI-generated code and recommendations, applying sound software engineering principles and appropriate human oversight.
* Hands-on experience with container technologies, such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, build automation, and modern software deployment practices.
* Experience with version control systems, such as Git and Perforce.
* Familiarity with SQL and NoSQL database technologies and their installation and configuration requirements.
* Experience working within an Agile software development environment.
* Strong analytical, debugging, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly communicate technical issues, designs, and solutions.
* Strong collaboration and teamwork skills, with the ability to work effectively with development teams and cross-functional stakeholders.

title: Security Software Engineer
description:
Software Engineer (Security)

**Location:**
Pune (Hybrid)

**Experience:**
5+ years (about 70% software development, 30% security)

About the role

This is a development-first security role. About 70% of the work is engineering: you will fix vulnerabilities in application code, upgrade vulnerable components, and build the tooling and automation that keep issues from coming back. The other 30% is security testing across our web apps and APIs. You own each fix end to end, from the finding to a merged, tested change.

What you will do

Development and remediation

* Fix vulnerabilities directly in application code, in whatever language or framework the application uses, and add tests that prove the fix.
* Fix root causes, not single instances: build shared validation, output encoding, parameterized queries, and authorization checks that remove whole classes of vulnerabilities.
* Upgrade vulnerable libraries, frameworks, and third-party components, resolve breaking changes, and keep builds and tests passing.
* Build internal security tooling and automation: scanner integrations, triage and reporting scripts, and checks that catch issues before release.
* Integrate SAST, DAST, and SCA tooling such as Aikido into CI/CD pipelines, and tune the rules to cut noise.
* Fix infrastructure and configuration issues: web server and TLS settings, cloud IAM and network rules, container and Kubernetes configuration, infrastructure-as-code, and CI/CD pipeline hardening.
* Where code or infrastructure is owned by another team, raise the change yourself as a pull request and drive it to merge.

Security testing

* Test web applications and APIs for exploitable vulnerabilities.
* Review code and design for flaws in authentication, authorization, session handling, data flows, and secrets management.
* Run and tune vulnerability scans across applications, hosts, or cloud accounts, and prioritize findings by exploitability and business impact alongside CVSS.
* Retest fixes and close findings only when the vulnerability is confirmed resolved.

Reporting and communication

* Write clear findings and fix notes with reproduction steps, evidence, risk rating, and the change made.
* Agree on realistic remediation timelines with engineers, and share secure coding patterns so the same issues stop recurring.

What you bring

Experience

* 5+ years total: approx. 3.5 years building and shipping production software as a developer, and approx. 1.5+ years of hands-on security work such as VAPT, application security, or secure code review.
* A track record of fixing security issues in code.

Development expertise

* Production-level depth in at least two of: Java, C#/.NET, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, PHP, Go, Swift, or Kotlin. Comfortable reading and changing code in languages you know less well.
* Able to land a correct, tested fix in an unfamiliar codebase without breaking existing behavior.
* Web and API development: REST and GraphQL services; authentication with OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, and JWT; session management; databases and ORMs.
* Unit and integration testing, Git-based workflows, pull requests, and code review.
* CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, and infrastructure-as-code such as Terraform or CloudFormation.
* Working knowledge of Nginx, Apache, IIS, and TLS configuration.
* Scripting in Python, Bash, or PowerShell to automate testing and remediation.

Communication

* Clear written findings and the ability to explain risk and trade-offs to engineers and business stakeholders.

Nice to have

* Web and API: manual testing with Burp Suite Professional; OWASP Top 10 and ASVS; injection, authentication and session flaws, access control (IDOR/BOLA), SSRF, and OAuth and JWT weaknesses.
* Secure code review: spotting vulnerable patterns in code and using SAST and SCA results to find and fix real issues.
* Built security tools, Burp extensions, or custom SAST rules (for example, Semgrep or CodeQL).
* Threat modeling and secure design review experience.
* Familiarity with compliance evidence requirements (ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI DSS) as they relate to vulnerability remediation.

What success looks like

* Vulnerabilities reach merged, tested fixes within agreed timelines.
* Recurring vulnerability classes decline because fixes address root causes.
* The tooling and automation you build catch issues before release and cut manual triage.
* Development teams see you as a fellow engineer who ships fixes alongside them.
* Cloud misconfiguration and patch exposure windows stay short.

title: HubSpot Specialist / Developer
description:
**Company Overview**
At Bridgenext, we engineer Growth Operating Systems. Most enterprises have spent millions on their revenue stack and still aren't seeing the growth they expected.They have tools that function, but no system that wins. We help growth-hungry companies close that gap by turning fragmented platforms, siloed teams, and disconnected data into one integrated Growth OS. More than a technology company or marketing agency, we're a global digital consultancy with experts in engineering, data, AI, creative and more.
  
  
Our teams are made up of experts who believe in engineering impact, starting with putting people at the center of everything we do. Every team member directly shapes our work, culture, and values. Nothing matters more to us than a kind, respectful, fulfilling environment that supports everyone. Our flexible, inclusive culture gives you the autonomy, resources, and opportunities to thrive.
  
  
**Position Description**
We are hiring a HubSpot Specialist / Developer role to act as a hands-on developer executing a substantial, already-documented backlog of HubSpot architecture, integration, lifecycle automation, and security remediation work. The candidate will work from existing Jira epics and tickets covering custom object data modeling, CRM/data pipeline integrations, and marketing automation for multiple product lines.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
The candidate will be responsible for developing, testing, and shipping work items across the following areas:
  
  

* Core HubSpot Architecture & Data Modeling

+ Architect, migrate, and deploy new HubSpot custom object data models to support team structures, multi-product subscription hierarchies, and lifecycle tracking.
+ Implement multi-product subscription modeling across B2B use cases.
+ Validate product/team hierarchy alignment and member associations.
+ Test custom object association traversal and workflow personalization logic.
+ Configure Databricks source table mapping and Hightouch synchronization models.

* CRM & Pipeline Integrations (Salesforce, Hightouch, Databricks, AppFlow)

+ Build and maintain Salesforce ↔ HubSpot sync configurations including resolving object sync threshold limits.
+ Investigate, triage, and resolve large-scale sync errors between Salesforce and HubSpot.
+ Configure HubSpot integration user permissions in Salesforce.
+ Fix revenue attribution and automated interaction-owner assignment logic.
+ Resolve lead deduplication and contact-eligibility logic across AppFlow, HubSpot, and Salesforce.
+ Diagnose and fix automated lead delivery/assignment failures.
+ Design robust handling for dropdown/enum properties to prevent pipeline sync failures.
+ Resolve Hightouch/Databricks sync failures caused by schema or column changes.
+ Ingest and map new data fields from Databricks into HubSpot
+ Manage ingress/egress and deprecation of third-party data attributes in HubSpot.
+ Scope and configure HubSpot object egress into Databricks for cross-functional reporting.

* Program-Specific Lifecycle & Marketing Automation

+ Scope risk and schema impact of funnel migrations affecting downstream data models.
+ Resolve missing/blocked CRM records that break workflow personalization.
+ Build data attributes to support self-service onboarding flows
+ Engineer persistent data frameworks to support multi-step nurture/pitch journeys in HubSpot.
+ Investigate and fix association bugs causing duplicate or incorrect notification delivery.
+ Configure property ingestion to support renewal and lifecycle email workflows.
+ Integrate product usage/deep-link data into HubSpot and resolve related association gaps.
+ Support market-expansion and segmentation work: enterprise segmentation, subscription product data matching, contact creation syncs, and workflow branching/property updates for new market launches.

* Security, Tooling & Incident Remediation

+ Audit permissions for third-party/AI connectors (e.g., AI assistants) integrated with HubSpot; identify high-risk write scopes and provide security recommendations.
+ Author root-cause analyses (RCAs) and recovery plans for production incidents affecting HubSpot-dependent lead/data flows; establish preventive protocols.
+ Evaluate and support integrations connecting HubSpot with messaging infrastructure for marketing use cases.

**Must Have Skills**

* Experience supporting B2B SaaS or subscription/membership-based products.
* Proven hands-on development experience with HubSpot (CRM, custom objects, workflows, properties, associations)
* Experience building and troubleshooting integrations between HubSpot and Salesforce.
* Working knowledge of data pipeline tools such Databricks (or comparable reverse-ETL/warehouse tools) is plus.
* Experience with AppFlow or similar data-ingestion/integration tooling.
* Strong SQL skills for schema design, data mapping, and troubleshooting.
* Experience diagnosing and resolving large-scale data sync errors across CRM systems.
* Familiarity with marketing automation concepts: lifecycle stages, lead scoring, workflow personalization, segmentation.
* Experience with incident response practices: writing RCAs, remediation plans, and preventive runbooks.
* Understanding of API/connector security — evaluating third-party and AI integration permission scopes.
* Ability to work independently from Jira-documented epics/tickets and translate written requirements into shipped, tested solutions.

title: Lead I - Talend Developer
description:
**Role Description**
At UST, we help the world’s best organizations grow and succeed through transformation. Bringing together the right talent, tools, and ideas, we work with our client to co-create lasting change. Together, with over 30,000 employees in 30+ countries, we build for boundless impact—touching billions of lives in the process. Visit us at www.ust.com
  
  
UST is looking for Talend Developer
  
  
Job Description: Talend Developer
  
  
**Job Title:**
Talend Developer
  
  
**Experience:**
7+ Years
  
  
**Location:**
Chennai / Pune
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are looking for an experienced
**Talend Developer**
to support the assessment, migration, validation, and phased decommissioning of existing Talend workloads as they transition to Databricks.
  
  
The ideal candidate will bring strong hands-on expertise in Talend Data Integration, Java-based Talend customizations, and legacy ETL workflows. The role requires close collaboration with architects and Databricks engineers to ensure existing business logic, dependencies, reconciliation rules, and runtime behavior are accurately understood and reproduced during migration.
  
  
What You Will Do
  
  

* Work closely with the architect to review the existing Talend inventory and identify:

+ Job dependencies and hidden coupling
+ Shared routines
+ JARs and plugins
+ Joblets
+ Context groups
+ Custom components

* Classify Talend jobs into simple, complex/custom, and difficult categories.
* Identify and document:

+ Platform-specific protections and configurations
+ Custom Java implementations
+ Third-party components
+ Mainframe integrations
+ Kafka touchpoints

* Review CodeCrafter-generated extracted logic across samples from each complexity category.
* Validate, correct, or annotate inferred business rules before conversion activities begin.
* Explain legacy Talend behavior to Databricks engineers, including:

+ Ambiguous expressions
+ Null and reject handling
+ Type coercion
+ Scheduling behavior
+ Job execution logic

* Support Gate 1 source baselines by documenting:

+ How existing jobs are parameterized and executed
+ What existing run history indicates
+ Where current reconciliation logic resides

* Participate in mismatch and reconciliation triage to determine whether variances are caused by:

+ Existing Talend behavior or quirks
+ Source or data issues
+ Conversion defects

* Document findings and resolutions to support migration acceptance.
* Advise on decommissioning sequencing to ensure Talend jobs are retired only after their Databricks equivalents have been successfully accepted.

Must-Have Skills
  
  

* 7+ years of hands-on experience with Talend Data Integration, including:

+ Talend Studio
+ TAC / TMC
+ tMap
+ tJava / tJavaRow
+ Routines
+ Context groups
+ Joblets

description:
**Introduction**
At IBM Software, we transform client challenges into solutions. Building the worldâ€™s leading AI-powered, cloud-native products that shape the future of business and society. **Your Role And Responsibilities**
About the Role
  
  
Backend engineers at Confluent, work on a set of diverse and complex challenges, such as building foundational cloud frameworks and services that power all components of the platform in the Cloud. We are building a multi-tenant, multi-cloud, cloud-native compute substrate to enable seamless data integration across Confluent Cloud.
  
  
As a Senior Software Engineer, you think strategically and you help drive end-to-end technical delivery from the customer experience to scaling internal operations. You leverage your growing expertise in cloud-native, distributed systems to help take our execution platform to the next level. You care deeply about the key operational aspects (availability, reliability, performance, monitoring, capacity planning, and disaster recovery) of our Connect Platform, helping ensure we provide a highly available, resilient, and secure environment that our largest customers can rely on to run their mission-critical data pipelines.
  
  
What You Will Do
  
  

* Build mission-critical infrastructure: Develop, test, and operationalize high-performance, scalable, and resilient backend services.
* Build and evolve Kafka connectors: Design, develop, and maintain Kafka Connect connectors for integrating with external data systems.
* Scale and optimize connector performance: Solve complex challenges in the stream processing space using cloud and on-premises resources to improve the performance, scalability, and elasticity of Kafka Connectors.
* Troubleshoot & debug: Dive into a complex technical stack that includes microservices, Kubernetes, containers, and virtualization to resolve issues and optimize performance.
* Support operational excellence: Participate in on-call rotations, ensure the operational readiness of our services, and help the team meet availability and performance SLA commitments.
* Innovate & improve: Act as a proactive engineer who identifies and suggests architectural, process, and operational improvements.

**Preferred Education**
Master's Degree

* 4+ years of industry experience designing, building, and supporting backend systems in production.

* Strong programming and algorithmic skills, with proficiency in major programming languages such as Java, Go, C/C++, or Python.
* Cloud-native experience, including hands-on experience or strong familiarity with configuring and deploying distributed systems and microservices using modern tools (e.g., Kubernetes, Helm, Docker).
* Operational awareness, with experience participating in on-call rotations and a strong desire to build reliable, production-grade cloud services.
* Self-starter mentality, with the ability to work effectively in a team and excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Collaborative mindset, featuring a strong sense of customer centricity, teamwork, and a drive to learn and grow alongside your peers.
* Educational background: BS or MS in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent work experience.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* Experience contributing to large-scale, highly available, low-latency, and high-throughput data systems.
* Knowledge of control planes, data planes, and multi-tenant resource management in public clouds (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
* Prior experience working with or extending the internal architecture of Apache Kafka® or Kafka Connect.

ice to have: Kubernetes operator patterns, ArgoCD or similar GitOps tooling, Temporal or Step Functions for workflow orchestration, or experience onboarding enterprise customers with SSO and SCIM.

 Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product management, QA, and operations, to define requirements, design solutions, and deliver high-quality software:
  
  
 Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior and mid-level software engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence and continuous learning: Leverage AI platforms for personalized learning paths, automated code feedback, and explanations of complex technical concepts. Encourage junior engineers to adopt AI-driven development practices.
  
  
 Actively research and experiment with AI technologies to identify opportunities for enhancing developer productivity, automating tasks, and improving software quality: Continuously explore emerging AI tools and techniques (such as Anti Gravity for complex problem-solving) and assess their applicability to our development ecosystem
  
  
 Participate in code reviews, ensuring adherence to coding standards, best practices, and architectural guidelines: Utilize AI-powered code analysis tools to pre-scan code for potential bugs, security vulnerabilities, performance bottlenecks, and style deviations, allowing human reviewers to focus on higher-level logic and design.
  
  
 Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues, ensuring the stability and performance of production systems: Implement AI-driven anomaly detection in monitoring systems, leverage AI for rapid log analysis and root cause identification, and automate incident response workflows.
  
  
 Contribute to the strategic planning and technical roadmap for our middleware platforms: Employ AI to analyze industry trends, forecast technology evolution, assess the impact of new features, and prioritize roadmap initiatives based on data-driven insights.
  
  
 Conduct tasks related to feasibility studies, time and cost estimates, IT planning, risk technology, applications development, and model development: Utilize AI for data synthesis, predictive modeling for estimations, identification of potential IT risks, and accelerated model prototyping and validation
  
  
 Monitor and control all phases of the development process (analysis, design, construction, testing, and implementation) and provide user and operational support: Implement AI-driven dashboards and reporting for real-time project health, automated progress tracking, and proactive identification of development lifecycle bottlenecks.
  
  
 Utilize in-depth specialty knowledge of applications development to analyze complex problems/issues, provide evaluation of business process, system process, and industry standards, and make evaluative judgment: Augment human analytical capabilities with AI-powered data analysis and pattern recognition to rapidly assess complex scenarios and inform robust decision-making.
  
  
 Recommend and develop security measures in post-implementation analysis of business usage to ensure successful system design and functionality: Use AI-driven security analysis tools to continuously monitor applications for vulnerabilities, predict potential threats, and recommend adaptive security control.
  
  
**Required Technical Skill:**
 Core Java: Strong understanding of Java (JDK 8+, preferably Java 11/17), including multithreading, collections, garbage collection, and JVM internals.  Frameworks: Extensive experience with Spring Framework (Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data JPA, Spring Security).  Middleware: Proven experience in designing and developing RESTful APIs and microservices.
  
  
 Database Technologies (Must): o Relational Databases: Strong proficiency in SQL and experience with Oracle databases, including schema design, query optimization, and stored procedures. o NoSQL Databases: Experience with MongoDB, including data modeling, querying, and performance tuning.
  
  
 CI/CD & DevOps: Hands-on experience with CI/CD tools and practices (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Maven/Gradle, Docker, Kubernetes).
  
  
 Version Control: Proficiency with Git and standard branching strategies (e.g., Gitflow).
  
  
 Testing: Experience with unit testing frameworks (JUnit, Mockito) and integration testing.
  
  
** AI Tools & Methodologies (Must have exposure):**

* Demonstrable exposure and practical experience with AI development tools such as Devin, GitHub Copilot, Claude, Anti Gravity, and Codex.
* Strong understanding of AI/ML concepts, prompt engineering, and integrating AI into software development workflows (e.g., for code generation, testing, debugging, and documentation).
* A keen desire to apply AI technologies to improve software development processes and outcomes.

**Qualifications**
 7-12 years of relevant experience in applications development, with a strong emphasis on modern software engineering practices and AI integration.
  
  
 Experience in systems analysis and programming of software applications, demonstrating success in leveraging AI for efficiency and quality.
  
  
 Experience in managing and implementing successful projects, including those utilizing AI driven development approaches.
  
  
 Working knowledge of consulting/project management techniques/methods, adaptable to AI-accelerated project lifecycles.
  
  
 AI certification is plus
  
  
 Ability to work under pressure and manage deadlines or unexpected changes in expectations or requirements, utilizing AI tools for enhanced adaptability and problem solving.
  
  
Education:
  
  

 Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience.

title: Lead Software Engineer - C/C++, Unix/Linux, ARQC, ARPC, HSM
description:

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Lead Software Engineer - C/C++, Unix/Linux, ARQC, ARPC, HSM
  
  
Who is Mastercard?
  
  
We work to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere, by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships, and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential. Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. We cultivate a culture of inclusion for all employees that respects their individual strengths, views, and experiences. We believe that our differences enable us to be a better team – one that makes better decisions, drives innovation, and delivers better business results.
  
  
**Technology At Mastercard**
What we create today will define tomorrow. Revolutionary technologies that reshape the digital economy to be more connected and inclusive than ever before. Safer, faster, more sustainable.
  
  
And we need the best people to do it. Technologists who are energized by the challenges of a truly global network. With the talent and vision to create the critical systems and products that power global commerce and connect people everywhere to the vital goods and services they need every day.
  
  
Working at Mastercard means being part of a unique culture. Inclusive and diverse, a rich collaboration of ideas and perspectives. A place that celebrates your strengths, values your experiences, and offers you the flexibility to shape a career across disciplines and continents. And the opportunity to work alongside experts and leaders at every level of the business, improving what exists, and inventing what’s next.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a Lead Software Engineer with strong expertise in C/C++ and Unix/Linux systems to design, develop, and lead high-performance, scalable, and secure enterprise applications. The role requires hands-on technical leadership, architecture ownership, and cross-team collaboration to deliver mission-critical systems.
  
  
Lead engineers are expected to own complex problems, drive architectural decisions, and mentor engineering teams, while ensuring high-quality software delivery.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Technical Leadership & Architecture
  
  

* Design and develop high-performance, low-latency systems using C/C++ on Unix/Linux platforms
* Own end-to-end architecture for components and services, ensuring scalability and resiliency
* Introduce and adopt modern design patterns, frameworks, and best practices
* Provide technical direction and guidance to engineering teams.

Development & Delivery
  
  

* Lead design, development, testing, and deployment activities
* Write efficient, maintainable, and secure C/C++ code adhering to coding standards.
* Drive automation of builds, testing, and deployment pipelines
* Troubleshoot complex production issues and ensure system stability

System Design & Performance
  
  

* Architect systems for high throughput, fault tolerance, and performance optimization
* Perform performance tuning, memory optimization, and multithreading enhancements
* Ensure system reliability and availability (high uptime expectations)

Collaboration & Stakeholder Management
  
  

* Work closely with product, QA, and operations teams to prioritize and deliver solutions
* Drive design discussions, trade-offs, and cross-functional decisions
* Coordinate across geographically distributed teams

Mentorship & Engineering Excellence
  
  

* Mentor developers and promote best practices (code reviews, TDD, secure coding).
* Conduct technical interviews and help build high-performing teams
* Lead post-incident reviews and drive continuous improvement initiatives

**Required Technical Skills**

* Strong experience of Cryptography in Payment cycle.
* Strong experience of Session Key Derivation and validation.
* Strong experience of Triple DES and Advanced Encryption Standard techniques.
* Strong understanding of Thales or equivalent Payment Validation HSM modules and its commands.
* Strong programming expertise in C and C++.
* Deep understanding of Unix/Linux systems, shell scripting, and system internals
* Strong understanding multi threading in C and Linux
* Experience with Multithreading and concurrency, Memory management and performance tuning, Socket programming / IPC mechanisms
* Knowledge of data structures, algorithms, and design patterns
* Familiarity with build tools (Make/CMake), debugging tools (gdb), gtest, and profiling tools.
* Strong experience of Github and Github Copilot.
* Strong experience of using Copilot with MCP servers.

**All About You**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience)
* Experience with Agile methodologies, strong understanding of DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines
* Experience writing unit, integration, and system tests
* Experience designing distributed systems or high-scale enterprise applications
* Exposure to security standards (OWASP, secure coding practices).
* Experience in payment systems / transaction processing / financial domain
* Exposure to cloud-native or hybrid systems
* Knowledge of additional languages (Java/Python) is a plus
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
* Ability to drive decisions and manage technical trade-offs
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management

Ownership mindset and ability to lead under ambiguity
  
  
**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Senior software engineer
description:
Job Title: Senior Software Engineer
  
  
Location: Pune, India
  
  
**About The Role**
ComScore is a leading cross platform audience measurement company. We measure what matters to make audiences and advertising more valuable. We collect and process billions of events each day, have 10s of petabytes online and each month our processes read nearly an exabyte. We use this capability to provide our clients with unlocked insights into their data.
  
  
We are looking for a Software Engineer to join our Product Data Engineering organization. This job involves designing and maintaining big data web & engineering solutions capable of running efficiently and robustly at petabyte scale.
  
  
As a Senior Software Engineer, you will own features and components end to end, contribute to technical design conversations, and begin to support the growth of engineers around you. You will work within a team but take responsibility for quality across the full lifecycle of your work.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Own the design and implementation of well-scoped features and system components, end to end
* Write production-quality code with minimal guidance, including tests, documentation, and observability
* Participate actively in code reviews, providing useful and constructive feedback to peers
* Use AI coding assistants fluently as part of your everyday development workflow — using them to draft, refactor, generate test cases, and explore approaches — while taking clear ownership of the code you ship
* Debug and resolve issues in production systems, including those you did not write
* Define data models which tie together large datasets from multiple data sources.
* Design, Implement and maintain Data pipelines and data driven solutions.
* Build data platform at scale using AWS and Snowflake to solve complex business use cases.
* Collaborate with DevOps, Release Management, Research and Operations teams
* Coordinate with external stakeholders to deliver on product requirements

**What We Are Looking For**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related field
* 4 to 7 years of professional software engineering experience
* 3+ years developing software using Python, Java or Scala in Linux environment
* 3+ years Big Data Technologies – Cloud and/or On-Prem. AWS EMR or similar, Spark, Hadoop.
* Familiarity with Linux, shell scripting
* Strong SQL skills
* Ability to understand & improve enterprise software apps while factoring in overall design goals
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capability
* Fluency with AI development tools — able to use them efficiently across the development lifecycle, with sound judgment about when to rely on them and when to verify carefully

**Nice To Have**

* Hands-On experience with Snowflake or similar
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)
* Experience in Scala
* Strong background in DevOps related practices (CI/CD, containerization, orchestration, infrastructure automation, etc.)
* Experience with agile development methodologies

**Benefits**

* Medical: Comscore offers a collective Private Medical Insurance scheme which is 100% covered by Comscore.
* The benefit is applicable to employees, an employee’s spouse, up to two children and parents.
* Pension: Provident Fund: Comscore bears both the employee and employer contribution.
* Time Off Annual Leave: Comscore offers market competitive annual leave of 26 Annual Leave
* Days (8 Casual and 18 Privilege), following local guidelines and practices.
* National Holidays and Festival Holidays: 10 Days.
* Sick Leave: 10 Days.
* Additional Leave: Paternity, Bereavement, Marriage, Maternity, Additional Pregnancy / Birth Related Leave
* Christmas / New Year Paid Leave, Comscore offers a week of Company paid leave over the Christmas / New Year period.
* Summer Hours: Comscore has a culture that rewards employees for their hard work. When you work hard, you need time to recharge and refresh. Early releases on Fridays are subject to manager approval.
* Internal Career Development Opportunities (minimum of 6 months tenure in the current position and in discussion with supervisors)
* Access to hundreds of professional e-learning courses, specifically created for Comscore
* Be creative: You don’t have to follow the norm to be successful – we encourage you to think outside the box. Our culture is built on encouraging innovative ideas, communication and joint success.
* Informal Work Atmosphere: We believe in getting the job done in a comfortable, casual environment!
* The ability to become a truly global engineer, with exposure to markets across the world. With more than 30 offices around the world, many Comscore teams work together across locations.

**About Comscore**
At Comscore, we’re pioneering the future of cross-platform media measurement, arming organizations with the insights they need to make decisions with confidence. Central to this aim are our people who work together to simplify the complex on behalf of our clients & partners. Though our roles and skills are varied, we’re united by our commitment to five underlying values: Integrity, Velocity, Accountability, Teamwork, and Servant Leadership. If you’re motivated by big challenges and interested in helping some of the largest and most important media properties and brands navigate the future of media, we’d love to hear from you.
  
  
Comscore (NASDAQ: SCOR) is a trusted partner for planning, transacting and evaluating media across platforms. With a data footprint that combines digital, linear TV, over-the-top and theatrical viewership intelligence with advanced audience insights, Comscore allows media buyers and sellers to quantify their multiscreen behavior and make business decisions with confidence. A proven leader in measuring digital and set-top box audiences and advertising at scale, Comscore is the industry’s emerging, third-party source for reliable and comprehensive cross-platform measurement. To learn more about Comscore, please visit Comscore.com.
  
  
Comscore is committed to creating an inclusive culture, encouraging diversity.

title: Senior Software Engineer Product Security
description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.
  
  
We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!
  
  
**Job Description**
**Job Summary:**
As a Software Engineer – Product Security, you will join a team that helps ensure Rockwell Automation products are designed, developed, and maintained using industry-leading secure development practices.
  
  
You will work closely with software development teams, architects, product security engineers, and DevSecOps teams to implement security capabilities, address vulnerabilities, automate security workflows, and improve the overall security posture of our products.
  
  
You will provide opportunities to contribute across the software development lifecycle, from design and implementation through testing, deployment, and maintenance.
  
  
You are a collaborative engineer who enjoys solving technical problems, learning new technologies, and working with globally distributed teams.
  
  
In addition to software engineering fundamentals, you have an interest in cybersecurity, secure software development, cloud technologies, and new AI-assisted development practices.
  
  
You will report to the SENIOR MANAGER, SOFTWARE ENGINEERING and have a hybrid schedule working in
**Bangalore or Pune, India.**
**Your Responsibilities**

* Develop software components, services, and tools supporting product security programmes.
* Apply secure coding practices and security-by-design principles throughout the software development lifecycle.
* Participate in feature design, implementation, testing, and deployment activities.
* Support threat modelling, security reviews, vulnerability remediation, and risk mitigation efforts.
* Develop automation solutions that improve security, compliance, and engineering productivity.
* Contribute to cloud-native, web, desktop, or distributed application development.
* Collaborate with software engineering teams to integrate security requirements into product designs and implementations.
* Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve software defects, performance issues, and security findings.
* Participate in code reviews, design reviews, and technical discussions.
* Create technical documentation, test plans, and engineering artefacts.
* Support DevSecOps projects by integrating security tooling into CI/CD pipelines.
* Use Generative AI tools responsibly to improve software development efficiency, code quality, testing, documentation, and engineering workflows.
* Learn and stay current with latest technologies, cybersecurity threats, software engineering practices, and AIdriven development methodologies.
* Collaborate with global teams.

**The Essentials - You Will Have**

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Cybersecurity, Electronic & Communication Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
* Product Security & DevSecOps Knowledge of secure software development lifecycle (SSDLC) practices.
* Understanding of common software vulnerabilities and mitigations (OWASP Top 10, CWE, secure coding practices).
* Familiarity with threat modelling concepts and security risk assessments
* Experience developing software using one or more modern programming languages such as C#, C++, Java, Python, Go, or TypeScript.
* Experience working in Agile development environments.

**The Preferred - You Might Also Have**

* 5+ years of software development experience.
* Experience developing software for cloud, web, desktop, or distributed systems.
* Experience with object-oriented design principles, data structures, algorithms, and design patterns.
* Experience with TypeScript, Node.js, Angular, React, GraphQL, or similar technologies.
* Experience developing software on Windows and Linux platforms.
* Familiarity with REST APIs, microservices, containers, and cloud-native architectures.
* Experience with Git, GitHub, Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing.
* Knowledge of authentication, authorization, encryption, and security protocols.
* Exposure to DevSecOps practices and security scanning tools such as SAST, SCA, DAST, SBOM, or container security solutions.
* Understanding of security frameworks and standards such as IEC 62443, NIST SSDF, CRA, NIS2, or similar industry standards.
* Generative AI & Modern Engineering Practices
* Experience using Generative AI tools such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, or similar platforms to improve engineering productivity.
* Understanding of AI-assisted software development, prompt engineering, code generation, automated testing, and documentation workflows.
* Exposure to AI/ML concepts, LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agentic workflows, or AI-enabled developer tooling.
* Evaluate AI-generated outputs for quality, security, maintainability, and compliance with secure development standards.
* Experience working with geographically distributed teams.
* Stay informed about relevant technology trends and developments new technologies and improve technical skill

**What We Offer**
Our benefits package includes …
  
  

* Comprehensive mindfulness programs with a premium membership to Calm
* Volunteer Paid Time off available after 6 months of employment for eligible employees
* Company volunteer and donation matching program – Your volunteer hours or personal cash donations to an eligible charity can be matched with a charitable donation.
* Employee Assistance Program
* Personalized wellbeing programs through our OnTrack program
* On-demand digital course library for professional development
* and other local benefits!

*At Rockwell Automation we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this or other roles.*
Rockwell Automation’s hybrid policy aligns that employees are expected to work at a Rockwell location at least Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays unless they have a business obligation out of the office.

Candidates should have knowledge and experience in web development technologies like Angular, Typescript, Ionic and ReactJS. Development experience of Hybrid Web Applications Compatible with Desktop, iOS, and Android mobile Platforms will be added advantage.

Tarana’s ngFWA technology has been embraced by more than 300 service providers in 24 countries. title: Lead Software Engineer -(4 wall Tech)
description:
**Job Description**
**Lead Software Engineer**
**Job Location – Pune (Hybrid)**
**About the Team**
The Logistics Technology team at Williams-Sonoma, Inc. builds and supports the platforms that move product across our supply chain — from distribution center operations and warehouse management to material handling automation, labeling, and sortation for brands including Williams Sonoma, Pottery Barn, West Elm, and Rejuvenation. We partner closely with Supply Chain, Distribution Center operations, and third-party automation vendors to keep fulfillment fast, accurate, and cost-effective. It is a hands-on, high-ownership team where engineers work end to end — designing systems, integrating with WMS, PLCs, and material handling equipment, and applying automation and AI to improve how our distribution network runs every day.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Lead Software Engineer will lead the design, development, and delivery of a Windows-based sortation and labeling platform that integrates with PKMS/WMS systems, PLCs, and material handling equipment (MHE) across our distribution network. The system processes TCP socket messages for carton lifecycle events, persists data to enterprise databases, and coordinates downstream services, subject-matter depth in warehouse automation and MHE, and close collaboration with cross-functional business, DC operations, WCS and WES system integrations, and coordination with third-party vendor teams such as Savoye, Opex, Honeywell Intelligrated, Boxer, and bagger/print-and-apply solution providers.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Provide technical leadership for the sortation and labeling domain — designing, developing, and leading delivery of high-throughput, low-latency Windows services and desktop applications.
* Design and maintain TCP socket server/client components for high-volume carton lifecycle messaging with PKMS/WMS and MHE controllers.
* Implement multithreading and asynchronous programming patterns for performance, responsiveness, and predictable throughput under peak volumes.
* Build and maintain desktop UI using WPF and coordinate with Windows Service hosts for end-to-end operational workflows.
* Lead integrations with PLCs, serial devices, scanners, print-and-apply, and material handling equipment, ensuring robust error handling, retry logic, and consistent state across data stores.
* Own ZPL label workflows and print pipelines, including label design, throughput tuning, and printer/applicator fault recovery.
* Define and enforce engineering standards for secure coding, unit testing, Git branching strategy, and code quality.
* Lead deployments, IIS configuration, and CI/CD automation, including automated testing and release readiness.
* Own application health in production — monitoring, alerting, incident triage, and root-cause resolution during peak fulfillment periods.
* Partner with Distribution Center operations, Supply Chain, and third-party MHE vendors to translate operational requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Identify and deliver AI and automation opportunities that improve DC operations, production support, and business-user productivity.
* Drive Agile delivery — sprint planning, estimation, and delivery tracking — adhere to IT change management, and mentor engineers to raise the bar across the team.

**Criteria**
**Experience**

* 10–15 years of software engineering experience, including at least 3 years in a technical lead or staff-level role.
* Proven track record delivering enterprise-scale .NET applications in a retail, supply chain, or logistics environment.
* Demonstrated experience as an individual contributor with strong ownership, self-direction, and vendor coordination.
* Experience delivering in Agile environments using Jira for sprint planning, estimation, and delivery tracking.

**Functional Expertise**

* Strong knowledge of warehouse management, sortation, labeling, and Distribution Center operations.
* Hands-on experience integrating with PKMS, Manhattan WMOS, or comparable WMS platforms.
* Experience leading third-party vendor integrations, integration platforms, and enterprise web services.
* Strong business acumen with the ability to align technology solutions to throughput, accuracy, and cost goals.

**Material Handling Equipment (MHE) Subject-Matter Expertise**

* Subject-matter expertise in material handling equipment and warehouse automation, with hands-on integration experience across one or more OEM solution sets: such as Savoye, Opex, Honeywell Intelligrated, Boxer, and bagger / print-and-apply systems.
* Deep understanding of MHE process flows — induction, singulation, scanning, sortation, diverts, put walls, unit sortation, carton and bag creation, weigh-in-motion, and label print-and-apply.
* Experience defining and supporting MHE interface specifications and message contracts between WMS/WCS/WES and equipment controllers, including carton lifecycle events, divert confirmations, no-reads, exceptions, and recirculation handling.
* Hands-on integration with PLCs, barcode scanners, scales, dimensioners, printers, and applicators over TCP/IP, serial, and OPC-style interfaces.
* Ability to troubleshoot live MHE issues on the floor — jams, mis-sorts, label misapplication, throughput degradation, and equipment/host message desynchronization — and drive root-cause resolution with vendors.
* Experience participating in MHE implementations: interface testing, dry runs, integration and acceptance testing, commissioning, go-live support, and post-go-live hypercare.
* Familiarity with MHE performance metrics — units per hour, sort accuracy, divert rates, read rates, and equipment uptime — and using them to tune application behavior.
* Ability to act as the technical point of contact and SME for MHE vendors, translating operational requirements into interface and application changes.

**Technical Expertise**

* Extensive hands-on experience with multithreading, async/await, and TCP/IP sockets.
* Experience with message parsing, custom protocols, and high-volume event processing.
* Strong relational database skills and SQL data access patterns across SQL Server, Oracle, and DB2.
* Knowledge of ZPL label workflows, logging, diagnostics, and performance tuning.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing.
* Working knowledge of secure coding standards, GitHub repository and branching strategies, and code quality tools such as Sonar.
* Proficiency with monitoring and observability tools such as AppDynamics, Splunk, ELK, and Grafana, including alert and notification setup.
* Familiarity with publisher/subscriber message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ) and an understanding of message acknowledgment and idempotent operations.

**AI Skills**

* Strong AI-first mindset.
* Experience using AI tools, AI agents, and automation platforms to improve operations, production support, data validation, reporting, testing, and documentation.
* Ability to design AI-agent led solutions for use cases such as issue triage, exception monitoring, MHE fault pattern detection, report generation, knowledge retrieval, regression testing support, and operational analytics.
* Understanding of responsible AI practices, including data privacy, security, auditability, compliance, and validation of AI-generated outputs.

**Leadership**

* Demonstrated situational leadership — guiding teams, driving execution, and delivering measurable business value.
* Self-driven with strong ownership; comfortable operating as a hands-on individual contributor.
* Ability to facilitate productive discussions across DC operations, business, and vendor stakeholder groups and drive alignment.
* Experience mentoring engineers and raising engineering standards across a team.

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.

**Work Location**

* This role is based in Pune, India and follows a hybrid working model.

**Environment**

* Socket-based services and Windows Service hosts.
* Integration with sortation devices, PLCs, MHE controllers, and WMS/PKMS via TCP.
* ZPL label print pipelines and event-forwarding mechanisms.

**About Us - ( https://www.williams-sonoma.com/ )**
Founded in 1956, Williams-Sonoma Inc. is the premier specialty retailer of high-quality products for the kitchen and home in the United States. Today, Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is one of the United States' largest e-commerce retailers with some of the best known and most beloved brands in home furnishings. Our family of brands are Williams-Sonoma, Pottery Barn, Pottery Barn Kids, Pottery Barn Teens, West Elm, Williams-Sonoma Home, Rejuvenation, GreenRow and Mark and Graham. We currently operate retail stores globally. Our products are also available to customers through our catalogs and online worldwide.
  
  
Williams-Sonoma has established a technology center in Pune, India to enhance its global operations. The India Technology Center serves as a critical hub for innovation and focuses on developing cutting-edge solutions in areas such as e-commerce, supply chain optimization, and customer experience management. By integrating advanced technologies like artificial intelligence, data analytics, and machine learning, the India Technology Center plays a crucial role in accelerating Williams-Sonoma's growth and maintaining its competitive edge in the global market.

**Description & Requirements**
**About Platform Services**
Platform Services as a group provides common infrastructure, managed services, and product development and release services to support Bloomberg's application development. The group has about a thousand team members spread across all of Bloomberg's global offices focused on Application and Middleware Frameworks, Database Solutions, Connectivity, Security, Cloud Native Compute and Storage Services. Our mission is to provide Bloomberg developers with a standard, scalable, managed and compliant platform experience.
  
  
**About The Teams**
*DataLayer Platform*
DataLayer is the high-performance library used to build reactive transformations of data in the Bloomberg Terminal. From simple sorting and filtering, to complex multi-level aggregations and the Excel-like expression evaluation engine, Datalayer is the engine that powers almost every grid or table of data in the Bloomberg Terminal.
  
  
The newly created DataLayer Platform team in Pune will take ownership of embedding the DataLayer into Bloomberg runtimes, providing seamless integration with the Bloomberg Terminal and backend services. This will require the team to work closely with other DataLayer teams as well as multiple infrastructure teams to ensure that DataLayer works as efficiently and performant as possible in those runtimes.
  
  
**We’ll Trust You To**

* Have an eye for detail and an interest in working on the complex challenges of large-scale distributed systems.
* Bring a strong understanding of working with highly multi-threaded and asynchronous programming environments
* Understand how to make changes to a live production system safely and responsibly, without causing any impact to our users
* Communicate clearly and effectively and share our values toward software development and professional collaboration.

**You'll Need To Have**

* 5+ years of total software developer experience in C++
* A Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, similar field of study or equivalent work experience
* Strong understanding of object-oriented design, data structures, multi-threading, and algorithms
* Experience with designing, developing and managing large-scale service-oriented systems
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills
* A self-starter approach with a strong sense of ownership

* Experience working on complex infrastructure systems under continuous use
* Experience in performance optimizations, passion to write performance-critical code

* Experience in multithreading
* Exposure to multiple phases of the software development life-cycle

title: Senior Software Engineer — Embedded C / Firewall Client
description:
**SonicWall**
 is a cybersecurity forerunner with more than 30 years of expertise and is recognized as a leading partner-first company, ensuring our partners and their customers are never alone in the fight against cybercrime. With the ability to build, scale and manage security across the cloud, hybrid and traditional environments in real-time, SonicWall provides relentless security against the most evasive cyberattacks across endless exposure points for increasingly remote, mobile and cloud-enabled users. With its own threat research center, SonicWall can quickly and economically provide purpose-built security solutions to enable any organization—enterprise, government agencies and SMBs—around the world. For more information, visit 
**www.sonicwall.com**
 or follow us on 
**Twitter**
, 
**LinkedIn**
, 
**Facebook**
 and 
**Instagram**
.

**About the Role**

SonicWall is hiring a Senior Software Engineer to develop and maintain the Content Filtering Service client embedded in SonicOS — the firmware running on SonicWall firewall appliances worldwide. This module intercepts live traffic, queries the CFS rating servers in real time, and enforces URL-based content filtering policies at the packet level. This is security-critical code: a policy bug is a traffic bypass on a deployed security appliance.

The codebase is in C with a split Control Plane / Data Plane architecture, multi-blade cache synchronization, and multiple firmware version upgrade paths.

**Responsibilities**

* Maintain, harden, and extend the CFS client module across both the control plane and data plane.
* Own the binary UDP protocol implementation between the firewall and the CFS rating servers, ensuring correctness and compatibility across protocol versions.
* Develop and maintain complete IPv4 and IPv6 support across all code paths.
* Own the firmware upgrade and migration paths, ensuring they are atomic, failure-safe, and correctly handle all supported version transitions.
* Improve reliability of inter-blade cache synchronization on multi-blade appliances.
* Collaborate with the server-side on coordinated protocol changes.
* Document the concurrency model, upgrade invariants, and dataplane integration for long-term maintainability.
* Collaborate asynchronously with a US-based team and the India-based server team.

**Requirements**

* Expert-level
  **C**
   (not C++): disciplined manual memory management, pointer arithmetic, and systems design.
* ****Multi-core concurrency in C****
  : reader-writer locks, spinlocks, atomic operations, and memory ordering.
* ****Kernel-level networking****
  : deep understanding of how a packet moves through a firewall dataplane — TCP/UDP processing, flow cache, connection tracking. Userspace socket programming alone is not sufficient.
* Strong
  **IPv4 and IPv6**
   across all code paths.
* Comfortable navigating and owning a large C codebase with multiple subsystems.
* Experience with network testing and debugging tools: packet capture (Wireshark/tcpdump), traffic generators, GDB.
* Good written English for remote, asynchronous collaboration.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience with multi-blade or multi-ASIC hardware platforms (Octeon/CVMX or similar).
* Understanding of symmetric encryption (AES-CBC, DES) at the C implementation level.
* Prior experience on a security appliance, network device, or UTM firmware codebase.
* Familiarity with TLV binary protocol design and versioning.
* Experience with C fuzz testing or sanitizers (AFL, AddressSanitizer, ThreadSanitizer).

**Education & Experience**

At least 8 years of related experience with a Bachelor's degree; or 6 years with a Master's degree; or a PhD with 3 years' experience; or equivalent experience preferred. Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field preferred.

Founded in 1956 and headquartered in San Francisco, California, Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is a Fortune 500, digital first, multi-channel specialty retailer. Our company vision is to own the home, and the places where our customers work, stay, and play. title: Staff Software Engineer- Agent
description:

Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success.

Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders - and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe.
  
  
We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in.
  
  
At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar.

**Endpoint Agent – Staff Software Engineer**

Join a fast-growing company transforming the IT management and cybersecurity industry. At Kaseya, we are modernizing how software is designed, built, tested, and operated—combining strong engineering fundamentals with AI-native development practices.

We are looking for a motivated Endpoint Software Engineer to help develop and maintain Kaseya's endpoint management agents. You will work alongside senior engineers to deliver new capabilities, improve platform reliability, and solve complex device management challenges across multiple operating systems.
  
  
This role is ideal for engineers passionate about operating systems, systems programming, device management, and endpoint security.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
  
  

* Design and implement new features for endpoint agents across Windows, macOS, Linux, and mobile platforms.
* Develop software components supporting monitoring, automation, patching, inventory collection, and device management.
* Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code.
* Investigate customer-reported issues and production escalations.

* Improve agent stability, performance, scalability, and security.
* Develop integrations with operating system management and security frameworks.
* Build telemetry and diagnostics capabilities that improve supportability.

* Collaborate with cloud, platform, QA, and support teams.
* Continuously learn and expand expertise in system software and endpoint technologies.

**What You Bring**
  
  

* 10+ years of software engineering experience developing system software, endpoint software, or platform services.
* Strong proficiency in C# and .NET
* Deep understanding of at least one operating system platform (Windows, macOS, Linux)
* Strong knowledge of operating system fundamentals including – Processes, Threads, Filesystems, Networking, Security fundamentals
* Good understanding of operating system security features and device management concepts.
* Familiarity with one or more MDM ecosystems – Intune, Apple MDM, Android Enterprise, Linux management tools

**Nice to have**

* Experience with RMM, UEM, EDR, XDR, or endpoint security products.

* Solves complex customer and platform challenges.
* Improves reliability, security, and performance of endpoint agents.
* Partners effectively across Product, Support, Security, and Engineering teams.

title: Principal Software Engineer
description:
Powering the world’s payments ecosystem
  
ACI powers the payments ecosystem – globally, and you power ACI. You’ll innovate, collaborate, and grow in an energetic technology culture with decades of proven success. ACIers – in all roles and levels – are truly your colleagues and many are your friends. Our size and reach allow you to see the global impact of your work. You are visible, your talents are valued, and you are empowered to shape the future of payments.
  
As a Principal Cloud Engineer in Pune, you will join a diverse, passionate team dedicated to powering the world’s payments ecosystem. This role is focused on designing, automating, and evolving cloud platform capabilities that support ACI’s enterprise infrastructure strategy and next-generation payment solutions. AWS, Kubernetes, Infrastructure as Code, automation, and continuous compliance are key focus areas for this role.
  
Job Summary
  
ACI Worldwide is seeking a highly experienced Principal Cloud Engineer to provide technical leadership for enterprise cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, automation, and cloud governance initiatives. This role is ideal for a hands-on technical leader with AWS, Kubernetes, EKS, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, Platform Engineering, Cloud Security, and Automation expertise who can drive technical strategy, influence engineering direction, and mentor engineering teams across the organization. The ideal candidate will bring a software-defined mindset and the ability to architect, automate, and orchestrate cloud solutions at scale.
  
Key Responsibilities
  
- Define and drive cloud architecture, technical strategy, and engineering standards across enterprise platforms.
  
- Lead the design and implementation of scalable, secure, highly available cloud infrastructure solutions.
  
- Drive adoption of Infrastructure as Code (IaC), automation, and platform engineering best practices.
  
- Architect and implement AWS and Kubernetes-based solutions, including Amazon EKS environments.
  
- Build and optimize CI/CD pipelines, automated deployment workflows, and cloud operational frameworks.
  
- Lead cloud governance, security, compliance automation, and operational excellence initiatives.
  
- Provide technical leadership across engineering teams and serve as the escalation point for complex cloud infrastructure challenges.
  
- Partner with Product, Engineering, Infrastructure, and Security teams to align technology investments with business objectives.
  
- Mentor engineers and promote engineering excellence, innovation, automation, and cloud-first strategies.
  
- Drive enterprise cloud modernization and continuous compliance initiatives through automated controls and evidence generation.
  
  
Required Qualifications
  
- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related field.
  
- 12+ years of experience in Cloud Engineering, Platform Engineering, DevOps, or Infrastructure Engineering.
  
- Proven experience designing and delivering large-scale cloud infrastructure solutions.
  
- Strong experience leading architecture, automation, and cloud transformation initiatives.
  
- Experience influencing technical direction and mentoring engineering teams.
  
- Experience in Payments, Financial Services, FinTech, or other regulated industries preferred.
  
  
Technical Expertise
  
- Expert-level experience with AWS Cloud Services, Kubernetes, Amazon EKS, and Cloud-Native Infrastructure.
  
- Deep expertise in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, Bicep, or equivalent technologies).
  
- Strong knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, Git-based workflows, platform automation, and DevOps practices.
  
- Experience with Containerization Technologies, Kubernetes Orchestration, and Cloud Platform Operations.
  
- Strong understanding of Cloud Networking, Security, Compliance, Reliability Engineering, and Governance.
  
- Experience implementing automated configuration management and secure cloud deployment frameworks.
  
- Experience developing pipeline-driven infrastructure delivery and enterprise cloud automation solutions.
  
- Strong understanding of scalability, performance optimization, operational resilience, and security best practices.
  
- Experience evaluating and adopting emerging technologies, including AI-powered engineering tools.
  
  
AI & Emerging Technologies
  
- Proven experience evaluating and integrating AI/ML capabilities into cloud platforms and engineering operations.
  
- Strong understanding of Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), AI Agents, and AI-driven automation concepts.
  
- Experience leveraging AI-powered cloud services from AWS, Azure, OpenAI, or equivalent providers.
  
- Ability to identify opportunities where AI can improve cloud operations, infrastructure management, compliance automation, and engineering productivity.
  
- Experience establishing governance, security, privacy, and responsible AI practices within enterprise environments.
  
- Demonstrated use of AI-assisted engineering tools to accelerate delivery, automation, and platform reliability.
  
- Ability to drive technical strategy and architectural decisions related to AI adoption within cloud engineering organizations.
  
  
Professional Skills
  
- Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills.
  
- Strong strategic and architectural thinking with a business-outcome mindset.
  
- Ability to influence technical direction without direct authority.
  
- Passion for mentoring and developing engineering talent.
  
- Strong problem-solving and decision-making capabilities.
  
- Ability to balance technical depth with enterprise-wide impact.
  
  
Preferred Qualifications
  
- Advanced AWS, Kubernetes, or Cloud Platform Certifications.
  
- Experience leading enterprise cloud transformation initiatives.
  
- Experience with FinOps, cloud cost optimization, and cloud governance frameworks.
  
- Knowledge of continuous compliance and automated audit evidence generation.
  
- Windows administration experience is considered a plus.
  
- Industry thought leadership, conference speaking, publications, or technical community contributions.
  
  
Ideal Candidate
  
The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in AWS, Kubernetes, Amazon EKS, Infrastructure as Code, Cloud Automation, Platform Engineering, and Cloud Security with the ability to architect and scale AI-enabled cloud platforms, driving innovation while ensuring security, compliance, reliability, and business value. The successful candidate will possess a software-defined mindset and demonstrate the ability to build, automate, and orchestrate cloud solutions at enterprise scale.
  
Core Capabilities
  
We seek colleagues who embody our core capabilities — these shape our culture and enable us to make a meaningful impact together:
  
- Ensure Accountability: holding self and others accountable to meet commitments.
  
- Drives Results: consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.
  
- Customer Focus: building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.
  
- Cultivate Innovation: creating new and better ways for the organization to be successful.
  
- Collaborates: building partnerships and working collaboratively with others.
  
- Courage: stepping up to address difficult issues, saying what needs to be said.
  
  
In return for your expertise, we offer opportunities for growth, career development, and a competitive compensation and benefits package—all within an innovative and collaborative work environment.
  
Are you ready to help us transform the payments ecosystem? To learn more about ACI Worldwide, visit our web site at www.aciworldwide.com
