title: Research Scientist - Nemotron India
description:
NVIDIA has continuously reinvented itself. Our invention of the GPU sparked the growth of the PC gaming market, redefined modern computer graphics, and revolutionized parallel computing. Today, research in artificial intelligence is booming worldwide, which calls for highly scalable and massively parallel computation horsepower that NVIDIA GPUs excel. NVIDIA is a “learning machine” that constantly evolves by adapting to new opportunities that are hard to solve, that only we can address, and that matter to the world. This is our life’s work , to amplify human creativity and intelligence. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join our diverse team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world!
  
  
We are looking for Research Scientists passionate about large generative models! We are searching for world-class researchers in deep learning and natural language processing (NLP) to join our applied deep learning research team which pioneered the Megatron, MT-NLG, and DLSS projects at NVIDIA. Our team is pushing the boundaries of generative AI by building state-of-the-art large language and multi-modal foundation models and applying them to solve real-world problems. If you are passionate about the latest research and technologies revolutionizing generative AI and want to explore creative new paradigms for applied foundation models such as software assistants and customized multi-modal agents, this team will be a great fit for you. After building prototypes that demonstrate the promise of your research, you will collaborate with product teams to apply your ideas into industry-leading real-world applications.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Develop deep learning-based approaches to improve and advance large language models (LLMs) and large multi-modal models.
* Design and implement machine learning techniques to adapt foundation models to downstream tasks of interest such as software assistant and multi-turn multi-modal and multi-lingual dialogue system.
* Construct and curate datasets for large-scale machine learning, for learning from human preferences, and for specific domains of applications.
* Work closely with product and hardware architecture teams to integrate your research and developments into products.

**What We Need To See**

* MS or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science/Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* 3+ years of experience.
* Extensive machine learning / deep learning research or work experience.
* Knowledge of application areas such as natural language processing and computer vision.
* Excellent programming skills in some rapid prototyping environments such as Python; C++ and parallel programming (e.g., CUDA) is a plus.

title: Lead Engineer
description:
Company description

PRAAJX Private Limited is a Pune-based technology company building a consumer AI assistant that gets real things done for people. You tell it what you need, by voice or text, and it carries the task out in the background: scheduling, deliveries, calls, and more. People will use it every day, so reliability matters more than demos.

Role description

You will be the first engineering hire and the technical co-owner of v1. You decide how it is built, you build the hardest parts yourself, and you set the standard for the engineers who join after you.

* Own the architecture and technical decisions for v1 of the product, from the first commit to the first thousand users
* Design the agent platform: task planning, tool calling, background execution, retries, and per-user memory
* Write production code every day. This is a hands-on role, not a management role
* Set up the foundations early: repositories, CI/CD, environments, logging, monitoring, and security basics
* Make build-versus-buy calls on APIs and managed services to keep cost per user low
* Set cost and latency guardrails for LLM and voice usage together with the founder, and track them weekly
* Take part in technical interviews and set the quality bar for the engineers we hire next
* Keep a written spec and decision log so nobody has to guess why something was built a certain way
* Push back on scope and help the founder cut v1 down to what can actually ship

Qualifications

* 5+ years building and shipping production software, including at least 1 year with LLM-based features running for real users (not only prototypes)
* Has been the lead or primary engineer on a product that went from zero to real users
* Strong in one backend stack (Node.js/TypeScript or Python) and comfortable across web, mobile, and infrastructure
* Hands-on with agent patterns: tool calling, structured outputs, async jobs and queues, and safe-to-retry operations
* Understands security for personal data: OAuth, token storage, encryption, and least-privilege access
* Cost-aware by habit: knows what an LLM or voice call costs and designs around it
* Can walk us through a live system, repository, or product they built and explain every major decision

Nice to have:

* Realtime voice or telephony experience
* Mobile app releases on iOS and Android
* Familiarity with India's data-protection (DPDP) requirements
* Early-stage startup experience as one of the first engineers

What we value:

* Owner mindset: treats the product as theirs, not as a ticket queue
* Serious and accountable: commits to a date and hits it, or says early that it will slip and why
* Direct: tells the founder when an idea is wrong, with reasons, instead of quietly building it
* Pragmatic: ships a working v1, then improves it with real usage
* Long-term commitment: this is a multi-year build, and we want someone who plans to stay

We’re looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer to join our Pune HQ2 team and work at the intersection of cutting-edge AI and complex enterprise software. You’ll embed with customer engineering teams and help them transform how they build software with Blitzy. This isn’t a hand-coding or traditional solutions engineering role. You’ll onboard new teams, guide them through the platform, troubleshoot issues, and work with client engineers on architecture and priorities, with the goal of getting each team to run Blitzy independently.
  
  
Our HQ2 FDE team deploys alongside customers around the world, working closely with US-based engineering and customer teams with regular time zone overlap for collaboration and handoffs. * Deploy Blitzy into complex enterprise environments, navigating technical constraints and translating customer business goals into practical technical solutions
* Embed with customer teams during critical implementations, partnering with engineering leaders on sprint planning, architecture reviews, technical decisions, and production deployments

* Build and evolve REST APIs using a contract-first approach with OpenAPI/Swagger, with data persistence through PostgreSQL, Hibernate/JPA, and Liquibase

* Drive successful POCs and technical demonstrations that showcase advanced use cases, deliver measurable value, and expand into enterprise-wide deployments
* Maintain high standards for testing, code quality, performance, and observability using JUnit 5, Cucumber/Gherkin, JMeter, Git, Logback/SLF4J, SpotBugs, and SonarQube

* Collaborate with product and engineering teams to translate field experience into platform improvements, technical documentation, reusable best practices, and contributions to the core product

* 10+ years of software engineering experience with a track record of shipping production code in enterprise environments
* Deep hands-on expertise with Java 17, Spring Boot 3.x, Spring MVC, Spring Data JPA, Spring Security, Hibernate/JPA, and Actuator
* Strong experience with REST APIs, OpenAPI/Swagger, PostgreSQL, Liquibase, Maven, Docker, and modern testing practices including JUnit 5, Cucumber/Gherkin, and JMeter
* Experience building and operating microservices with CI/CD, cloud architecture, observability, production monitoring, and tools such as Micrometer, Dynatrace, SpotBugs, and SonarQube
* Knowledge of enterprise modernization and distributed systems, including Java 8 → Java 17 upgrades, monolith → microservices migrations, Kafka, Avro, Schema Registry, caching, and resilience patterns
* Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum and modern software development practices, with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts to audiences ranging from interns to CTOs
* Experience in customer-facing engineering, developer tools, AI/ML, or enterprise modernization is a plus, along with technical thought leadership through blogs, talks, or open-source contributions
* Passion for AI-powered software development and willingness to work in person from Pune, India, with overlap for US-based teams

*Blitzy is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We believe different perspectives make us stronger. Base salary ranges are determined by country, role, level, experience, and skills. The range displayed on each job posting reflects Blitzy’s good faith determination of the minimum and maximum targets for new hire salaries across all locations. title: Senior Software QA Test Developer - Embedded
description:

You will work alongside a versatile team using modern technologies to elevate quality across our dynamic ecosystem.

* Develop and improve Python-based test frameworks and CI/CD automation for NVIDIA Metropolis, validating end-to-end IVA and video AI workflows across cloud, data center, workstation and edge platforms.

* Benchmark AI pipelines and applications for accuracy, latency, efficiency, resource utilization, scalability, and reliability across different GPU configurations and deployment profiles.
* Partner with development, architecture, product, and release teams to identify quality risks, analyze sophisticated system-level issues, drive defects to resolution and communicate release readiness and quality metrics.

**What We Need To See**

* B.Tech. Or M.Tech. In Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Electronics, or a related field, or comparable experience.
* 5+ years of hands-on software test development or automation experience, preferably in AI/ML, computer vision, video analytics, embedded systems or GPU-accelerated applications.
* Strong Python programming skills with experience building test frameworks, automation infrastructure, utilities and validation tools from the ground up.
* Hands-on experience bringing to bear AI-assisted development tools and AI-powered workflows for test development, code generation, test analysis, debugging, coverage improvement, or test development workflow optimization.
* Strong proficiency in Linux, including shell scripting, system-level debugging, process/resource analysis and command-line fixing.
* Hands-on understanding of AI/ML and computer vision, including concepts such as object detection, classification, tracking, video analytics and AI inference pipelines.
* Experience with CI/CD, Docker, and containerized application deployments, using tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or equivalent.
* Strong understanding of test development methodologies, including test planning, test building, regression testing, defect lifecycle management, root-cause analysis, code/test coverage, and release validation.

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Experience with NVIDIA Metropolis, DeepStream, Video Search & Summarization (VSS), TensorRT, CUDA, NGC, or AI inference technologies driven by GPUs.
* Experience evaluating real-time video streaming, intelligent video analytics, multi-stream/multi-camera workloads, or Video Search & Summarization (VSS) systems.
* Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and Helm, including deployment and validation on NVIDIA Jetson, RTX, or data center GPU platforms.
* Experience working on the development or validation of AI agents, Agentic AI workflows, multimodal AI, or Physical AI applications, including tool calling, orchestration, perception, or spatial understanding.
* Proven track record of applying AI tools or AI-powered test development agents to measurably improve test automation efficiency, coverage, quality, debugging, and regression efficiency.

title: Technology and Innovation - Data Engineering Manager
description:
**Data Engineering Manager**
Riveron is seeking a hands-on Data Engineering Manager to be part of our data engineering team in India. This is not a pure people-management role — you will be writing code, building pipelines, and architecting data platforms daily alongside your team. We're looking for someone who leads from the codebase, not just from a conference room. If you bring deep implementation experience across Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, and Databricks and can pair strong architectural thinking with real delivery output, we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
**Who You Are**

* A data engineering professional with 8 to 12 years of experience, including 1-3 years balancing technical leadership with active, hands-on implementation — you've managed teams without stepping away from the keyboard.
* You write production-quality code daily. This role requires active coding and pipeline development — not just code reviews and architectural diagrams.
* Hands-on, implementation-level expertise with Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, and Databricks is non-negotiable. You've personally built, deployed, and tuned production workloads on these platforms.
* Strong data architecture background spanning lakehouse design, medallion architecture, data vault, dimensional modeling, and enterprise data platform design — grounded in systems you've actually built, not just designed on paper.
* Deep proficiency in SQL and Python — you can write complex transformations, optimize query performance, debug pipeline failures, and build automation frameworks yourself.
* Proven experience building and shipping ETL/ELT frameworks using Azure Data Factory, dbt, Spark, and platform-native orchestration tools.
* Solid working knowledge of Azure cloud data services (Synapse Analytics, Data Lake Storage, Azure SQL Database) and comfort operating in multi-cloud environments.
* Well-versed in data governance, data quality frameworks, cataloging, lineage, and security best practices — with experience implementing these controls, not just defining policies.
* Proficient with Git-based version control, CI/CD pipelines for data workloads, and Infrastructure as Code — you commit code, open pull requests, and maintain deployment pipelines alongside your team.
* Comfortable working in Agile delivery environments and translating business requirements into scalable technical designs.

**What You'll Do**

* Spend a significant portion of your time writing code — building data pipelines, developing transformation logic, configuring platform services, and shipping production-ready solutions.
* Lead, mentor, and grow a team of data engineers while remaining the team's strongest technical contributor and setting the standard through your own code and architectural decisions.
* Design and personally implement scalable data platforms on Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, and Databricks — selecting the right platform for each use case and building the solution end to end.
* Architect and build lakehouse and data warehouse solutions, defining and coding ingestion patterns, transformation layers, storage strategies, and consumption models.
* Own critical and complex implementation work — the toughest pipeline builds, the most challenging performance problems, and the architectural spikes that set direction for the team.
* Write and maintain shared libraries, frameworks, and reusable components that accelerate the team's delivery and enforce engineering standards.
* Conduct deep, line-level code reviews focused on correctness, performance, and maintainability — not just approval stamps.
* Partner with analytics, data science, and business stakeholders to translate data requirements into engineered solutions and personally prototype key components.
* Establish and enforce best practices for data modeling, pipeline reliability, observability, testing, and documentation — by building the reference implementations yourself.
* Optimize platform performance and manage costs across Snowflake compute, Databricks clusters, and Fabric capacities through hands-on tuning and configuration.
* Implement data governance and security controls across engineering initiatives, ensuring compliance, data quality, and lineage traceability at the code and platform level.
* Stay current with the evolving data platform landscape and evaluate emerging tools through hands-on proof-of-concept work, not just vendor demos.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* A career path that shows sustained, hands-on implementation even as responsibilities grew — architect-turned-manager, not analyst-turned-manager.
* Hands-on experience building medallion-architecture lakehouses on Databricks or Microsoft Fabric, and designing and tuning performant Snowflake warehouse structures.
* Experience implementing CI/CD for data pipelines using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, including writing the pipeline definitions and deployment scripts yourself.
* Familiarity with dbt for transformation orchestration, with personal experience writing and maintaining dbt models and tests.
* Exposure to real-time or near-real-time data ingestion patterns (Kafka, Event Hubs, Spark Structured Streaming) through direct implementation.
* Experience with data mesh or domain-oriented data platform strategies is a strong plus.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to articulate architectural trade-offs to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Excellent stakeholder management skills, with experience running sprint planning, design reviews, and cross-functional delivery coordination.

**About Riveron**
At Riveron, we partner with clients—from global multinationals to high-growth private entities—to solve complex finance challenges, guided by our DELTA values: Drive, Excellence, Leadership, Teamwork, and Accountability. Our entrepreneurial culture thrives on collaboration, diverse perspectives, and delivering exceptional outcomes. We are committed to fostering growth, both for our clients and our people, through mentorship, integrity, and a client-centric approach. This inclusive environment offers flexibility, progressive benefits, and meaningful opportunities for impactful work that supports well-being in and out of the office.

EY’s financial services practice provides integrated Consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, retail banks, investment banks, broker-dealers & asset management firms, and insurance firms from leading Fortune 500 Companies. Within EY’s Consulting Practice, Data and Analytics team solves big, complex issues and capitalize on opportunities to deliver better working outcomes that help expand and safeguard the businesses, now and in the future. This way we help create a compelling business case for embedding the right analytical practice at the heart of client’s decision-making.
  
  
**The opportunity**
Senior Data & AI Architect with 13+ years of experience in data engineering and data architecture, strong hands-on expertise in Databricks, Hadoop, Spark/PySpark, and cloud data platforms.
  
  
This role combines deep technical ownership of enterprise Lakehouse and data platform architecture with hands-on experience building Agentic AI and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions on Databricks. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable designing large-scale, production-grade data pipelines, architecting modern AI-driven solutions, and engaging directly with clients on strategic proposals and solution design.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Architect, design, and deliver scalable Data & AI solutions on the Databricks Lakehouse platform, covering ingestion, transformation, storage, governance, and consumption layers.
* Design and optimize large-scale distributed data processing pipelines using Hadoop, Apache Spark, and PySpark.
* Build reusable, production-grade Python frameworks and pipelines for batch and streaming data engineering workloads.
* Define and implement cloud data architecture on AWS and/or Azure, covering storage, IAM, networking, security, and monitoring, with native Databricks integration.

* Act as a trusted technical advisor in customer workshops, translating business requirements into robust technical architectures.
* Mentor engineering teams on Databricks, Spark, cloud architecture, and modern AI/RAG engineering practices.

13+ years of experience in Data Engineering / Data Architecture, with strong hands-on experience across Databricks, Hadoop, Spark/PySpark, and cloud data platforms.
  
  

* Databricks

+ Strong expertise in Databricks Lakehouse, Delta Lake, Databricks SQL, and Unity Catalog.
+ Hands-on experience with Jobs/Workflows, performance optimization, and production deployments.

* Hadoop & Spark

+ Strong knowledge of the Hadoop ecosystem, HDFS, and Hive.
+ Strong hands-on experience with Apache Spark and PySpark for large-scale distributed data processi

* Python

+ Strong proficiency in Python for building scalable, reusable, production-grade data pipelines and frameworks.
+ Cloud
+ Strong experience with AWS and/or Azure, including cloud storage, IAM, networking, security, and monitoring.
+ Experience integrating Databricks with cloud-native services.

* Data Engineering

+ Expertise in ETL/ELT, batch and streaming processing, data ingestion, transformation, orchestration, and data quality.
+ Proven ability to design scalable, production-ready pipeline architectures.

* SQL & Data Modelling

+ Strong SQL skills, with experience in dimensional modelling, star/snowflake schemas, fact/dimension models, SCD, and analytical data models.

* Agentic AI

+ Hands-on experience designing and building Agentic AI solutions with Databricks, including LLMs, tool/function calling, agent workflows, guardrails, and enterprise data integration.

* RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)

+ Strong experience building RAG solutions using Databricks, including document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector search, retrieval, grounding, and evaluation.

* Git & CI/CD

+ Strong knowledge of Git, branching strategies, pull requests, and code reviews.
+ Experience with CI/CD pipelines and deployment across multiple environments.
+ Experience with Databricks Asset Bundles and/or Terraform is a plus.

* Strategic RFPs & Solutioning

+ Ability to participate in strategic RFP/RFI responses, solution shaping, technical proposals, and effort estimations.
+ Experience delivering architecture presentations and leading customer workshops.

* Client Communication
* Strong client-facing and communication skills, with the ability to understand business requirements, translate them into scalable technical solutions, and clearly communicate architectural decisions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:

title: Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Description**
At
**Relatient**
, we help healthcare organizations optimize patient access through AI-powered workflows, real-time automation, and flexible access tools. Trusted by more than 50,000 providers, we modernize the patient experience and have been recognized by Forbes and Deloitte for our innovative, inclusive culture.
  
  
**Your Role at Relatient:**
We’re seeking an
**Infrastructure Engineer**
to join our team at
**Amar Tech Park**
.
  
  
In this role, you’ll manage and optimize Relatient’s AWS infrastructure to support the stability, performance, and security of our healthcare SaaS platform. You’ll partner with architects, developers, DevOps engineers, and operations teams to maintain core services, resolve pipeline issues, and respond quickly to incidents.
  
  
**How You’ll Make an Impact:**

* Manage, optimize, and support AWS services, including EC2, SQS, S3, API Gateway, CloudWatch, Cognito, CloudFront, Fargate, ECS, and RDS.
* Use Terraform and other infrastructure-as-code practices to improve consistency, scalability, and reliability.
* Support daily infrastructure operations and escalate unresolved issues appropriately.
* Use DevOps tools such as Nexus, GitLab, Jenkins, Git, Bitbucket, Terraform, Kubernetes, and Service Catalog to automate deployments, strengthen CI/CD pipelines, and manage infrastructure.
* Monitor system health with CloudWatch and related tools, responding quickly to incidents and alerts to support service continuity.
* Partner with development and operations teams to diagnose and resolve pipeline issues with minimal disruption.
* Apply security patches and updates to maintain a secure, compliant infrastructure environment.
* Administer PostgreSQL and MySQL databases to support data integrity, performance, and high availability.
* Configure and maintain Nginx and Asterisk PBX to support load balancing and reliable VoIP services.
* Use Linux systems administration and networking knowledge to troubleshoot and optimize infrastructure components.
* Write scripts in Bash, Python, or similar languages to automate routine tasks, streamline processes, and improve operational efficiency.
* Maintain clear documentation for infrastructure configurations, procedures, and troubleshooting steps.

**What You Bring:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, B.E./B.Tech, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 5+ years of experience as a Platform Engineer, Infrastructure Engineer, or similar role.
* Experience supporting a healthcare SaaS environment hosted on AWS preferred.
* Relevant certifications such as AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, AWS Solutions Architect, Kubernetes certifications, Azure Administrator, RHCE, VCP, CCNP, MCSE, CompTIA Network+, or ITIL Foundation are a plus.
* Hands-on experience managing AWS and cloud infrastructure services, including EC2, Lambda, Route 53, VPC, SQS, S3, API Gateway, CloudWatch, Cognito, CloudFront, Fargate, ECS, and RDS.
* Strong knowledge of DevOps, automation, and infrastructure-as-code tools, including Nexus, GitLab, Jenkins, Git, Bitbucket, Terraform, Kubernetes, Service Catalog, Docker, Ansible, Chef, Puppet, and CloudFormation.
* Experience with incident management, pipeline issue resolution, patch management, logging, monitoring, alerting, and system performance troubleshooting.

**Mindsets That Matter:**
We’re always looking for ways to grow and take pride in what we do. You’ll thrive here if you:
  
  

* Act with purpose, focus, and accountability
* Collaborate across teams and communicate clearly
* Keep innovating and automate what slows you down

**Benefits Include (India):**

* INR 5,00,000 in life insurance coverage for all full-time employees and their immediate households.
* INR 15,00,000 in accident coverage.
* Education reimbursement.
* 10 national or state holidays, plus one floating holiday.
* Flexible hours and a hybrid work environment.

**Equal Opportunity at Relatient:**
We’re building a team as diverse as the communities we serve.
**Relatient**
is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. If you need accommodation during the application process, just let us know.
  
  
To learn more about our organization, visit
**www.relatient.com**
**Ready to Join Relatient?**
If you’re looking for work that matters and a team that makes it count, we'd love to hear from you!

title: Senior Consultant - SAP-SAP CPI DS
description:
**Job Description**
Bristlecone India Limited is seeking a seasoned Senior Consultant for its SAP ET – Analytics – Delivery team. The role focuses on designing, developing, and delivering complex SAP Cloud Platform Integration – Data Services (CPI‑DS) solutions that connect SAP IBP with ECC, S/4HANA, APO, HANA DB, flat files and other data sources. You will drive workshops, mentor junior staff, and ensure seamless data flow across business and IT landscapes while meeting aggressive timelines.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead design workshops with business and IT stakeholders to define integration architecture and data flow.
* Architect and implement end‑to‑end CPI‑DS solutions for IBP to ECC/S/4HANA, APO, HANA DB, flat files and other systems.
* Develop complex CI‑DS tasks, including pre‑scripts, post‑scripts, and RFC‑based integrations.
* Configure and manage CI‑DS agents, connections, scheduling, and administration in customer landscapes.
* Collaborate with functional teams to align master data, attributes, and planning level concepts in IBP.
* Produce and validate XML‑based inputs/outputs for CI‑DS tasks and ensure data quality.
* Provide expertise on SAP S/4HANA and IBP integration, including demand, SOP, inventory, and response‑supply processes.
* Mentor and guide junior consultants, fostering knowledge transfer and best practices.
* Support CI (Continuous Integration) pipelines and assist with OData/CDS view integrations where required.
* Deliver project milestones within tight deadlines and manage stakeholder expectations.

**Qualifications**

* 8+ years of SAP integration experience, with minimum 4 years focused on SAP CPI‑DS.
* At least 4 full lifecycle CPI‑DS implementation projects delivered end‑to‑end.
* Deep expertise in SAP IBP (functional knowledge of demand, SOP, inventory, response‑supply).
* Strong hands‑on experience developing CI‑DS tasks for ECC, S/4HANA, APO, HANA DB, flat files, etc.
* Proficiency in pre‑scripts, post‑scripts, RFC function module integration, and XML data handling.
* Good understanding of SAP S/4HANA functional processes and IBP add‑ons/extractors.
* Experience setting up CI‑DS agents, connections, scheduling and administration in client landscapes.
* Knowledge of ABAP, CDS views and OData is a plus.
* Excellent communication, workshop facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to mentor junior team members and thrive under aggressive timelines.

**About Us**
**ABOUT US**
Bristlecone is the leading provider of AI-powered application transformation services for the connected supply chain. We empower our customers with speed, visibility, automation, and resiliency – to thrive on change.
  
  
Our transformative solutions in Digital Logistics, Cognitive Manufacturing, Autonomous Planning, Smart Procurement and Digitalization are positioned around key industry pillars and delivered through a comprehensive portfolio of services spanning digital strategy, design and build, and implementation across a range of technology platforms.
  
  
Bristlecone is ranked among the top ten leaders in supply chain services by Gartner. We are headquartered in San Jose, California, with locations across North America, Europe and Asia, and over 2,500 consultants. Bristlecone is part of the $19.4 billion Mahindra Group.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Employer**
Bristlecone is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status .

* Understand and adhere to Information Security policies, guidelines and procedure, practice them for protection of organizational data and Information System.
* Take part in information security training and act while handling information.
* Report all suspected security and policy breach to InfoSec team or appropriate authority (CISO).
* Understand and adhere to the additional information security responsibilities as part of the assigned job role.

title: Software Engineer - Team Leader
description:
**Who We Are**
Worldline helps businesses of all shapes and sizes to accelerate their growth journey - quickly, simply, and securely. We are the innovators at the heart of the payments technology industry, shaping how the world pays and gets paid. Our technology powers the growth of millions of businesses across 5 continents. And just as we help our customers accelerate their business, we are committed to helping our people accelerate their careers. Together, we shape the evolution.
  
  
Long Description
  
  
**Who Are We Looking For**
We look for big thinkers. People who can drive positive change, step up and show what’s next – people with passion, can-do attitude and a hunger to learn and grow. In practice this means:
  
  

* Technical Proficiency: A lead developer should have a deep understanding of the technologies used in the project. They should be able to write clean, efficient, and maintainable code.
* Leadership: They should be able to guide and mentor other developers in the team. They should be able to delegate tasks effectively and ensure that the team is working towards the project goals.
* Communication: A lead developer should have excellent communication skills. They should be able to clearly articulate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Problem Solving: They should be able to identify and solve problems quickly and efficiently. They should also be able to anticipate potential issues and take proactive measures to prevent them.
* Collaboration: A lead developer should be able to work well with others. They should be able to collaborate effectively with other teams and stakeholders.
* Continuous Learning: Technology is always evolving, and a lead developer should be committed to continuous learning and improvement. They should be open to new ideas and technologies.
* Quality Assurance: They should be responsible for ensuring the quality of the code produced by the team. They should enforce coding standards and best practices, and should also be involved in code reviews.
* Project Management: A lead developer should have a good understanding of project management principles. They should be able to manage resources effectively, meet deadlines, and deliver projects on time and within budget.
* Ethics: They should adhere to the ethical standards of the software development profession. They should respect intellectual property rights, maintain confidentiality, and avoid conflicts of interest.
* Innovation: A lead developer should be innovative and creative. They should be able to come up with new ideas to improve the product or the development process.

**Must have**

* Sense of ownership and technical responsibility on the team's software
* Technical expertise in .NET Core and practices surrounding it as well as the faculty to spread them in the team.
* Experience with SCRUM methodology and participation to the backlog construction, refinement and sprint planning, in order to help estimate and plan work items.
* Contribution to the development of organizational policies, standards, and guidelines for software development.
* Experience in software design in complex, high throughput, real time and 0 downtime context aligned with architectural guidelines and documented precisely.
* Ensures team software respect functionally but also non functionally (Security, Performance, Resilience, etc...) the requirements Experience with DevOps tooling and practices (CI/CD pipelines, Git, 4 eyes principle or canary releases) Experience troubleshooting complex systems in case of bug, incident or test result failures.
* Experience with SOA and API contract definitions and preferably in a micro services architecture context.
* Experience with testing techniques and automation such as BDD, TDD, etc... allowing the lead developer to design test cases covering complex or non functional test cases.
* Continuous improvement mindset.

**Shape the evolution**
We are on an exciting journey towards the next frontiers of payments technology, and we look for big thinkers, people with passion, can-do attitude and a hunger to learn and grow. Here you'll work with ambitious colleagues from around the world, take on unique challenges as a team, and make a real impact on the society. With an empowering culture, strong technology and extensive training opportunities, we help you accelerate your career - wherever you decide to go. Join our global team of 18,000 innovators and shape a tomorrow that is yours to own.
  
  
Learn more about life at Worldline at jobs.worldline.com
  
  
We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as an individual with a disability, or any applicable legally protected characteristics.

title: AxiomSL / Adenza ControllerView Developer Pune/ Bangalore
description:
**About Northern Trust**
As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
  
  
Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
  
  
With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
  
  
**AxiomSL / Adenza ControllerView Developer**
**This is a hands-on core development role, not an application or production support role.**
The developer will independently design, build, test, and deploy AxiomSL / Adenza ControllerView regulatory reporting solutions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, configure, and maintain solutions using current AxiomSL / Adenza ControllerView releases, including data sources, data models, portfolios, aggregations, shorthand logic, business rules, workflows, and Free Form and Tabular Reports.
* Translate regulatory, functional, and data requirements into technical designs, mappings, calculations, validations, and reporting workflows.
* Develop and optimize SQL and PL/SQL, ETL processes, and Unix/Linux shell scripts used to source, transform, reconcile, and deliver regulatory data.
* Perform source-to-report data analysis, reconciliation, drill-down validation, and root-cause analysis for data-quality and reporting discrepancies.
* Build solutions with traceability, lineage, auditability, maker-checker controls, and evidence required for governance, internal audit, and regulatory review.
* Prepare technical specifications, data mappings, deployment instructions, support procedures, and operational runbooks.
* Create and execute unit, integration, regression, and end-to-end test cases; support user acceptance testing and maintain evidence of results.
* Manage ControllerView object migration, release onboarding, environment promotion, scheduling, and production deployment in accordance with SDLC and change-management controls.
* Resolve defects in developer-owned solutions and provide limited post-deployment stabilization; routine monitoring and ticket-based support are out of scope.
* Collaborate with Finance, Risk, Treasury, Regulatory Reporting, data providers, infrastructure teams, auditors, and vendor support to deliver accurate and timely reporting.
* Participate in Agile delivery, peer reviews, estimation, backlog refinement, and continuous improvement of development and operational practices.

**Required Qualifications**

* 6–8 years of software development experience, including at least 3 years of hands-on AxiomSL / Adenza ControllerView development in a banking or financial-services environment.
* Proven hands-on experience independently designing and developing end-to-end ControllerView solutions; support-only experience does not meet this requirement.
* Advanced SQL and PL/SQL skills, including complex data analysis, reconciliation, query optimization, and database performance tuning.
* Hands-on experience with ETL concepts, enterprise data warehouses, Unix/Linux, shell scripting, and enterprise job schedulers such as Control-M or Autosys.
* Working knowledge of regulatory reporting controls, data lineage, data quality, governance, and production support practices.
* Experience delivering regulatory reports in one or more jurisdictions, such as U.S. Federal Reserve and FFIEC reporting, Basel III/IV, EMEA COREP/FINREP, or APAC regulatory reporting.
* Ability to read business and functional requirements, challenge gaps, and independently develop a technically sound solution aligned with architecture and coding standards.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, written communication, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Finance, or a related discipline.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Controller View 10 or 11, including enhanced import/export, reporting, workflow configuration, lineage and dependency tracking, troubleshooting, and release maintenance.
* Familiarity with Git-based version control, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, code-quality controls, and DevOps release practices.
* Experience with regulatory change delivery, platform upgrades, taxonomy updates, remediation programs, or modernization of legacy reporting processes.
* Knowledge of capital, liquidity, counterparty credit risk, financial reporting, or trade and transaction reporting.

**Success Competencies**

* End-to-end ownership of design, development, testing, and deployment.
* Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment while communicating risks, decisions, and dependencies early.
* Attention to detail and a control-focused mindset appropriate for regulatory reporting.
* Ability to explain complex data and technical issues clearly to both technical and business stakeholders.

**Working with Us**
As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
  
  
Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
  
  
**Reasonable Accommodation**
Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.
  
  
**About Our Pune Office**
The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.
  
  
Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

title: Software Engineer (Python & Data) – Markets Business Controls Technology
description:
Citi's Markets Technology group is seeking a skilled Software Python & Data Engineer in Pune to help engineer high-throughput Regulatory Controls and Market Surveillance Platforms. In this hands-on engineering role, you will design, code, and optimize scalable Python backend services and data pipelines that process large volumes of financial market data—including trade lifecycles, orders, executions, and risk analytics. Working at the intersection of software engineering and capital markets, you will collaborate with trading desks, risk managers, and compliance teams to deliver automated control frameworks and apply modern innovations—including Generative AI—to strengthen operational resilience and regulatory compliance across Citi's global markets footprint.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design and implement high-throughput Python backend services and SQL pipelines to ingest and process large volumes of financial market data, under the guidance of senior technical leads.
* Translate regulatory mandates and market surveillance policies into reliable, deterministic control algorithms and automated surveillance components.
* Collaborate with trading desks, risk managers, and compliance stakeholders to support the modeling of trade lifecycles, order workflows and multi-asset risk analytics.
* Perform application profiling, database tuning, and SQL query optimization to reduce bottlenecks, minimize latency and improve throughput.
* Contribute to Generative AI-assisted solutions and automation patterns that reduce manual operational activities and streamline control testing workflows.
* Participate in architectural discussions, system design reviews and modern CI/CD practices using GitHub and Jira.
* Apply engineering best practices, take part in peer code reviews, follow testing standards and support knowledge sharing within the team.
* Ensure technical deliverables adhere to Citi engineering policies, enterprise security standards and regulatory compliance requirements.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with solid hands-on experience building backend applications and data pipelines in Python.
* Strong proficiency in SQL, relational database design, query optimization, indexing strategies and database performance profiling.
* Working knowledge of Investment Banking and Capital Markets, including a good understanding of trade and transaction lifecycles, order management, execution workflows and market risk analytics.
* Demonstrated experience developing and supporting scalable systems handling sizable data volumes.
* Experience working within Agile frameworks, using Jira and GitHub for version control, branching strategies and collaborative development.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with the ability to resolve complex technical issues and translate business requirements into technical specifications.
* Good communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with both technical teammates and business stakeholders.

**Beneficial Skills & Qualifications**

* Exposure to regulatory reporting or market surveillance platforms (e.g., MiFID II, CAT, Dodd-Frank, MAR, Best Execution).
* Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies (Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift).
* Familiarity with distributed computing or data streaming technologies (e.g., Apache Spark, PySpark, Kafka, Solace, MQ).
* Exposure to Generative AI APIs, prompt engineering, or LLM-driven tooling to automate workflows and extract structured insights from unstructured data.

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent professional experience; Master’s degree preferred.

**What We Offer**

* Hands-on engineering ownership of high-impact systems that help safeguard market integrity and support regulatory compliance across a global financial leader.
* A hybrid working model combining focused remote productivity with in-office collaboration in Pune.
* Access to comprehensive technical training and professional growth programs across Citi's global engineering community.

title: Senior Systems Software Engineer, Developer Productivity and Cloud Automation - GeForce NOW
description:
GeForce NOW is NVIDIA's Cloud Gaming service, streaming games at the highest quality to any and every user, regardless of their device type and capabilities - low-end PCs, Macs, TV or mobile devices. Using the most sophisticated GPUs and NVIDIA proprietary software, GeForce NOW transforms the gaming experience with always up-to-date games on always the latest hardware, a streaming experience rivaling that of a local PC, and near-instant launch – just click and play! For more details, see http://www.geforce.com/geforce-now .
  
  
Our mission empowers every GeForce NOW engineer to deliver confidently by removing obstacles, catching issues early, and turning deployments into a strength rather than a liability. We handle pipelines using GitLab’s CI platform and Jenkins, along with Flux CD and Argo CD rollouts, StackStorm event-driven automation, HashiCorp Vault for credential storage, and automation across multi-cloud environments. This is the Kubernetes-native deployment platform paired with its automation system and the backend services and APIs that support it. We deliver zero-downtime global rollouts with automatic drift detection. Our reliable staging environments replicate production accurately. We provide cloud automation for bare-metal and multi-cloud environments. If a GFN service ships, runs, or self-heals, you build the infrastructure behind it.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Build and develop backend microservices and REST/gRPC/MCP APIs that power the deployment platform, zone reservation/lease system, and developer self-service tooling
* Extend the platform with dynamic delivery, automatic rollback, drift detection, and automated zone bootstrapping
* Build and stabilize prod-like staging environments/zones so teams catch regressions early
* Develop and sustain GitOps pipelines (Flux CD, Argo CD) across on-premises and Nvidia GFN Cloud/AWS/Azure/GCP
* Develop Kubernetes CRDs and operators in Go for scheduling, auto-scaling, and compliance across data centers
* Build backend integrations and control-plane services connecting CI/CD, observability, and automation systems into a unified platform experience
* Automate dedicated hardware and multiple cloud platform configurations using Terraform, Ansible, and Vault
* Implement monitoring solutions including Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, and ELK, paired with SLO/alerting for early detection
* Integrate automation tools — runbooks, StackStorm bots, anomaly-triggered remediation, and Slack self-service release bots

**What We Need To See**

* BS or MS in Computer Science or equivalent experience with 12+ years of experience in Cloud Infrastructure and DevOps, with deep expertise in Kubernetes, GitOps (or equivalent), and production-grade cloud-native CI/CD pipelines

title: Lead Engineer II – Senior Engineer, Authentication and Authorization IRC302231
description:
**Description**
We’re building the identity and access layer that every service in our SaaS control plane depends on. You’ll own the common auth stack — making sure the right principals get the right access, consistently, across every tenant and product surface.
  
  
**Requirements**
You should have
  
  
– 5+ years building auth systems in production SaaS environments.
  
  
– Strong Go or Python (ideally both); comfortable writing performant, well-tested service code in either.
  
  
– Deep knowledge of OAuth 2.0, OIDC, JWT, and SAML — not just using libraries but understanding what’s happening underneath.
  
  
– Experience with authorization policy engines (OPA, Casbin, or equivalent) and modeling complex permission structures.
  
  
– Familiarity with multi-tenant isolation patterns and the security implications of getting them wrong.
  
  
– Comfort in an AWS/EKS environment with secrets management (AWS Secrets Manager, Vault).
  
  
Nice to have: SCIM provisioning, FIDO2/WebAuthn, zero-trust networking, SOC 2 audit experience, or prior work on a shared platform team serving internal consumers.
  
  
Job responsibilities
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  
– Design and operate the centralized authn/authz platform: token issuance and validation (OIDC/JWT), OAuth 2.0 flows, API key management, and service-to-service identity.
  
  
– Build and maintain the authorization model: RBAC and ABAC policies, tenant isolation enforcement, and fine-grained permission evaluation (Open Policy Agent or similar).
  
  
– Expose auth as a shared internal service consumed by the rest of the control plane — clean APIs, well-documented contracts, and minimal coupling.
  
  
– Partner with product and platform teams to implement SSO integrations (SAML, SCIM) and onboard enterprise identity providers.
  
  
– Harden the auth layer: token rotation, secret management, audit logging, and threat modeling against common identity attacks.
  
  
– Drive adoption of consistent auth patterns across services, replacing one-off implementations.
  
  
What we offer
  
  
**Exciting Projects:**
We focus on industries like High-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.
  
  
**Collaborative Environment:**
You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!
  
  
**Work-Life Balance:**
GlobalLogic prioritizes work-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
Our dedicated Learning & Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.
  
  
**Excellent Benefits:**
We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.
  
  
**Fun Perks:**
We want you to love where you work, which is why we host sports events, cultural activities, offer food on subsidies rates, Corporate parties. Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!
  
  
**About GlobalLogic**
GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.

description:

**NICE**

At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.
  
  
So, what’s the role all about?
  
  
NiCE is building SPARK, a new internal incubation team that turns great ideas from across CX International into working AI solutions, and then into enterprise-grade tools that roll out to colleagues around the world. We are looking for builders who understand the business as well as the code.
  
  
As Technical AI Architect & Builder, you will design and build the AI solutions that SPARK brings to life. You combine real business knowledge with solid software engineering: you understand how sales, service, support, and operations teams actually work, and you know how to take an idea through the full software development lifecycle to a solution people use every day.
  
  
You will work as part of a small team of senior builders, led by the Senior Technical AI Architect & Builder, with significant ownership of the solutions you deliver. You will partner closely with the Business Analyst and the Project Manager.
  
  
How will you make an impact?
  
  
You will design and build the AI solutions at the heart of SPARK, owning them from the first prototype through hardening and handover, working with the Senior Technical AI Architect & Builder, the Business Analyst, and the Project Manager.
  
  
Design Solutions that Fit the Business
  
  

* Work with the Business Analyst and business teams to understand the process, the users, and the outcome, and shape a solution design that fits how people actually work
* Translate use cases into solution architectures covering agents, retrieval, integrations, data flows, and user experience
* Choose the right approach for each problem, whether that is an AI agent, a workflow automation, a prompt-based assistant, or a conventional software fix
* Estimate effort and flag technical risks early to the Project Manager

Build and Ship
  
  

* Build working prototypes and production-grade solutions using LLM APIs, agent frameworks, and RAG pipelines
* Work with IT to develop integrations, APIs, and services that connect AI solutions to enterprise systems such as Salesforce, Snowflake, Power BI, ServiceNow, Workday, and Microsoft 365
* Apply prompt engineering and context design that deliver reliable results, and iterate on user feedback
* Write clean, tested, documented code and keep it in well-organised shared repositories
* Optimize solution costs

Engineer for Quality and Scale
  
  

* Apply the full SDLC to every solution (design, build, test, release, and support), using Git workflows, code review, and CI/CD pipelines
* Build automated evaluations and regression tests so quality is measured, not assumed
* Add logging, monitoring, and cost tracking so solutions can be run and supported in production
* Follow the security, privacy, and responsible AI standards set with the Senior Technical AI Architect & Builder and NiCE’s security teams
* Ensue audit trails are included and follow the discussed solutions on agreed guardrails measure.

Hand Over and Improve
  
  

* Prepare documentation, runbooks, and demos for the Support Helpdesk, the Change Management & Evangelist, and the business teams who will use each solution
* Use feedback and recurring support issues to fix, improve, and extend solutions after launch
* Share patterns and reusable components that make the next build faster

Have you got what it takes?
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience
* 6-8 years of software development experience across the full SDLC, building enterprise-grade, scalable software
* 2+ years of hands-on experience building LLM-powered applications, such as RAG pipelines, agents, tool use, or prompt-engineered assistants
* Proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript, with strong knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, and async or event-driven design
* Solid business knowledge: experience working closely with functions such as sales, customer service, operations, or finance, and the ability to turn their needs into working software
* Experience with at least one agent or orchestration framework (LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, or equivalent) and with vector databases or search
* Practical experience with a major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP)
* Solid Git workflow, code review, testing, and CI/CD practices
* Ability to work with autonomy in a small, fast-moving team with evolving requirements
* Fluency in English

**You Will Have An Advantage If You Also Have**

* Experience implementing MCP servers or clients, and integrating with enterprise systems
* Familiarity with the Anthropic Claude API and tool-use patterns
* Background in CX, contact centre, CCaaS, or enterprise SaaS environments, with exposure to Cognigy or NiCE CXone
* Experience with LLM evaluation frameworks and observability tooling
* Experience with low-code or agent-building platforms such as Claude, Microsoft Copilot Studio
* Experience in workflow applications such as N8N or similar

What’s in it for you?
  
  
SPARK is a chance to be a founding member of a brand-new team, and to shape how NiCE turns AI ideas into everyday tools used by colleagues around the world.
  
  
Join an ever-growing, market-disrupting, global company where the teams, comprised of the best of the best, work in a fast-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! As the market leader, every day at NiCE is a chance to learn and grow, and there are endless internal career opportunities across multiple roles, disciplines, domains, and locations. If you are passionate about AI, innovative at heart, and excited to constantly raise the bar on what intelligent technology can do, you may just be our next NiCEr!
  
  
Enjoy NiCE-FLEX!
  
  
At NiCE, we work according to the NiCE-FLEX hybrid model, which enables maximum flexibility: 2 days working from the office and 3 days of remote work, each week. Naturally, office days focus on face-to-face meetings, where teamwork and collaborative thinking generate innovation, new ideas, and a vibrant, interactive atmosphere.

description:
**Job Summary**
We are seeking an experienced Senior Developer Analyst – Integration Platforms with 8+ years of overall IT experience and strong hands-on expertise in enterprise integration, middleware and API platforms. This is a run-team role that combines end-to-end platform ownership with active participation in platform modernization – including designing, building and migrating interfaces and APIs on SAP Integration Suite, SAP PI/PO, Advanced Event Mesh (AEM/Solace), WSO2 API Manager and Azure API Management.
  
  
The successful candidate will ensure platform reliability, security and governance, while also designing and delivering new integrations, APIs and event-driven flows as part of the SAP PI/PO to SAP Integration Suite migration, API modernization and automation roadmap.

* Monitor platform health, message processing, API traffic, error rates, latency, throughput and connectivity to ensure SLA and availability commitments.
* Lead incident triage, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, problem management and preventive action closure for production issues.
* Drive change, release readiness, planned maintenance, upgrades, patching and post-deployment validation with minimal business disruption.
* Strengthen resiliency through capacity management, performance tuning, disaster recovery testing and operational risk reduction.
* Participate in on-call rotation for critical production issues and planned maintenance windows.
* Interface & API Design and Development (Modernization)
* Design, develop, test and deploy new interfaces, iFlows, APIs and event-driven flows on SAP Integration Suite, WSO2 API Manager, Azure APIM and Advanced Event Mesh.
* Translate business and functional requirements into integration designs – interface specifications, mapping documents, error handling, retry, security and monitoring patterns.
* Lead the redesign and migration of SAP PI/PO interfaces to SAP Integration Suite, including re-platforming, re-testing, cutover planning and hypercare.
* Apply API-first and event-driven design principles – RESTful API design, OpenAPI specifications, versioning, reusable policies, throttling, and publish/subscribe patterns.
* Contribute to reference architectures, design patterns, reusable templates and integration standards adopted across the team.
* Participate in design reviews, effort estimation, solution walkthroughs and technical decision-making with architects and application teams.
* SAP Integration Suite & SAP PI/PO
* Build and support SAP Integration Suite / SAP CPI iFlows, Cloud Connector, Open Connectors, API Management and related connectivity components.
* Develop and troubleshoot SAP PI/PO interfaces across IDOC, RFC, BAPI, SOAP, REST, Proxy, File, SFTP, HTTP and OData based integrations.
* Analyse integration failures, mapping and adapter issues, certificates, authentication, connectivity and performance bottlenecks.
* Partner with SAP application, Basis, infrastructure, cloud and security teams during design, implementation and incident resolution.
* API Management & Event-Driven Platforms
* Own WSO2 API Manager and Azure API Management from a design, configuration, administration and governance perspective.
* Configure and enhance API gateway policies, throttling, certificates, access control, routing and identity integrations.
* Design and administer Advanced Event Mesh objects – queues, topics, subscriptions, broker connectivity and messaging flows.
* Guide application teams through API onboarding, design consultation, operational readiness and production support.
* Governance, Security & Compliance
* Manage environment configuration, user access, role management, certificates, keys, tenant settings and platform-level security controls.
* Support vulnerability remediation, lifecycle management, ITGC/SOX and audit requirements for integration platforms.
* Ensure new and migrated integrations meet design, security, resiliency, monitoring and supportability standards before go-live.
* Develop and maintain design documents, SOPs, runbooks, playbooks, knowledge articles and escalation models.
* Observability, Automation & Continuous Improvement
* Build and enhance monitoring, logging, alerting and dashboards using SAP monitoring tools, Splunk, Datadog, Elastic, Grafana and Azure Monitor.
* Use operational data to identify recurring issues, service degradation, capacity trends and modernization opportunities.
* Drive automation and CI/CD adoption for build, deployment, validation, reporting and repetitive support activities.
* Apply AI-assisted engineering and operations concepts for log analysis, anomaly detection, alert correlation and productivity gains.
* Collaboration, Mentoring & Communication
* Collaborate with application teams, architecture, Basis, CloudOps, ServerOps, security, vendors and business stakeholders.
* Provide technical guidance and mentoring to junior engineers and lead knowledge sharing across the run team.
* Communicate designs, issues, risks, status and RCA findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Demonstrate ownership, accountability and a delivery mindset in complex, high-availability enterprise environments.

* 8+ years of overall IT experience in enterprise integration, middleware, API management or integration platform engineering.
* 5+ years of hands-on experience designing, developing and supporting integration interfaces and APIs in a high-availability enterprise environment.

title: Senior Technical Courseware Developer
description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.
  
  
We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.
  
  
**Role**
We are looking for a Senior Technical Courseware Developer to join our team. This is a Hybrid role, reporting to the Technical Training Content Development Manager in the Product Management department.
  
  
You will design and develop end-to-end learning experiences that turn cutting-edge cybersecurity capabilities into persona and task-based training to drive on-the-job performance. By creating and evolving a blended curriculum across instructor-led training, hands-on labs, interactive eLearning, and assessments, you will ensure learners can confidently apply their skills in real-world scenarios.
  
  
**What You’ll Do (Role Expectations)**

* Drive discovery with SMEs to capture real job workflows, define learner personas, and translate findings into performance-based course architectures, measurable objectives, and detailed design/storyboards
* Create and govern instructor-ready decks and facilitation materials that communicate a clear technical story, include teach/ask/do moments, and improve instructor consistency and delivery quality
* Design and build highly engaging, interactive eLearning at scale—scenario-driven, activity-rich, and modular—while applying strong UX, accessibility, and reusability standards across learning components
* Design lab journeys that mirror real-world tasks, validate labs/demos end-to-end in the product, troubleshoot complex issues, and partner with lab/platform stakeholders to ensure stability, fidelity, and repeatability
* Define the assessment approach for the program and develop objective-mapped items, including scenario/task-based questions and performance checks, validating quality and continuously improving using feedback

**Who You Are (Success Profile)**

* You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.
* You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.
* You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.
* You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.
* You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.

**What We’re Looking For (Minimum Qualifications)**

* Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain
* 7–10 years creating technical learning content across eLearning and instructor-led modalities, with demonstrated ownership of end-to-end programs
* Expert writing, visual communication, and presentation slide deck and Google doc architecture skills, with the ability to craft crisp technical narratives and instructor-ready materials
* Strong ability to ramp up on complex products quickly and convert SME input into persona- and task-based learning with measurable outcomes
* Advanced proficiency building interactive eLearning using Articulate (Storyline/Rise) and/or Adobe tools (e.g., Captivate), including scenario-based interactions and assessments
* Solid knowledge of or strong demonstrated interest in cybersecurity and networking, with comfort discussing technical workflows and terminology

**What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)**

* Demonstrated experience leveraging generative AI tools to accelerate content drafting, storyboarding, and assessment generation while maintaining strict standards for accuracy, confidentiality, and IP protection
* Prior experience designing enablement for cloud security, SASE, or zero trust solutions, translating real customer and field use cases into role-based learning paths
* Certification in Cyber Security such as Zscaler certifications, Cisco, or Juniper network certifications

At Zscaler, we are committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve and the customers we work with. We foster an inclusive environment that values all backgrounds and perspectives, emphasizing collaboration and belonging. Join us in our mission to make doing business seamless and secure.

title: AI Product Engineer- SDE II
description:
**Role Overview**

We are transitioning our organization to an AI-first operational model. We are seeking an
**AI Product Engineer**
to architect and build the company’s central intelligence engine.

In this role, you will be the primary builder of
**automated intelligence systems**
—tools that not only retrieve insights but actively trigger workflows, and synthesize strategic intel across our entire business landscape.

**Role Profile**

This is a high-impact, hands-on engineering role requiring a convergence of three distinct skill sets:

1. **Software Engineering (50%):**
   Building scalable middleware, API integrations, and production-grade applications that connect our data stack to business tools (CRM, Marketing Automation, Support/Ticketing).
2. **AI Engineering (30%):**
   Implementing Agentic workflows, RAG architectures, and LLMs to process unstructured data at scale.
3. **Data Analytics (20%):**
   Leveraging SQL and B2B SaaS metrics to ensure all automation is grounded in accurate, governed data.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Building the "Enterprise Brain" (Architecture & Integration)**

* Develop a unified intelligence layer that ingests signals from disparate sources (Product Telemetry, CRM, Call Transcripts, Marketing inputs) and processes them into actionable outputs.
* Build robust integrations/webhooks to push AI-generated insights directly into workflow tools (e.g., pushing "Churn Risk" alerts into Salesforce

**2. AI Logic & Agent Implementation**

* Architect "Agentic" workflows where LLMs are granted permission to perform tasks
* Implement advanced RAG to ground AI outputs in company documentation, historical data, and strategic context.
* Ensure rigorous evaluation and guardrails for non-deterministic models to prevent "hallucinations" in critical business workflows.

**3. Data Engineering & Governance**

* Collaborate with Analytics Engineers to ensure the underlying data pipelines support real-time or near-real-time AI applications.
* Maintain security and privacy standards, ensuring that AI agents respect data access permissions across different departments.

**Qualifications**

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* **Education:**
  Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* **Software Engineering:**
  3+ years of experience in Python development, with strong proficiency in API development (FastAPI/Django) and building integrations between SaaS platforms.
* **AI/ML Application:**
  Proven experience building applications using LLM APIs and orchestration frameworks, Experience with "Agent" concepts.
* **Data Proficiency:**
  Strong SQL skills and familiarity with cloud data warehouses (Snowflake/BigQuery).

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* **Business Systems Knowledge:**
  Experience working with APIs for major B2B tools (Salesforce, HubSpot, Zendesk, Jira, Marketo).
* **Workflow Automation:**
  Experience with tools like Airflow, Zapier/Make (advanced usage), or custom workflow engines.
* **B2B Domain Expertise:**
  Understanding of the interplay between Sales, Product, and Customer Success.

**Competencies**

* **The "Builder" Mindset:**
  You are comfortable taking a high-level strategic requirement from leadership (e.g., "We need to automate lead qualification") and independently architecting and coding the solution.
* **Systemic Thinking:**
  You understand how a change in product data schema impacts the downstream marketing automation flow.
* **Adaptability:**
  You can switch contexts rapidly—from debugging a SQL query for Strategy to refining a prompt for Customer Support automation.
