title: Quantitative Technology Developer - Python and C++ - Vice President
description:
**The Opportunity**
The Analytical Calculation Engine (ACE) Development Team is responsible for building and maintaining Citi's strategic platform for derivatives credit risk and exposure calculations. The platform supports critical risk management, regulatory capital, and risk analytics functions across the firm and serves as a cornerstone of Citi's Financial Risk Technology landscape.
  
  
We are seeking a hands-on Senior Quantitative Technology Developer to join the ACE team and contribute to the development of high-performance risk analytics solutions. This role offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of quantitative finance, software engineering, and large-scale distributed computation while partnering closely with Quantitative Research, Model Development, Risk Management, and Front Office Technology teams.
  
  
**Your Role and Impact**
As a member of the ACE development team, you will design, develop, and enhance the strategic analytics platform that powers derivatives credit risk calculations across multiple asset classes. You will collaborate with quantitative analysts, model developers, and technology teams to implement pricing and exposure models, improve computational efficiency, and deliver robust risk analytics solutions used across the firm.
  
  
This role combines strong software engineering skills with an understanding of quantitative modeling and risk management. You will contribute to strategic platform initiatives, application modernization efforts, and the delivery of key business and regulatory capabilities
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain strategic risk analytics applications supporting derivatives credit risk and exposure calculations.
* Develop, enhance, and support quantitative technology solutions leveraging in-house Python and C++ analytics libraries.
* Partner with Quantitative Research, Model Development, and Front Office Technology teams to integrate pricing models and analytical enhancements into the ACE platform.
* Contribute to the design and implementation of scalable, resilient, and high-performance calculation workflows spanning multiple asset classes.
* Analyze and optimize computational performance, memory utilization, and processing efficiency of large-scale risk calculations.
* Develop and extend automated testing frameworks, including unit, regression, integration, and performance testing.
* Support software release processes, CI/CD pipelines, and environment management activities.
* Investigate and resolve complex production, performance, and analytical issues.
* Collaborate with stakeholders across Risk, Quantitative Analytics, and Technology organizations to deliver business and regulatory priorities.
* Produce high-quality technical documentation and contribute to development standards and engineering best practices.
* Mentor junior developers and contribute to a collaborative, high-performing engineering culture.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Financial Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline.
* Strong software engineering experience within Capital Markets, Risk Technology, Quantitative Analytics, or Financial Services environments.
* Expert-level Python programming skills with experience building production-grade applications and analytics frameworks.
* Strong C++ development experience, with an emphasis on performance, scalability, and maintainability.
* Experience developing and supporting analytics libraries for derivatives pricing, exposure calculations, or risk management platforms.
* Strong understanding of object-oriented design, software architecture, data structures, and algorithms.
* Experience developing software on Linux/Unix platforms.
* Familiarity with SDLC processes, Git, Jenkins, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing frameworks.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail and quality.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across global teams.
* Proven ability to take ownership of complex deliverables and drive them to successful completion.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Knowledge of Counterparty Credit Risk (CCR), Exposure Modeling, XVA, Market Risk, or quantitative risk analytics.
* Understanding of derivatives products across Rates, Credit, Equities, FX, and Commodities asset classes.
* Familiarity with numerical methods, statistical analysis, optimization techniques, and Monte Carlo simulations.
* Experience working on regulatory initiatives including Basel, Stress Testing, FRTB, CCAR, or Model Risk Management.
* Exposure to distributed computing, high-performance computing, or large-scale analytics platforms.
* Prior experience working closely with quantitative researchers and model development teams.

title: ServiceNow Developer - Officer
description:
****Role Summary & Role Description****
The role is responsible for building, validating, maintaining, and governing end‑to‑end service maps within the CMDB to ensure accurate visibility of business services and their underlying application and infrastructure dependencies. The role supports operational resilience, regulatory compliance (including DORA), incident and change impact analysis, and ongoing BAU governance by ensuring service maps meet defined quality, completeness, and freshness standards.
  
  
This role works closely with Application Owners, SMEs, Discovery teams, ServiceNow Operations, and Governance stakeholders to ensure service mapping data is accurate, auditable, and fit for operational and regulatory use cases.
  
  
**Service Mapping & CMDB Management**

* Create, enhance, and maintain business service and application service maps using ServiceNow Service Mapping and Discovery capabilities.
* Validate relationships between business services, applications, and underlying configuration items (servers, databases, load balancers, networks, cloud resources).
* Ensure service maps follow approved mapping standards, rubrics, and SOPs.
* Build, maintain, and optimize service maps using a combination of pattern based (top-down) and automated discovery techniques (e.g. Tag based), starting from defined application entry points (URL, IP, load balancer) and leveraging ML assisted, traffic based dependency detection to automatically identify, validate, and maintain accurate end to end service relationships across applications and infrastructure.
* Identify and remediate gaps such as missing relationships, incorrect dependency paths, stale or orphaned CIs.
* Coordinate with Discovery and Infrastructure teams to resolve discovery gaps, CI inaccuracies, and integration issues.
* Perform map validation sessions with Application Owners and SMEs to confirm technical and business accuracy.
* Support iterative refinement cycles and health reviews of service maps.
* Monitor data freshness, CI health, and mapping quality metrics.

**Governance, BAU, Compliance & Automation**

* Support BAU service mapping governance, including tier based recertification cycles and evidence collection.
* Track exceptions, remediation actions, and stakeholder responses related to service map validation.
* Maintain audit ready documentation and evidence to support regulatory and internal control requirements (e.g., DORA).
* Contribute to KPI reporting, dashboards, and management updates on mapping coverage and quality.
* Contribute to ITAM automation by identifying repeatable asset management tasks and supporting automation enhancements that improve data accuracy, lifecycle visibility, and operational efficiency across the asset estate.
* Collaborate cross functionally to identify, prioritize, and deliver automation enhancements, ensuring solutions are scalable, platform aligned, and support BAU efficiency, governance, and audit readiness.

****Core/Must Have Skills****
Strong understanding of Service Mapping concepts, CMDB, and dependency mapping.
  
  
8-14 years hands‑on experience with ServiceNow (Service Mapping, Discovery, CMDB).
  
  
Experience with tag-based service mapping and meta data driven mapping approaches, particularly in cloud environments.
  
  
Understanding of IT infrastructure components (servers, databases, networks, cloud services).
  
  
Familiarity with ITSM processes (Incident, Change, Problem).
  
  
****Good To Have Skills****
ServiceNow Certification (CSA, CIS.SM)
  
  
Familiarity with improving mapping outcomes through pattern optimization or extension concepts (where applicable)
  
  
Understanding of MID Server setup, health monitoring, and discovery troubleshooting.
  
  
**Work Schedule**
Hybrid
  
  
**Keywords (If any)**
Service mapping, CMDB, ServiceNow Discovery
  
  
**Location**
Hyderabad, Bangalore, Pune

title: Senior System Security Software Engineer
description:
NVIDIA is seeking a highly motivated, creative system software engineer with strong embedded, kernel/driver, and security experience to join the GPU Software team in Pune, Maharashtra. As someone who is hardworking and passionate about their work, you will design and build key security features and verification strategies for NVIDIA GPUs. You should demonstrate the ability to excel in an environment with complex, multifaceted software and hardware designs.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Define, design, develop and verify security and platform features for next-gen RISCV and other in-house controllers on NVIDIA GPUs, collaborating closely with hardware, firmware and system software teams.
* Perform security analysis and hardening of various firmware & middleware (threat modeling, code reviews, static/dynamic analysis, fuzzing, negative testing).
* Follow the devices from inception through silicon bring‑up and production into desktops, notebooks, workstations, data centers, and gaming console products that are used throughout the world.
* Use pre‑silicon modeling, simulation and emulation to validate system and security properties early, de‑risk bring‑up, and shift‑left defect discovery.
* Multiple opportunities to collaborate and communicate effectively with distributed teams across time zones.
* Use AI‑assisted tools to improve development, review, and testing efficiency while staying aligned with NVIDIA security and coding best practices.

**What We Need To See**

* B.Tech./B.E. degree or higher (Computer science or related) or equivalent experience.
* 4+ yrs of relevant software development experience, especially with embedded systems and/or kernel/driver stack.
* Strong interest and background in software and hardware security, with hands‑on experience building or maintaining security‑relevant features.
* Excellent C programming skills and experience with low‑level, resource‑constrained or real‑time environments (bare‑metal or RTOS) and device driver or BSP development.
* Solid understanding of computer architecture and SoC fundamentals (caches, buses, MMUs, memory controllers, DMA, interrupt controllers, security islands, fuses).
* Experience with complex system‑level debugging (cross‑component issues involving firmware, drivers, and hardware).
* Comfortable using AI tools for development, code reviews, and testing in a secure and responsible way.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to drive designs and reviews across teams.

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Experience with RISC‑V architecture, low‑level BSP / firmware bring‑up, toolchains, and/or on‑chip security controllers.
* Strong understanding of hardware security, applied cryptography, and secure coding practices, especially for embedded controllers and firmware.
* Hands-on work with secure boot, code integrity and confidentiality, TEEs, keys provisioning/rotation.
* Experience with simulation/emulation and silicon bring‑up for security or control processors (FPGA prototyping, virtual platforms, QEMU/PQEMU, emulators).
* Familiarity with security verification techniques: fuzzing, fault‑injection, coverage‑driven security testing, negative testing, or formal methods for security properties.

Widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. As you plan your future, see what we can offer to you and your family www.nvidiabenefits.com

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**About the Role**

**We need a hands-on technical manager to own our API, integration and tracking work and to guide a small development team. You will build and fix things yourself, and you will also review developers’ work and unblock them. This is not a purely managerial role.**

**What You’ll Do**

1. **APIs & Webhooks:**
   Build, integrate and maintain REST APIs and webhooks. Handle authentication (API keys, OAuth 2.0, JWT). Troubleshoot failed API calls, data mismatches and integration errors.
2. **CRM & Data Integrations:**
   Connect websites, landing pages, CRMs and internal systems. Sync lead creation, status updates and conversion events between systems without duplicates.
3. **Marketing Tracking:**
   Implement and debug Meta Pixel and CAPI, Google Ads conversion and offline conversion tracking, GA4, GTM, server-side tracking, GCLID/FBCLID and UTM capture. Send lead status and revenue values back to ad platforms.
4. **Server, Cloud & Database:**
   Manage deployments, hosting, DNS, SSL, Cloudflare and cloud servers (AWS/GCP/Azure). Monitor uptime and logs, and work with SQL/NoSQL databases.
5. **Team & Delivery:**
   Review code and implementation quality, allocate tasks, track delivery, keep documentation up to date, and be the escalation point for complex technical issues.

**Must-Have (Mandatory)**

* 5–7 years of backend development experience (Node.js, PHP/Laravel, Python or Java/.NET)
* REST API development and third-party API integration
* Webhook implementation
* CRM integration experience
* Meta CAPI and Google Ads conversion/offline conversion integration
* GTM and GA4
* Server-side tracking
* Linux/cloud server and deployment knowledge
* MySQL/PostgreSQL (MongoDB is a plus)
* Experience reviewing or managing developers (even a small team)
* Strong troubleshooting skills

**Good to Have (Bonus)**

* AWS/GCP certification
* Docker, CI/CD and DevOps exposure
* Affiliate/postback and S2S tracking
* WhatsApp or communication API experience
* Fintech, e-commerce or ad-tech background
* Experience with high-volume lead and conversion data
* Experience building internal automation

**Qualification:**
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering or a related field (preferred).

**Success in This Role Means**

* Reliable APIs and webhooks with few integration failures
* Accurate conversion tracking and attribution
* Stable production systems and good uptime
* On-time delivery by the development team
* Fast resolution of critical technical issues

title: Senior Software Engineer- Cloud Infrastructure, Kubernetes, Golang/Python
description:
**About The Job**
The Red Hat Engineering team is looking for a talented and versatile Senior Software Engineer.
  
  
Our mission is to deliver a next generation platform for building, testing and releasing artifacts to deliver Red Hat products and services using open hybrid cloud technologies while focusing on innovation and security.
  
  
In this role, you will be instrumental in developing the next-gen productization pipeline, optimizing our systems, and ensuring a seamless user experience in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
  
  
This position requires a proactive problem solver who is passionate about delivering high-quality solutions and continuously improving our systems.
  
  
You will work with Red Hat’s latest open source technologies, such as Kubernetes, Tekton, ArgoCD, Terraform and OpenShift. You will also work closely with Red Hat’s leading product development teams, QE, SRE, product management, and other stakeholders worldwide, working with a stable team in an agile environment to deliver services for Red Hat teams and customers.
  
  
**What you will do?**

* Design, develop, and implement new features based on evolving business requirements.
* Collaborate with product managers and stakeholders to understand user needs and translate them into technical solutions.
* Investigate, diagnose, and resolve software defects.
* Ensure that all code changes maintain or improve system stability and performance.
* Assist users by troubleshooting issues and providing technical support when needed.
* Gather user feedback and suggest improvements to enhance user experience.
* Monitor system performance and implement optimizations to improve efficiency and scalability.
* Conduct code reviews and refactor existing code to maintain code quality and performance.
* Deploy changes to staging and production environments following established processes and best practices.
* Collaborate with DevOps to ensure smooth and reliable operation of software in production.
* Stay updated with industry trends and technologies to bring innovative ideas to the team.
* Contribute to the improvement of internal processes, tools, and standards.
* Work with open source communities such as Tekton and Kubernetes and submitting code in these upstream communities for review
* Work in a global team, including teams in EMEA, NA, and APAC
* Work with developers, quality engineers, PMs, SRE and customers
* Learn about the latest AI tools and how to apply them to solve existing problems

**What you will bring?**

* Ability to work with new and fast-changing technologies with a high level of uncertainty, reacting to changes in requirements quickly
* Strong problem-solving skills, with a passion for learning and adapting to new challenges.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer science or equivalent working experience
* At least 5 years of experience writing code in Golang, JAVA, or Python
* Experience working on shared codebases using source control management (SCM) systems like GitHub or GitLab
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and ability to work effectively in a team-oriented environment.
* Experience working with Linux as a developer
* Experience with building & debugging applications on Kubernetes clusters
* Experience building and running containerized applications and controllers
* Experience with cloud-based infrastructure (e.g., AWS) and microservices architecture

**The Following Is Considered a Plus**

* Experience with IBM cloud
* Experience in Terraform
* Experience in Tekton or ArgoCD
* Experience building CICD pipelines
* Experience in Observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk
* Experience in Open Source development
* Experience defining requirements between application components
* Experience in DevSecOps or Product Security
* Experience with Operator Lifecycle Manager (OLM)

**About Red Hat**
Red Hat is the world’s leading provider of enterprise open source software solutions, using a community-powered approach to deliver high-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies. Spread across 40+ countries, our associates work flexibly across work environments, from in-office, to office-flex, to fully remote, depending on the requirements of their role. Red Hatters are encouraged to bring their best ideas, no matter their title or tenure. We're a leader in open source because of our open and inclusive environment. We hire creative, passionate people ready to contribute their ideas, help solve complex problems, and make an impact.
  
  
**Inclusion at Red Hat**
Red Hat’s culture is built on the open source principles of transparency, collaboration, and inclusion, where the best ideas can come from anywhere and anyone. When this is realized, it empowers people from different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences to come together to share ideas, challenge the status quo, and drive innovation. Our aspiration is that everyone experiences this culture with equal opportunity and access, and that all voices are not only heard but also celebrated. We hope you will join our celebration, and we welcome and encourage applicants from all the beautiful dimensions that compose our global village.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Policy (EEO)**
Red Hat is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We review applications for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law.
  
  
Red Hat does not seek or accept unsolicited resumes or CVs from recruitment agencies. We are not responsible for, and will not pay, any fees, commissions, or any other payment related to unsolicited resumes or CVs except as required in a written contract between Red Hat and the recruitment agency or party requesting payment of a fee.
  
  
Red Hat supports individuals with disabilities and provides reasonable accommodations to job applicants. If you need assistance completing our online job application, email application-assistance@redhat.com. General inquiries, such as those regarding the status of a job application, will not receive a reply.

title: Principal Staff Software Engineer
description:
**Organization Overview**
****Company Description****
QAD is building a world-class SaaS company, and we are growing. We are looking for talented individuals who want to join us on our mission to help solve relevant real-world problems in manufacturing and the supply chain. This hybrid position requires candidates to be based in Pune with 3-4 days of in-office collaboration per week.
  
  
****Job Description****
**Help us build the "System of Action" that supercharges global manufacturing teams.**
QAD is entering a high-velocity GTC to architect the world’s first AI-native, agentic Supply Chain. We are moving beyond legacy "systems of record" to build an autonomous platform where humans and AI work as a tag team to redefine how factories operate. Join us at this pivotal moment to build our next generation platform, lead the next generation of the GTC and turn global speed into strategy.
  
  
****Job Description****
**Ignite Your Future: Strategic Leadership**
Are you a distinguished technical leader ready to own the cross-stack architectural vision for an intelligent, adaptive SaaS platform? Sitting directly above our Senior Staff Engineering roles, you will serve as the chief technical authority for our full stack systems. At QAD, we are redefining the supply chain through a single System of Action that connects people, processes, and data. As a Full Stack Technical Architect, you will bridge high-level strategy with hands-on execution—driving architecture across frontend, backend, microservices, and cloud infrastructure while setting technical standards across engineering teams.
  
  
**The Mission: Defining the Platform's Future**
You Will Be The Executive Driver In Setting The Technical North Star For The Platform, Translating The Company's Business Strategy Into a Multi-year Engineering Roadmap, And Ensuring Architectural Alignment Across All Product Pillars. You Will Lead And MentorPrincipal-level Engineers, Leverage Executive-level Expertise In Highly Specialized Fields To Innovate At Scale, And Govern The Development Standards For Cloud-native Architectures, Microservices, And Agile Product Development Across All Teams. You Will Be Instrumental In Ensuring The Platform Delivers On Its Core Pillars:
  
  

* Adaptive Applications: The intelligent backbone powering the manufacturing enterprise.
* Champion AI: Agentic AI for manufacturing that drives measurable productivity and growth.

****Your Impact/ What You Will Be Doing:****

* End-to-End System Architecture: Define, govern, and execute the multi-year technical vision and architectural roadmap across the complete application lifecycle—from modern frontends to resilient backend microservices.
* Full Stack Standards & Governance: Establish and enforce enterprise-wide design patterns, API contracts, micro-frontend/microservices blueprints, and code governance standards.
* Hands-on Technical Leadership: Conduct deep design reviews, author architectural decision records (ADRs), resolve systemic performance bottlenecks, and write critical reference code.
* Next-Gen AI & Platform Integration: Architect robust full stack frameworks that support Adaptive Applications and Agentic AI workflows embedded directly into user-facing enterprise applications.
* Cross-Functional & Strategic Alignment: Collaborate with Product Leadership, Engineering Directors, DevOps/SRE, and Senior Staff Engineers to translate complex business objectives into scalable architectures.
* Technical Mentorship & Elevation: Mentor Senior Staff, Principal, and Lead Engineers, setting the technical bar and driving engineering excellence across multiple feature pods.

****Core Technical Foundations / What We Are Looking For****

* Frontend Architecture: Advanced mastery of modern web frameworks (React, Angular, or Vue.js), micro-frontends, design systems, state management, and web performance optimization.
* Backend & Microservices: Deep architectural expertise in distributed systems, REST/GraphQL APIs, event-driven designs, and runtimes like Java, Node.js, Python, or Go.
* Data & Cloud Infrastructure: Extensive experience with relational & NoSQL databases, message brokers (Kafka/RabbitMQ), and cloud-native architecture (AWS/GCP/Azure).
* Core Engineering & Governance: Foundational expertise in Data Structures, System Design, Security (OAuth/OIDC), CI/CD automation, and high-availability design

****The Mindset:****

* Strategic Visionary: Strong conceptual and strategic thinking to understand the most advanced issues and implications, applying this knowledge to define and execute the future direction of the platform. Exercises independent executive judgment in setting organization-wide methods and evaluation criteria.
* Organizational Leader: Demonstrates end-to-end responsibility for the architectural and organizational health of the entire function. Capable of driving complex, multi-year solutions and influencing critical company-wide technology choices.
* Adaptability & Innovation: Eagerness to rapidly assess and strategically adopt cutting-edge technologies that create a competitive advantage.
* Proactive Executive: Takes initiative to anticipate future organizational, technical, and business needs, risks, or improvements without explicit direction, establishing new executive standards where necessary.

****Qualifications****
**Qualifications**
****Qualifications & Next Steps****

* Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Experience: 14+ years of hands-on software development experience, including 5+ years acting as a Technical Architect or System Architect overseeing multi-team systems.
* Location: On-site technical leadership role based in Pune (3–4 days in-office per week).

****Additional Information****

* Your health and well being are important to us at QAD. We provide programs that help you strike a healthy work-life balance.
* Opportunity to join a growing business, launching into its next phase of expansion and transformation.
* Collaborative culture of smart and hard-working people who support one another to get the job done.
* An atmosphere of growth and opportunity, where idea-sharing is always prioritized over level or hierarchy.
* Compensation packages based on experience and desired skill set

****About QAD:****
QAD | Redzone is redefining manufacturing and supply chains through its intelligent, adaptive platform that connects people, processes, and data into a single System of Action. With three core pillars — Redzone (frontline empowerment), Adaptive Applications (the intelligent backbone), and Champion AI (Agentic AI for manufacturing) — QAD | Redzone helps manufacturers operate with Champion Pace, achieving measurable productivity, resilience, and growth in just 90 days.
  
  
QAD is committed to ensuring that every employee feels they work in an environment that values their contributions, respects their unique perspectives and provides opportunities for growth regardless of background. QAD’s DEI program is driving higher levels of diversity, equity and inclusion so that employees can bring their whole self to work.
  
  
We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any other federal, state or local protected class.

title: Salesforce Developer
description:
**About Mindstix Software Labs**

Mindstix accelerates digital transformation for the world's leading brands. We are a team of passionate innovators specialized in Product Engineering, Cloud Engineering, DevOps, Data Science and Digital Experiences.

Our UX studio and modern-stack engineers deliver world-class products for our global customers, including Fortune 500 enterprises and Silicon Valley startups. Our work impacts a diverse set of industries such as eCommerce, Luxury Retail, SaaS, Consumer Tech, Health Tech, and Hospitality.

A fast-moving open culture powered by curiosity and craftsmanship. A team committed to bold thinking and innovation at the very intersection of business, technology, and design. That’s our DNA.

Mindstix is looking for Salesforce developers. As a member of the Salesforce team, you will have an opportunity to work on leading-edge CRM platforms like Salesforce and Commerce Cloud.

**Roles and responsibilities:**

Mindstix is looking for a passionate and experienced
**Senior Salesforce Engineer**
to join our growing engineering team. The ideal candidate will have extensive hands-on experience in Salesforce development within complex enterprise environments and a strong understanding of scalable application architecture and platform best practices.

As a Senior Salesforce Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining robust Salesforce solutions while collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality applications.

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable Salesforce solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and Salesforce platform capabilities.
* Build and optimize Apex triggers, controllers, batch processes, and asynchronous processing solutions.
* Develop reusable and maintainable Lightning Web Components with clear component hierarchies and event-driven communication patterns.
* Design and implement automation strategies using Flows and Apex while ensuring scalability and maintainability.
* Analyze and resolve performance bottlenecks and governor limit issues in high-volume Salesforce environments.
* Design and implement integrations using REST/SOAP APIs, Named Credentials, and asynchronous integration patterns.
* Work closely with product owners, architects, and engineering teams to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
* Participate in code reviews, mentor junior developers, and promote engineering best practices across the team.
* Implement secure and scalable solutions while adhering to Salesforce security best practices, including OWD, Sharing Rules, and Field-Level Security.
* Collaborate with DevOps teams and manage deployments using Git-based workflows and CI/CD pipelines.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex production issues while ensuring system reliability and performance.
* Continuously evaluate and improve existing Salesforce implementations and automation strategies.

**Qualifications and Skills**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Minimum of
  **7+ years**
  of hands-on experience in Salesforce development, with significant experience in enterprise Salesforce environments.
* Strong expertise in:
* Apex Development (Triggers, Controllers, Batch Apex, Asynchronous Processing)
* Lightning Web Components (LWC)
* Salesforce Flows and Automation Architecture
* Salesforce Platform Events and Bulk API
* Salesforce Security Model
* REST/SOAP Integrations and Named Credentials
* Strong understanding of Salesforce order of execution, recursion handling, and scalable automation design patterns.
* Hands-on experience with Git, including branching, merging, conflict resolution, and pull request workflows.
* Experience with deployment tools such as Copado, Gearset, or Sourcetree is preferred.
* Experience with Salesforce DX, Scratch Orgs, Connected Apps, and OAuth is an added advantage.
* Strong understanding of testing methodologies, test data setup, and code quality practices.
* Experience working in Agile and Scrum environments.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

**Who Fits Best?**

* You have worked in complex enterprise Salesforce environments and have successfully improved existing systems and processes.
* You take ownership of technical decisions and proactively address scalability and maintainability concerns.
* You are passionate about writing clean, reusable, and high-quality code.
* You enjoy mentoring team members and contributing to engineering excellence.
* You are a self-motivated, detail-oriented professional who thrives in a collaborative environment.
* You possess strong verbal and written communication skills and can effectively work with global teams and stakeholders.

**Benefits**

An opportunity to work in a competitive environment with top-tier engineers in your industry. Flexible working environment, competitive compensation and perks, health insurance coverage, rewards and recognition, accelerated career planning. An opportunity to build products and solutions at a truly global scale.

**Location**

This position is primarily based at our Pune (India) headquarters, requiring all potential hires to work from this location. A modern workplace is deeply collaborative by nature, while also demanding a touch of flexibility. We embrace deep collaboration at our offices with reasonable flexi-timing and hybrid options to our seasoned team members.

*not*

description:

is an industry leader in data-driven, client-to-cloud networking for large data center, campus and routing environments. Arista is a well-established and profitable company with over $5 billion in revenue. Arista’s award-winning platforms, ranging in Ethernet speeds up to 800G bits per second, redefine scalability, agility, and resilience. Arista is a founding member of the Ultra Ethernet consortium. We have shipped over 20 million cloud networking ports worldwide with CloudVision and EOS, an advanced network operating system. Arista is committed to open standards, and its products are available worldwide directly and through partners.

At Arista, we value the diversity of thought and perspectives each employee brings. We believe fostering an inclusive environment where individuals from various backgrounds and experiences feel welcome is essential for driving creativity and innovation.

Our commitment to excellence has earned us several prestigious awards, such as the Great Place to Work Survey for Best Engineering Team and Best Company for Diversity, Compensation, and Work-Life Balance. At Arista, we take pride in our track record of success and strive to maintain the highest quality and performance standards in everything we do.

**Who You’ll Work With**

As a software engineer at Arista, you own your project end to end. You and your project team will work with product management and customers to define the requirements and design the architecture. You’ll build the backend, write automated tests, and get it deployed into production via our CD pipeline. As a senior member of the team you’ll also be expected to help mentor and grow new team members. This role demands a strong and broad software engineering background, and you won’t be limited to any single aspect of the product or development process.

The candidate will be working with the WiFi team at Arista, developing cutting edge and next generation WiFi solutions in a fast-paced environment. The WiFi team is responsible for the end to end development of the Cloud managed WiFi product portfolio of Arista. This specific position is for the WiFi AccessPoint team.

**What You’ll Do**

As a core member of the AccessPoint team, the candidate is expected to work closely with relevant teams to understand product requirements, design the solution, build the software and deliver it for final validation and customer deployment. **Role Overview**
We are looking for an experienced Power BI Developer with 3–8 years of experience in Business Intelligence, reporting, analytics and Power BI development.
  
  
The candidate will be responsible for designing and developing scalable Power BI dashboards, reports, semantic models and KPIs, while also supporting Power BI administration and day-to-day operations. * Design, develop and maintain interactive Power BI dashboards, reports and scorecards.

* Configure and support data gateways, refresh schedules, user access and security groups.

* Maintain technical documentation, SOPs and knowledge-base articles.
* Collaborate with Data Engineering, Analytics and business teams to ensure reliable end-to-end BI solutions.
* Follow organizational security, governance and development standards and ensure alignment with ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 requirements.

**Technical Skills & Certifications: Essential Skills**

* 5–8 years of experience in BI, Analytics or Data & Reporting solutions.
* Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Power BI Desktop and Power BI Service.
* Advanced proficiency in DAX and Power Query (M).
* Strong experience in data modelling, Star Schema and Snowflake Schema.
* Strong SQL skills and experience working with relational and analytical data sources.
* Experience integrating Power BI with SQL Server, Azure SQL, Databricks, Excel and SharePoint.
* Experience managing workspaces, gateways, semantic models/datasets, dataflows and deployment pipelines.
* Strong understanding of RLS, OLS and Power BI security/access management.
* Experience with performance optimization, capacity monitoring and refresh troubleshooting.
* Experience with production support, incident management and root cause analysis.
* Good understanding of Git, CI/CD and DevOps practices for BI solutions.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
* Good communication skills and experience working with technical teams and business stakeholders.

**Certifications**

* Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300) preferred.
* Relevant Microsoft Fabric / Azure Data certification would be an added advantage.
* Hands-on enterprise Power BI development and operational experience is essential.

title: SAP Fiori ,ABAP-Sr Application Developer - 11257
description:

Posting Start Date: 8/17/26
  
  
At Fujitsu, we've been driven to create a sustainable world through innovation since 1935. Today, we lead in digital transformation globally with our 130,000 employees across 50+ countries. We empower our diverse community to achieve greatness through career development and opportunities. Explore our internal positions and join us in shaping a brighter future. Thank you for being a part of Fujitsu. We look forward to growing together toward a brighter future.
  
  
**SAP Fiori ABAP-**
**Sr Application Developer - 11257**
Job Title: Sr Application Developer - SAP Fiori ABAP
  
  
Experience: 8+yrs exp
  
  
Location: Pune, Bangalore, Chennai, Noida, Hyderabad
  
  
Role Type: Permanent
  
  
Work Mode: Hybrid
  
  
Shift: 2 PM-11 PM IST
  
  
Design, build, and support SAP ABAP and Fiori enhancements, reports, interfaces, forms, and applications aligned to business requirements.
  
  
**Role Overview**
A technical role delivered under a strict clean-core mandate. The program has deliberately constrained its build: 79% of requirements are met by standard configuration, and the WRICEF objects will be gated behind conditions precedent — a validated requirement, a quantified benefit, and confirmation that no standard alternative exists — and extensions are delivered on SAP BTP rather than by modifying the core. This role needs judgment as well as skill: the largest technical risk on the program is over-customization, specifically rebuilding a legacy shop-floor system's bespoke lot-numbering and lot-handling logic one-for-one inside SAP. You will be expected to resist that.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Translate functional specifications from all workstreams into technical designs, honest estimates and clean-core-compliant build approaches; challenge designs better solved by configuration.Develop the report backlog using CDS views, RAP services and analytical Fiori applications in preference to classical ABAP list reports.Develop enhancements using released extension points — BAdIs, key-user and developer extensibility — rather than core modifications or implicit enhancements.Design and build interfaces between S/4HANA, SAP Digital Manufacturing, factory-automation and edge systems and the analytics layer, using SAP BTP Integration Suite (Cloud Integration, API Management, Event Mesh) plus IDoc, OData, REST and file patterns.Build custom and extended Fiori applications with SAPUI5 / Fiori Elements, including shop-floor UIs usable on hand-held devices and gloved hands, with Japanese and English language support.Build the traveler / batch-card print program and forms carrying resolved machine, tool, hardness, mold, cavity and lot detail; implement quality, hold and disposition approval workflows; build the flexible master-data maintenance application if it clears its gate.Build the composite KPI CDS layer and the post-Material-Ledger allocation engine in the agreed architecture; enforce clean-core governance — extension registry, released-API discipline, upgrade-safety review, code review — and document objects so client IT can maintain them.
**■ BATCH MANAGEMENT & TRACEABILITY EXPERIENCE — REQUIRED**
Hands-on Batch Management and end-to-end traceability experience is a mandatory requirement for this role. Batch, lot and cavity-level traceability sits at the center of this program; candidates without demonstrable hands-on experience in the following will not be shortlisted:Batch and classification data structures in S/4HANA — batch master, characteristics and classification, batch determination and status — and how to read, extend and report on them without breaking standard behavior.Batch number assignment: standard internal/external number ranges, the batch number BAdI, and the judgment to say honestly when a bespoke lot-number format genuinely cannot be met by standard next-number maintenance. Replicating legacy lot-numbering one-for-one is this program's largest over-customization risk.Batch characteristic copying and re-derivation on split and merge, including enhancement programs that update collected data each time a shop-floor control number is split.Cavity-level and sub-lot data: carrying mold, machine and cavity identity onto batch characteristics and onto planned/production orders via custom fields, and surfacing it on travelers, labels and packing documents.Traceability reporting: building forward/backward genealogy queries over batch data with CDS, integrating with the Batch Information Cockpit and Global Batch Traceability rather than rebuilding them.Interfaces that carry batch identity — SFC-to-batch one-to-one mapping with the digital manufacturing layer, vendor batch capture, batch data on delivery documents — and the handling of long (up to 40-digit) lot numbers through splits, an open design decision on this program.
**Required Qualifications**
6+ years SAP technical development with 3+ full-lifecycle implementations, including at least 1 on S/4HANA.Strong ABAP OO and ABAP on HANA: CDS views, AMDP, code pushdown and performance optimization; hands-on RAP and modern extensibility (key-user and developer extensibility, released APIs, BAdIs).Demonstrable clean-core delivery: extensions that survive upgrades, and the discipline to refuse core modifications.SAPUI5 / Fiori development including Fiori Elements, annotations, custom controls and launchpad configuration.Hands-on SAP BTP including Integration Suite (Cloud Integration, API Management) and event-based integration; Cloud Foundry or Kyma application development is an advantage.SAP integration technologies: OData, REST, SOAP, IDoc, ALE/EDI, the Data Replication Framework and file-based interfaces; forms and print output (Adobe Forms or SmartForms) for travelers, labels and packing documents.Development against PP, QM and MM/IM/WM with a working functional understanding of what those modules do.
**Preferred Qualifications**
Bilingual English/Japanese (business level); prior delivery in Japan, including multi-language UI and print output.Integrating SAP Digital Manufacturing or an MES with S/4HANA, and machine/edge connectivity patterns (OPC UA; bridging non-standard protocols such as CC-Link via middleware or an edge gateway is a distinct advantage).Analytical CDS models consumed by SAP Analytics Cloud or SAP Business Data Cloud.SAP Build Process Automation or SAP Workflow Management.ABAP Test Cockpit, abapGit, gCTS and CI/CD for SAP.SAP certification in ABAP for S/4HANA, Fiori application development, or BTP Integration Suite.
**Language Requirement — Bilingual English/Japanese Preferred, Not Required**
Fluent professional English is required for design documentation, deliverables and steering-committee communication. Business-level Japanese is a strong advantage — many process owners, shop-floor personnel and legacy-system custodians work primarily in Japanese, and much current-state documentation exists only in Japanese — but it is not a condition of appointment. Interpretation support, bilingual design documentation and pairing with bilingual business analysts are provided, and strong candidates will be considered regardless of Japanese-language ability.
  
  
**Engagement Details**
Full-time consulting assignment across the Explore, Realize and Deploy phases. Hybrid delivery with periodic on-site presence at the Japan sites during validation workshops, integration testing, cutover and hypercare. Reports to the workstream lead, working alongside client SMEs, client IT and the corporate global SAP template and clean-core governance teams.
  
  
**Top 4 Job Requirements For This Role**
**Clean-core development discipline —**
CDS, RAP and released extension points only, with the discipline to refuse core modifications and challenge builds better solved by configuration.
**SAP BTP Integration Suite —**
Cloud Integration, API Management and event-based integration to SAP Digital Manufacturing, factory-automation systems and the analytics layer.
**Fiori and SAPUI5 delivery —**
Fiori Elements and custom applications, including shop-floor UIs usable on hand-held devices and gloved hands, with Japanese and English support.
**Batch and lot data expertise —**
batch classification, the batch number BAdI, characteristic re-derivation on split, and the judgment to resist rebuilding legacy lot logic. Required — see highlighted section below.
  
  
Relocation Supported: No
  
  
Visa Sponsorship Approved: No
  
  
At Fujitsu, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process that values the diverse backgrounds and experiences of all applicants. We believe that hiring people from a wide variety of backgrounds makes us stronger, not because it's the right thing to do, but because it allows us to draw on a wider range of perspectives and life experiences.

* Stay current with advancements in XR, VR, WebGL, cloud technologies, and Unity ecosystems.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and engineering excellence programs.

**Expertise You'll Bring**

* 6?10 years of software development experience with at least 5 years of hands-on Unity development.
* Strong proficiency in C# and Object-Oriented Programming principles.
* Extensive experience developing applications using Unity for WebGL and VR platforms.
* Deep understanding of XR, VR, and immersive application development concepts.
* Hands-on expertise with MRTK (Mixed Reality Toolkit), OVR, Unity XRI, and OpenXR.
* Strong experience designing and developing high-performance interactive 3D applications.
* Expertise in Unity features such as AssetBundles, Timeline, UniTask, TextMesh Pro, and uLipSync.
* Experience building scalable, modular, and maintainable application architectures.
* Strong understanding of networking concepts, REST APIs, WebSockets, and JWT authentication.
* Experience integrating third-party SDKs, APIs, and enterprise services.
* Hands-on experience implementing CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and DevOps tools.
* Experience with AWS services, particularly AWS S3 and cloud-hosted application environments.
* Strong knowledge of Git, Git LFS, branching strategies, and repository management.
* Experience optimizing WebGL applications for browser compatibility, scalability, and performance.
* Strong understanding of VR performance optimization, rendering pipelines, and user experience principles.
* Familiarity with Vuplex WebView integration within Unity projects.
* Knowledge of NUnit and automated testing frameworks.
* Exposure to BrainCloud integration and Amplify Shader development is desirable.
* Experience with debugging, profiling, and performance tuning of Unity applications.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving capabilities.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Experience working in Agile and Scrum-based development environments.
* Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with global teams.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to delivering high-quality software solutions.

* Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company-sponsored higher education and certifications

title: Senior Enterprise Software Engineer
description:
Wolters Kluwer is seeking a motivated and talented DevSecOps Senior Engineer to join our dynamic team. This is an exciting opportunity for an individual with hands-on experience in mature software engineering and a DevSecOps environment to further develop their skills and make a meaningful impact within a forward-thinking organization. As a DevSecOps Senior Engineer, you will play a crucial role in supporting our engineering team, contributing to the development, maintenance, and enhancement of our enterprise cloud platform.
  
  
In this role, you will be responsible for working closely with various stakeholders, including our experienced engineering team, Cloud Operations, Security, Compliance, and other key partners. Your primary focus will be on engineering practices to streamline our software development processes, enhance efficiency, and ensure the reliability and scalability of our cloud platform. You will gain hands-on experience with a variety of DevSecOps tools and application and platform technologies, helping to build and maintain our continuous integration and delivery pipelines, infrastructure as code, and automated deployment processes.
  
  
You will be involved in a wide range of tasks, including application and platform automation, infrastructure management, monitoring, and performance optimization. Your foundational understanding of application and platform engineering concepts, practices, and tools will be critical as you contribute to the implementation of best practices and the optimization of our platform workflows. You will have the opportunity to learn from and collaborate with seasoned professionals, gaining valuable insights and experience that will help you grow in your career.
  
  
As a DevSecOps Senior Engineer, you will be expected to actively participate in the design, development, and deployment of our cloud applications. You will work on projects that require keen attention to detail and a strong commitment to quality. Your ability to collaborate effectively with team members and communicate clearly will be essential in ensuring the successful delivery of our application and platform solutions.
  
  
This position offers a fantastic opportunity for growth and career development within a supportive and innovative environment. You will have the chance to work with state-of-the-art technologies, be part of a collaborative and high-performing team and make a significant impact on our organization’s success. If you are passionate about engineering and eager to take your career to the next level, we encourage you to apply and join our team at Wolters Kluwer.
  
  
**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**

* Support architecture for complex applications ensuring they meet business requirements.
* Implement best practices in coding with support of AI
* IaC-first approach to managing cloud infrastructure using Terraform and an opinionated IaC Framework standard.
* Transform manual processes using automation.
* Perform the deployment, monitoring, and maintenance of platforms.
* Conduct work activities using SRE principles, such as resilience, metrics, capacity planning, toil, Incident management and security
* Manage cloud infrastructure and services in Azure and AWS
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams (developers, operations, QA, etc.).
* Communicate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* Implement and Manage Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines.
* Develop scripts and tools to improve operational efficiency.
* Build and help transform container and serverless architectures, such as AKS (Azure Kubernetes Service), EKS (Elastic Kubernetes Services), Docker and Azure Functions.
* Ensure software and platforms comply with security standards and regulations.
* Implement security best practices and conduct regular security assessments.
* Adhere to access controls and protect sensitive data.
* Document processes, procedures, and infrastructure setups.
* Stay up to date with emerging technologies and industry trends.
* Continuously improve systems, processes, and methodologies.
* Participate in project planning and execution.
* Ensure projects are completed on time and within budget.
* Understand customer requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
* Engage with stakeholders to gather feedback and refine requirements.
* Ensure customer satisfaction through reliable and high-quality deliverables.
* Explore generative AI technologies to enhance software capabilities.
* Deploy AI models for automated content generation and predictive analytics.

**Other Duties**

* Performs other duties as assigned by management
* On call rotation responsibilities with the Service Delivery and Operations Team

**Job Qualifications & Experience**
**Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, or a related field
* Minimum 1 year of experience with AI and Generative AI technologies or equivalent
* Minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience in the DevSecOps engineering discipline, prefer enterprise engineering experience or equivalent
* Experience with Application and Infrastructure Operations
* Proficiency in scripting languages (e.g., Bash, Python) for automation tasks and infrastructure management.
* In-depth knowledge of programming frameworks (e.g., .NET, JAVA) and application development.
* Extensive experience with Terraform for infrastructure as code (IaC) management, including writing and maintaining modules.
* Proficiency with CI/CD tools and practices (e.g., Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions), including creating and managing pipelines.
* Comprehensive experience with cloud platforms (e.g., Azure, AWS), including designing and implementing cloud services and architecture. Azure is strongly preferred.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, evolving environment, ensuring platform reliability and scalability.

**Thought Leadership and Soft skills:**

* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with a willingness to learn and contribute to team success.

Our Interview Practices
  
  
*To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.*
*Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.*

title: Senior Software Engineer (Development & Quality)
description:
**About Kaseya**
Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success.
  
  
Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide.
  
  
Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders - and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe.
  
  
We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in.
  
  
At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it.
  
  
**Senior Software Engineer, Endpoint Agent**
(Development & Automation Testing)
  
  
**Why Kaseya?**
Join a fast-growing company transforming the IT management and cybersecurity industry. At Kaseya, we are modernizing how software is designed, built, tested, and operated by combining strong engineering fundamentals with AI-native development practices.
  
  
You will have the opportunity to shape not only our technology architecture, but also how engineering teams leverage AI to build high-quality software faster and more effectively.
  
  
Join the Kaseya growth rocket ship and see how we are #ChangingLives
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer to help develop and maintain Kaseya's endpoint management agents across Windows, macOS, Linux, and mobile platforms.
  
  
This is a hands-on software engineering role focused on building secure, reliable, and scalable endpoint management capabilities. The ideal candidate is passionate about operating systems, systems programming, device management, endpoint security, and software quality.
  
  
Unlike traditional development environments where quality ownership is separated, our engineers own the full software lifecycle. You will design, develop, test, deploy, and support your solutions while building automated validation alongside the features you create. Successful candidates combine strong software engineering skills with a quality-first mindset and leverage automation to ensure reliability, maintainability, and release confidence at scale.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Design and implement new features for endpoint agents across Windows, macOS, Linux, and mobile platforms.
* Develop software components supporting monitoring, automation, patching, inventory collection, remote actions, scripting, and device management.
* Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code.
* Own features throughout the entire lifecycle from design and implementation through testing, deployment, and production support.
* Build automated tests and validation frameworks alongside feature development.
* Develop automated coverage for functional, integration, regression, resiliency, and system-level scenarios.
* Improve software quality through testability, diagnostics, telemetry, and automation.
* Investigate customer-reported issues and production escalations.
* Perform root-cause analysis and implement preventative solutions to avoid future recurrence.
* Reproduce complex issues across diverse operating system and endpoint environments.
* Improve agent stability, performance, scalability, security, and reliability.
* Develop integrations with operating system management, security frameworks, and device management APIs.
* Build telemetry and diagnostics capabilities that improve product supportability and troubleshooting.
* Collaborate with Product, Support, Cloud Platform, Security, and Engineering teams to deliver customer-focused solutions.
* Participate in design discussions, code reviews, architecture reviews, and sprint planning activities.
* Utilize AI-assisted development and testing tools to accelerate engineering productivity and improve software quality.

**What You Bring**
**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years of software engineering experience developing system software, endpoint software, platform services, or related applications.
* Strong proficiency in C# and .NET, including experience building production-grade applications and services.
* Experience building automated tests and validation capabilities as part of the software development lifecycle.
* Experience developing automated test frameworks and validation tooling using technologies such as xUnit, NUnit, MSTest, Selenium, Playwright or similar testing frameworks
* Experience with Windows system programming concepts such as Win32 APIs, Windows Services, WMI, Registry operations, process management, threading, security models, or related operating system capabilities.
* Strong knowledge of operating system fundamentals, including: Processes and threads, Filesystems, Networking, Services and daemons, Security models, Privilege management, Performance and resource utilization
* Strong troubleshooting, debugging, and root-cause analysis skills.
* Experience developing software that interacts with operating system services, APIs, or management frameworks.
* Understanding of software quality engineering principles, test automation, and CI/CD practices.
* Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as coding assistants, code generation tools, or intelligent debugging solutions.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with RMM, UEM, EDR, XDR, endpoint security, or device management products.
* Knowledge of C, C++, Rust, Go
* Experience with Microsoft Intune, Apple MDM, Android Enterprise, or Linux management platforms.
* Knowledge of PowerShell, Bash, Python, AppleScript, or other scripting technologies.
* Experience building test frameworks, automation libraries, or system-level validation tooling.
* Experience working with virtualization, containerization, or automated device provisioning environments.
* Familiarity with endpoint telemetry, diagnostics, observability, and monitoring systems.

**What Success Looks Like**
A successful Senior Endpoint Software Engineer at Kaseya:
  
  

* Builds secure, scalable, and high-quality endpoint software.
* Owns features end-to-end from design through production support.
* Demonstrates strong ownership of both software development and quality.
* Develops automated validation alongside feature implementation.
* Solves complex customer, platform, and operating system challenges.
* Improves the reliability, performance, security, and maintainability of endpoint agents.
* Rapidly diagnoses issues and implements long-term corrective solutions.
* Partners effectively across Product, Support, Security, Platform, and Engineering teams.
* Leverages AI-native engineering practices to improve productivity and accelerate delivery.
* Continuously grows expertise in operating systems, endpoint management, systems programming, and modern software development practices.

**Additional Information**
*Kaseya provides equal employment opportunity to all employees and applicants without regard to race, religion, age, ancestry, gender, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.*

title: Software Engineer
description:
Join us in pioneering breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.
  
  
Our inspiring and caring environment forms a global community that celebrates diversity and individuality. We encourage you to step beyond your comfort zone, offering resources and flexibility to foster your professional and personal growth, all while valuing your unique contributions.
  
  
Varian - A Siemens Healthineers Company is looking for a mid-level Full-Stack Platform Engineer to build, maintain, test and enhance a containerized deployment platform used in regulated healthcare environments. You will work across the platform and its user interface, supporting reliable operation in both connected and disconnected (air-gapped) infrastructure.
  
  
**## What You'll Do**

* Develop and maintain the platform web application using Nuxt, Vue, and TypeScript, including reusable, accessible, responsive components.
* Implement dashboards and workflows for site status, deployments, packages, health, and operational actions.
* Integrate frontend views with .NET Core APIs over secure HTTP and JSON, handling loading, empty, error, permission, and offline states clearly.
* Contribute to build and packaging tooling that produces the artifacts distributed to nodes.
* Contribute to platform security: TLS certificate management, secret handling, and registry access.
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps (YAML, multi-stage, artifact publishing).
* Write and maintain automated tests across the stack (Vitest, Playwright, xUnit, Pester).

**## Required Skills**

* Full-stack development experience, including .NET Core on the backend.
* Strong experience with Vue.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
* Experience with Nuxt or a similar modern frontend framework.
* Experience building responsive, accessible enterprise web applications.
* Experience consuming REST APIs and working with JSON data and API error responses.
* Frontend testing with Vitest, Playwright, or similar tools.
* Working knowledge of Git, pull requests, code review, and CI/CD workflows.
* Understanding of web security fundamentals, authentication, authorization, and secure handling of sensitive data.

**## Preferred Skills**

* Experience with Nuxt UI, a component library, or an enterprise design system.
* Familiarity with .NET / C# and containerized development environments.
* Linux administration — systemd, networking, and troubleshooting.
* Scripting and automation with PowerShell or Python.
* Exposure to SonarQube and code-quality gates.
* Familiarity with regulated industries (healthcare, defense) — traceability, validation, and change control.

**## Soft Skills**

* Strong ownership and accountability mindset.
* Good attention to usability, quality, security, and detail.
* Ability to work effectively with backend, platform, QA, and cybersecurity teams.
* Ability to thrive in a globally distributed environment.

**Who we are**
: We are a team of more than 72,000 highly dedicated Healthineers in more than 70 countries. As a leader in medical technology, we constantly push the boundaries to create better outcomes and experiences for patients, no matter where they live or what health issues they are facing. Our portfolio is crucial for clinical decision-making and treatment pathways.
  
  
**How we work**
: When you join Siemens Healthineers, you become one in a global team of scientists, clinicians, developers, researchers, professionals, and skilled specialists, who believe in each individual’s potential to contribute with diverse ideas. We are from different backgrounds, cultures, religions, political and/or sexual orientations, and work together, to fight the world’s most threatening diseases and enable access to care, united by one purpose: to pioneer breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.
  
  
To find out more about Healthineers’ specific businesses, please visit our company page here.
  
  
As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from individuals with disabilities.
  
  
**Data Privacy**
: We care about your data privacy and take compliance with GDPR as well as other data protection legislation seriously. For this reason, we ask you not to send us your CV or resume by email. We ask instead that you create a profile where you can upload your CV. Setting up a profile also lets us know you are interested in career opportunities with us and makes it easy for us to send you an alert when relevant positions become open. Register here to get started.
  
  
**Beware of Job Scams:**
Please beware of potentially fraudulent job postings or suspicious recruiting activity by persons that are currently posing as Siemens Healthineers recruiters/employees.  These scammers may attempt to collect your confidential personal or financial information.  If you are concerned that an offer of employment with Siemens Healthineers might be a scam or that the recruiter is not legitimate, please verify by searching for the posting on the Siemens Healthineers career site.
  
  
**To all recruitment agencies**
: Siemens Healthineers does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, employees, or any other company location. Siemens Healthineers is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from individuals with disabilities.

title: Oracle APEX Senior Software Engineer
description:
**Do you enjoy programming and leading a team which builds and supports enterprise applications?**
**Would you like to be part of a successful team?**
**Join our Team.**
Baker Hughes is the leading energy technology company. Our innovative technologies and services are taking energy forward, making it safer, cleaner, and more efficient for people and the planet.
  
  
Our Digital Technology is looking for an experienced Sr Software Engineer to work on several exciting projects that will have a positive impact on our businesses. Our team is responsible for developing and supporting a suite of applications for internal users within Baker Hughes.
  
  
**Join our Digital Technology Team!**
We operate at the heart of the digital transformation of our business. From Digital Engineering to enabling employee success, the Digital Technology team is driven to provide the best products and service. We collaborate with teams to solve complex technical challenges and design future innovations.
  
  
**Partner with the best**
As a Sr Software Engineer, you will be responsible for leading a team of Software Engineers in the design, development, and support of enterprise applications built on Oracle technologies. You will act as the technical leader for Oracle APEX solutions, driving architecture decisions, development standards, and best practices while collaborating with architects, stakeholders, and management to deliver scalable and secure business applications. You will also contribute to the extended Sr Software Engineers community and work independently while providing technical guidance to the team.
  
  
As an Oracle APEX Tech Leader, you will be responsible for:
  
  
  

* Leading a team of Oracle APEX developers in the design, development, deployment, and support of enterprise applications.
* Driving technical excellence, development standards, and best practices across the Oracle APEX application portfolio.
* Acting as the technical authority for Oracle APEX, Oracle Database, PL/SQL, and related Oracle technologies.
* Defining and reviewing application architecture, data models, security frameworks, and integration patterns to ensure scalability, maintainability, and performance.
* Collaborating with Enterprise Architects, Product Owners, Business Stakeholders, and Functional Teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
* Providing effort estimations, technical assessments, risk analysis, and solution recommendations throughout the software delivery lifecycle.
* Designing, developing, and supporting enterprise-grade Oracle APEX applications using UI/UX principles and Oracle best practices.
* Building and maintaining integrations between Oracle APEX applications and enterprise systems through Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), REST APIs, and other integration technologies.
* Establishing and enforcing SDLC standards, Agile methodologies, code review practices, testing strategies, documentation standards, and secure development principles.
* Leading troubleshooting activities for complex production issues, performance tuning initiatives, and root cause analysis.
* Providing technical mentoring, coaching, and career development support to team members while fostering a culture of continuous learning and innovation.
* Driving DevOps and CI/CD adoption for Oracle-based applications, ensuring reliable and automated deployment processes.
* Working closely with cybersecurity and governance teams to ensure applications comply with enterprise security standards and regulatory requirements.
* Monitoring application health, defining operational KPIs, and driving initiatives focused on reliability, performance, simplification, and incident reduction.
* Representing the team in technical design reviews, architecture boards, and cross-functional technology initiatives.

**Fuel your passion.**
To be successful in this role you will:
  
  
  

* Have a bachelor's degree in information systems/technology, Computer Science, or Engineering or equivalent experience.
* Have experience of 5 to 7 years
* Have professional experience as Technical Leader or similar, with deep focus on system design expertise.
* Have Demonstrate the ability to make informed technology choices after due diligence and impact assessment.
* Have extensive experience designing, developing and supporting enterprise applications using Oracle APEX.
* Have strong proficiency in SQL and PL/SQL, including complex query optimization, database object design, and development of scalable database solutions.
* Have expertise in Oracle APEX security best practices, including authentication, authorization schemes, role-based access control, session management, data protection, and secure coding practices.
* Have proficiency in front-end technologies such as HTML, CSS and JavaScript to customize Oracle APEX applications and deliver modern user experiences.
* Have experience integrating Oracle APEX applications with enterprise systems using REST APIs, SOAP services, Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), and other integration technologies.
* Have experience defining application architecture, technical standards, and development best practices for Oracle APEX solutions.
* Have experience leading technical teams, performing design and code reviews, and mentoring developers to ensure delivery excellence.
* Have experience with source control, CI/CD pipelines, release management, and Agile software development practices.
* Have knowledge of Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)
* Demonstrate strong analytical, troubleshooting, and stakeholder management skills in complex enterprise environments.
* Have Demonstrated solid leadership, collaboration, and communication skills with fluency in English.

**Work in a way that works for you.**
We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. In this role, we can offer the following flexible working patterns:
  
  
  

* Occasionally working remotely from home or any other work location
* Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit in everything in and work when you are the most productive.

**Working with us**
Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.
  
  
**Working for you**
Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we must push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect:
  
  
  

* Contemporary work-life balance policies and well-being activities
* Comprehensive private medical care options
* Safety net of life insurance and disability programs
* Tailored financial programs.
* Additional elected or voluntary benefits

**About Us**
With operations in over 120 countries, we provide better solutions for our customers and richer opportunities for our people. As a leading partner to the energy industry, we are committed to achieving net-zero carbon emissions by 2050 and we are always looking for the right people to help us get there. People who are as passionate as we are about making energy safer, cleaner, and more efficient.
  
  
**Join Us**
Are you seeking an opportunity to make a real difference in a company with a global reach and exciting services and clients? Come join us and grow with a team of people who will energize and inspire you!
  
  
The Baker Hughes internal title for this role is: Digital Technology Specialist - Software Engineering
  
  
**About Us:**
We are an energy technology company that provides solutions to energy and industrial customers worldwide. Built on a century of experience and conducting business in over 120 countries, our innovative technologies and services are taking energy forward – making it safer, cleaner and more efficient for people and the planet.
  
  
**Join Us:**
Are you seeking an opportunity to make a real difference in a company that values innovation and progress? Join us and become part of a team of people who will challenge and inspire you! Let’s come together and take energy forward.
  
  
Baker Hughes Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.
