Jefferies is creating a Technology Innovation Hub in Pune, a greenfield opportunity to build the systems that power global markets. As our first India technology center, this hub brings together hands on builders who engineer the platforms behind Jefferies’ growth across capital markets, investment banking, and institutional securities. We’re scaling toward an elite team of 500 engineers while maintaining the agility, ownership, and meritocratic spirit that defines Jefferies. From cloud and data to AI, risk, and core business technologies, teams in Pune will lead high impact work with a global mandate.
  
  
**IT Equities Technology**
  
  
Jefferies’ Equities Technology team builds and runs global, real-time trading and risk platforms across the full equities product spectrum—cash equities, portfolio/algo trading, central risk books, listed & OTC derivatives, convertibles, swaps, and ETF/basket trading. The team supports front-office workflows end-to-end, including order management, quantitative trading, real-time position and risk, AI/ML analytics, trade lifecycle processing, and regulatory/customer reporting.
  
  
Operating in a 24x7 follow-the-sun model across major trading hubs, the India Technology Innovation Hub will be a core engineering center working closely with New York, London, Hong Kong, and other regions to build and enhance high-performance, scalable systems using technologies such as Python, Java, C++/C#, cloud, modern visualization, low-latency messaging, and in-memory data stores.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a technically strong and motivated C# Developer to join the Securities Finance Technology team within Jefferies’ Equities – Prime Services division. You will help design, build, and support strategic trading and servicing systems that power a global Securities Borrowing & Lending (SBL) business. The role involves close collaboration with trading, operations, and technology stakeholders, with opportunities to work across modern cloud-native architecture and high-performance platforms.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain core in-house Securities Borrowing & Lending (SBL) platforms and related services.
* Deliver new features and enhancements across server-side and client-side components using C# and .NET (Core/Framework).
* Partner with developers, product stakeholders, and users to clarify requirements, prioritize work, and deliver high-impact outcomes.
* Build and maintain automated tests (unit/integration) and support UAT/business testing activities.
* Participate in code reviews, contribute to engineering standards, and drive continuous improvements in code quality, reliability, and SDLC practices.
* Support production systems as needed, including troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and incident remediation.

**Required Qualifications**

* Strong proficiency in C#, with hands-on experience in .NET Core and/or .NET Framework (server-side and client-side development).
* Working knowledge of AWS, including EKS, EC2, S3, SQS, and SNS.
* Strong SQL skills; experience with Microsoft SQL Server preferred.
* Familiarity with modern engineering tools and workflows, including Kafka, RabbitMQ, Jira, Bitbucket, and Bamboo.
* Experience using GitHub Copilot effectively within a development workflow.
* Strong communication skills, ownership mindset, and ability to collaborate across teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Prior experience or understanding of Securities Lending / Securities Finance or related products (e.g., Equity Swaps).
* Exposure to Java and/or Python.
* Familiarity with Airflow, Snowflake, and AWS QuickSight.

**What You’ll Bring**

* Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail in a production-focused environment.
* Ability to work effectively in a global team and deliver under time-sensitive business priorities.
* Interest in building resilient, scalable systems for a high-throughput financial platform.

Title and Summary

**Overview**
The Mobile Payment Gateway (MPG) program is part of Mastercard Markets and Localization team, responsible for driving the identification of new opportunities across different markets and building bespoke solutions and integrating with the wider Mastercard products and services.
  
  
The MPG program aspires to be the platform of choice for economies moving into the Digital first world of payments. We are building a solution and an ecosystem to enable the Mastercard multi-rail capabilities into these markets, building a Digital Payment Hub that integrates with Mastercard and Industry Payment processing and management solutions – both in the online and offline world.
  
  
Our positioning puts us right in the middle of 3 key dimensions –
  
  
Integrating with a varied set of global and regional Payments solutions,
  
  
Ensuring Security as we deliver services in both an API-first approach and over mobile platforms, and
  
  
Building an unique customer experience coupled with a set of compelling user journeys, meeting the ever growing and varied Digital financial needs of consumers.
  
  
We are looking for a passionate and skilled Software Engineer with proven experience in building enterprise solutions using Java, Spring, Microservices and Cloud technologies.
  
  
Role

* own it, simplify it, sense of urgency, thoughtful risk taking, unlock potential, and be inclusive – with a relentless focus on our customers.

Design and implement microservices with high quality, secure code that is modular, functional and testable.

Perform assessment of technology frameworks and integration products to meet demand of growing capability and scale.
  
  
Be an active participant of your DevOps team with full accountability of CI/CD, test automation, support and monitoring of functions within a team.
  
  
Adhere to and drive maturity of engineering processes and standards, including change management principles and processes to ensure deliverables meet or exceed defined quality standards.
  
  
Develop own and peers skills and be a mentor to junior peers, to build T-shaped team.
  
  
Communicate, collaborate and work effectively in a global environment.
  
  
This role will also require you to participate in occasional weekend work and on call work.
  
  
**All About You**
Education
  
  
Bachelor or Master's degree in the area of Computer Science or Engineering
  
  
Expertise
  
  
Experience in software engineering majorly in application development
  
  
Expert level skills in Java programming and familiar with secure coding standards (e.g. OWASP, CWE, SEI CERT)

We are seeking a Senior Java Developer with hands-on experience in enterprise-grade financial applications and payment integration solutions. The ideal candidate will be responsible for building high-performing, scalable, and resilient applications. You will play a key role in designing and delivering solutions for mission-critical systems within the banking and payments space. This position involves contributing across the full software development lifecycle — from requirement analysis and technical design to development, testing, and deployment — while ensuring compliance with industry standards for performance, security, and reliability.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Participate in requirement-gathering sessions with product teams and assess the technical feasibility of features and integrations.

* Drive technical design sessions and peer reviews to ensure alignment with architectural standards.

* Work closely with QA and DevOps to ensure smooth CI/CD and release processes.
* Investigate production issues and perform RCA for defects and escalations.
* Continuously improve the system through innovation, refactoring, and adoption of emerging technologies.

* 5-8 years of experience in Java/JEE development with expertise in Core Java, Java EE (8+), multithreading, memory management, and performance tuning.

* Skilled in containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions), and observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, Dynatrace).
* Deep understanding of financial messaging standards (ISO 20022, SWIFT, MT/MX messages, SEPA, NACHA) and payment flows (RTGS, real-time, cross-border), with compliance and security expertise.
* Proven experience in banking/fintech implementations, including reconciliation, settlement, and reference data management.

* Experience working with APIs for real-time and batch payment processing.
* Experience in secure system integration, including mutual TLS and client certificate management.
* Hands-on experience in developing adapters or extensions for products like VolPay or similar integration platforms.
* Knowledge of PaaS platforms (e.g., AWS MSK, Azure Service Bus, Red Hat OpenShift).
* Previous contributions to open-source projects or developer communities.
* Sun/Oracle Certified Java Programmer/Developer is a plus.

✔ Health benefits
  
  
✔ Remote/flexible work options
  
  
✔ Professional development support

Hyderabad / Pune / Chennai

As part of Client Technology, you’ll work with technologists and business experts, blending EY’s deep industry knowledge and innovative ideas with our platforms, capabilities, and technical expertise. That means more growth for you, exciting learning opportunities, career choices, and the chance to make a real impact.
  
  
**EY Technology:**
Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently. We have 250,000 people in more than 140 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. Everything from the laptops we use, to the ability to work remotely on our mobile devices and connecting our people and our clients, to enabling hundreds of internal tools and external solutions delivered to our clients. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and is key to us being more innovative as an organization.

Client Technology (CT) - focuses on developing new technology services for our clients. It enables EY to identify new technology-based opportunities faster and pursue those opportunities more rapidly.
  
  
Enterprise Workplace Technology (EWT) – EWT supports our Core Business Services functions and will deliver fit-for-purpose technology infrastructure at the cheapest possible cost for quality services. EWT will also support our internal technology needs by focusing on a better user experience.
  
  
Information Security (Info Sec) - Info Sec prevents, detects, responds and mitigates cyber-risk, protecting EY and client data, and our information management systems.

description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Software Engineer II (Software Engineer in Test )
  
  
**Overview**
Job Description Summary
  
  
Quality Engineering within Mastercard is about creating an ecosystem where all delivery teams can achieve time-to-market, quality excellence, and higher customer satisfaction within all verticals including core, emerging payments, and value-added services.  Unlike similar quality/testing roles in other organizations, Quality Engineering positions at Mastercard require a firm knowledge and hands on software development skills on par with software developers to work closely them to build test automation, test infrastructure, and perform code analysis/review to enable development quality.  This position will be responsible for driving Quality Engineering best practices within Mastercard and working with teams to deliver applications and solutions that meet the needs of our stakeholders, including consumers, merchants, issuers and governments.
  
  
Questions
  
  
Are you an experienced software professional who is passionate about innovative technology and its potential to help create a world beyond cash?
  
  
Can you plan test strategy and acceptance criteria keeping end customer needs – functional, non-functional, and user experience - in mind?
  
  
Love being hands on and can write code to break software as part of ensuring highest software quality and stability?
  
  
Do you have a motivation to drive quality automation and self-service culture as a part of software delivery practices?
  
  
Can you scale your communication at all levels starting from engineers to program managers to product managers?
  
  
Role
  
  
Play a crucial part in helping drive Quality to help build and ship better products.
  
  
Collaborate with our development teams to enhance our existing software development processes.
  
  
Drive Quality Engineering methodologies and help build high quality software.
  
  
Partner with developers to improve and automate test and release processes
  
  
Help make Quality as an integral part of the development process
  
  
  
  
**All About You**
Must Have skills
  
  
Java, Selenium WebDriver, RESTful services, JSON and XML.
  
  
Unit test frameworks such as Junit
  
  
Git based version control such as Bitbucket.
  
  
Testing frameworks such as TestNG and Spock
  
  
Ability to create acceptance and integration automation tests, integrate with
  
  
Continuous integration (Jenkins/Bamboo) and code coverage tools (Sonar).
  
  
Experience with Linux and shell scripting
  
  
Experience in working in Agile Methodology.
  
  
Experience of working with other developers to ensure that systems are designed for reliability, performance and testability.
  
  
Exposure/ Knowledge in cloud-based applications.
  
  
SQL (Oracle DB)
  
  
Good to Have
  
  
Experience with Maven build process
  
  
HTTP clients such as RESTAssured, OkHttp.
  
  
In Memory Grids (Pivotal Gemfire)
  
  
Knowledge in Digital Native Architecture
  
  
Knowledge in Cloud/micro-services.
  
  
Experience in Integration testing needs with exposure to data virtualization tools.
  
  
Experience testing across a variety of platforms: web UI, APIs (REST and SOAP), Unix (RedHat, Mint)
  
  
Knowledge of payment simulation tools (Paragon, FinSim, T3 or similar).
  
  
Knowledge of ISO payment protocols (8583) desirable.
  
  
**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world.
  
  
**Job Description**

* Financial Planning: Prepare monthly Forecasts & Actuals as well as annual Budgets on various P&L as well as other KPIs lines, followed by system upload and checks.

* Governance and Compliance: Ensure adherence to internal controls & other governance aspects (like updated SOPs, validation checks in reports).
* Transformation: Drive Process improvements, Digitization & Automation to improve efficiency & value-added offerings to stakeholders.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Engage with stakeholders to reflect on different aspects of Delivery as well as People topics, set expectation & future planning.

**Professional Skills**

* Strong working knowledge of accounting concepts as well as Reporting & Analytics techniques.
* Working knowledge of Financial Processes & financial statements.
* Understanding of P&L and various KPI levers impacting P&L.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Office tools, specifically MS Excel, MS PowerPoint.
* Experience of working in a large-scale ERP like Oracle, SAP, HFM is preferred.
* Understanding Internal Control Principles and Processes is preferred.
* Experience of working in Service industry or IT industry
* Data Analytics & Visualization as well as Data Story telling skills is preferred.

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2024 global revenues of €22.1 billion.
  
  
Make it real | www.capgemini.com

title: Senior Application Developer
description:

* Agile Product Ownership, Backlog Management, and PI Planning.

* ISO 20022, SWIFT, CHAPS, SEPA, ACH, RTGS knowledge.

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as experience with, skills to meet business requirement as well as job-specific skillsets.
  
  
This role is based out of Pune.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To design, develop and improve software, utilising various engineering methodologies, that provides business, platform, and technology capabilities for our customers and colleagues.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Development and delivery of high-quality software solutions by using industry aligned programming languages, frameworks, and tools. Ensuring that code is scalable, maintainable, and optimized for performance.
* Cross-functional collaboration with product managers, designers, and other engineers to define software requirements, devise solution strategies, and ensure seamless integration and alignment with business objectives.
* Collaboration with peers, participate in code reviews, and promote a culture of code quality and knowledge sharing.
* Stay informed of industry technology trends and innovations and actively contribute to the organization’s technology communities to foster a culture of technical excellence and growth.
* Adherence to secure coding practices to mitigate vulnerabilities, protect sensitive data, and ensure secure software solutions.
* Implementation of effective unit testing practices to ensure proper code design, readability, and reliability.

**Vice President Expectations**

* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Test
description:
Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) who views testing as an engineering problem waiting to be solved. In this role, you won't just be executing
  
  
tests; you will design, build, and maintain the automated testing frameworks, infrastructure, and tooling that allow our engineering teams to ship high-quality code at speed. You will sit at the intersection of development and QA, operating as a developer whose primary focus is software quality and reliability.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* A minimum of 8 years of work experience is required.
* Automation Framework Architecture: Design, build, and scale robust, maintainable test automation frameworks from scratch for web, mobile, and APIs.
* Code Quality & Testing: Write clean, high-quality automation code (e.g., using Java, Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript) and participate in developer code reviews.
* CI/CD Integration: Integrate automated test suites directly into deployment pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) to achieve true continuous testing.
* Test Strategy & Execution: Analyse complex business requirements, identify edge cases, and design comprehensive test plans spanning functional, integration, regression, and performance testing.
* Tooling & Infrastructure: Build internal tools, mock services, and data generation utilities to unblock the development team and accelerate testing cycles.
* Collaboration: Partner closely with Product Managers and Software Engineers during early design phases to ensure features are inherently testable from day one.

**What You’ll Bring**

* Programming : Strong proficiency in at least one modern language (e.g., Java, Python, C#, or TypeScript).
* Automation Tools : Deep experience with tools like Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, Appium, or RestAssured.
* CI/CD & DevOps : Hands-on experience with Docker, gitversion control, and pipeline tools like GitHub Actions or Jenkins.
* Database & API : Proficiency in querying SQL/NoSQL databases and testing RESTful or GraphQL APIs.
* Mindset : Strong debugging skills, a knack for breaking things, and a "shift-left" testing philosophy.

**Bonus Skills**

* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Performance and load testing experience using tools like JMeter or K6.
* Background in Unit Testing frameworks (TestNG, JUnit, PyTest) and working alongside developers to improve unit test coverage.

**What You’ll Get**

* 18 paid vacation days, plus 4 extra global VeeaMe Days for self-care and 24 paid volunteer hours annually through Veeam Cares
* Private medical coverage for you and up to four dependents
* Life, accident, and disability insurance with enhanced coverage
* Annual flexible wellbeing allowance for physical and mental wellness
* Free confidential counselling and coaching via Employee Assistance Program (EAP), including legal and financial advice
* Meal, fuel, and transportation benefits based on work arrangement
* Daycare reimbursement and safe cab facility for eligible employees
* Opportunities to learn and grow through on-demand libraries (LinkedIn Learning, O’Reilly), mentoring, workshops, and learning events like our annual Global Day of Learning

**Veeam Software is an equal opportunity employer**
and does not tolerate discrimination in any form on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, age, national origin, citizenship, disability, veteran status or any other classification protected by federal, state or local law. All your information will be kept confidential.
  
  
Personal data collected during the recruitment process will be processed in accordance with our Recruiting Privacy Notice, which explains how your information is collected, used, and handled in connection with hiring activities. By applying for this position, you consent to this processing.
  
  
By submitting your application, you confirm that the information provided, including any supporting documents, is complete and accurate to the best of your knowledge. Any misrepresentation, omission, or falsification may result in disqualification from consideration or, if discovered after employment begins, termination of employment.

title: Software Engineer
description:
**Location Name:**
Pune Corporate Office - Mantri
  
  
**Job Purpose**
To develop, configure, test and support secure, scalable and maintainable ServiceNow IRM and GRC solutions for IT Compliance by translating approved functional requirements into platform workflows, integrations, reports and technical components while adhering to coding, security, change and audit standards.
  
  
**Duties And Responsibilities**
Develop and configure ServiceNow IRM/GRC capabilities for policy and compliance, risk, audit, controls, issues, exceptions, evidence, remediation and related IT Compliance workflows based on approved requirements and technical designs.
  
  

* Configure tables, forms, fields, views, UI policies, client scripts, business rules, script includes, ACLs, notifications, scheduled jobs, Flow Designer flows, subflows and reusable actions.
* Build and support integrations using REST/SOAP APIs, IntegrationHub, import sets, transform maps, data sources and approved authentication and integration patterns.
* Convert user stories and acceptance criteria into technical tasks, estimates, configuration or code changes, unit-test cases, deployment notes and support documentation.
* Perform unit testing, peer-review remediation and technical validation; support SIT, UAT, regression testing, defect fixing, release validation and post-production verification.
* Analyze application defects, integration failures, access issues, data discrepancies and performance concerns; identify root causes and implement controlled fixes within agreed timelines.
* Create and maintain reports, dashboards, data checks and scheduled monitoring required for risk, compliance, audit and management reporting.
* Follow ServiceNow development standards, scoped-application practices, role-based access, secure coding, data privacy, audit trail, source control, change management and release governance requirements.
* Maintain technical design notes, configuration records, code comments, unit-test evidence, update-set or application-repository records, deployment steps and knowledge articles.
* Participate in requirement walkthroughs, solution reviews, sprint ceremonies, release planning and continuous improvement, and recommend reusable or low-code solutions where appropriate.

**Key Decisions / Dimensions**
Select the suitable configuration, Flow Designer, scripting or integration approach for assigned tasks within approved architecture and platform standards.
  
  

* Analyze assigned defects and determine whether the likely cause relates to configuration, code, access, integration or data.
* Design reusable scripts, subflows and technical components for assigned requirements while avoiding unnecessary customization.
* Identify technical risks, security concerns, performance impacts, data-quality issues and design deviations and escalate them to the technical lead.
* Recommend technical improvements that simplify workflows, improve maintainability, strengthen controls or reduce manual effort.

**Major Challenges**
Understanding risk, compliance, control and audit requirements and translating them into maintainable ServiceNow configurations and code.
  
  

* Balancing platform configuration and customization while preserving security, performance, supportability and upgrade compatibility.
* Managing dependencies across workflows, integrations, data, roles, notifications, reports and multiple IRM/GRC applications.
* Resolving defects and production issues within agreed timelines while maintaining change controls, audit evidence and data integrity.
* Coordinating with functional, QA, platform, integration and support teams where issue ownership spans multiple components.

**Required Qualifications And Experience**
Educational Qualifications Graduate degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems or equivalent. ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) is preferred; Certified Application Developer (CAD) or CIS-Risk and Compliance exposure will be an added advantage.
  
  
Experience 3-5 years of IT experience with hands-on ServiceNow development and configuration. Exposure to ServiceNow IRM/GRC, IT compliance, risk, audit, policy and compliance, controls, issues or third-party risk processes will be preferred.
  
  
Core Functional / Technical Skills ServiceNow configuration and development, JavaScript, Glide APIs, Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, UI Policies, ACLs, Flow Designer, notifications, scheduled jobs, reports, dashboards, debugging and unit testing. Working understanding of scoped applications and role-based security.
  
  
Additional Skills REST/SOAP APIs, IntegrationHub, JSON/XML, import sets, transform maps, data loads, update sets or application repository, source control concepts and basic performance troubleshooting. Exposure to Automated Test Framework, MID Server, Agile, SDLC, ITIL change/release processes and CI/CD will be an added advantage.
  
  
Behavioral Competencies Analytical thinking, coding discipline, attention to detail, ownership, problem solving, clear documentation, effective communication, collaboration, learning agility, prioritization and timely escalation of technical risks and blockers.

title: Senior Developer (Oracle EBS)
description:
**Job Description**
If you are a
**Senior Oracle EBS Developer**
with deep hands-on experience in Oracle E-Business Suite R12 and PL/SQL development, this role offers the opportunity to make a broad impact as a shared technical resource across multiple business-critical applications, supporting Customer Service Delivery, Product Intelligence, and Learning Platform teams at Emerson. You will own complex EBS customizations end-to-end, bridge Oracle database layers to modern web applications, and maintain enterprise systems that drive global operations across Emerson's network.
  
  
**In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:**

* Design, develop, and maintain Oracle EBS R12 customizations across financial modules (AP, AR, GL, INV, Fixed Assets) and service modules (Depot Repair, TeleService, Order Management, WIP, BOM, CRM Foundations).
* Write robust, well-documented PL/SQL code, including packages, procedures, functions, triggers, bulk collect operations, and dynamic SQL, following Emerson coding standards and best practices.
* Build and maintain Oracle Forms (6i/10g) and Oracle Reports to support business process requirements across multiple teams.
* Register and manage Concurrent Programs, parameter sets, and request sets within the Concurrent Manager; debug failed concurrent requests and resolve scheduling conflicts.
* Design and implement Oracle Workflow and AME (Approvals Management Engine) configurations for business process automation.
* Support and extend EBS module integrations across Depot Repair, TeleService, Order Management, Education Services Administration, and other business-critical applications.
* Expose EBS data to web applications through Oracle REST Data Services (ORDS) and REST APIs, enabling cross-team data sharing across Customer Service, Product Intelligence, and Learning Platform systems.
* Debug production issues, tune SQL and PL/SQL performance using execution plan analysis and index optimization and continuously improve application scalability.
* Manage competing priorities across teams as a shared resource, communicating proactively on delivery timelines, dependencies, and risks.
* Conduct code reviews, participate in agile ceremonies, and contribute to technical design discussions.

**Who You Are:**
You ask the right questions to accurately analyze situations and uncover root causes to difficult problems. You act with a clear sense of ownership and take personal responsibility for decisions, actions, and failures. You partner with others to get work done and create teamwork that allows the organization to achieve shared objectives. You learn quickly when facing new situations and take on the challenge of unfamiliar tasks. You balance multiple demands from different stakeholders without losing focus or quality.
  
  
**For This Role, You Will Need:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 8–12 years of hands-on experience in Oracle EBS R12 development, including active customization and development.
* Expert-level PL/SQL development skills, including packages, procedures, functions, triggers, bulk collect, dynamic SQL, and exception handling.
* Proven experience developing and maintaining Oracle Forms (6i/10g) and Oracle Reports in a live EBS R12 environment.
* Experience in program registration, parameter set configuration, request set design, and debugging failed concurrent requests.
* Strong experience across Oracle EBS financial modules, such as AP (Accounts Payable), AR (Accounts Receivable), GL (General Ledger), INV (Inventory), and Fixed Assets.
* Experience with Oracle EBS service and operations modules, including Depot Repair, TeleService, Order Management, WIP, BOM, and/or CRM Foundations.
* Experience configuring and extending Oracle Workflow and AME (Approvals Management Engine) for business process automation.
* Solid SQL performance tuning skills and ability to work as a shared or cross-team technical resource, managing concurrent priorities across multiple products, owners, and release timelines simultaneously.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to document technical solutions clearly for both technical and non-technical audiences.

**Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart**

* Experience with Oracle REST Data Services (ORDS) for exposing EBS data to external web applications and integrations.
* Familiarity with OAF (Oracle Application Framework) for page personalization and custom region extensions.
* Knowledge of EBS open interface tables and standard Oracle APIs for data migration, bulk loading, and system integration.
* Experience integrating Oracle EBS with middleware platforms (MuleSoft, REST APIs, or web services) as a data source.
* Familiarity with EBS Depot Repair, TeleService, or Oracle Field Service integration patterns.
* Basic knowledge of Agile methodology and experience participating in sprint-based delivery teams.
* Exposure to Oracle ERP Cloud or Oracle Fusion as a point of comparison to on-premises EBS environments.

**Our Culture & Commitment to You:**
At Emerson, we prioritize a workplace where every employee is valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We foster an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectives—because we know that great ideas come from great teams. Our commitment to ongoing career development and growing an inclusive culture ensures you have the support to thrive. Whether through mentorship, training, or leadership opportunities, we invest in your success so you can make a lasting impact. We believe diverse teams, working together are key to driving growth and delivering business results.
  
  
We recognize the importance of employee wellbeing. We prioritize providing competitive benefits plans, a variety of medical insurance plans, Employee Assistance Program, employee resource groups, recognition, and much more. Our culture offers flexible time off plans, including paid parental leave (maternal and paternal), vacation, and holiday leave.
  
  
**About Us**
**WHY EMERSON**
**Our Commitment to Our People**
At Emerson, we are motivated by a spirit of collaboration that helps our diverse, multicultural teams across the world drive innovation that makes the world healthier, safer, smarter, and more sustainable. And we want you to join us in our bold aspiration.
  
  
We have built an engaged community of inquisitive, dedicated people who thrive knowing they are welcomed, trusted, celebrated, and empowered to solve the world’s most complex problems — for our customers, our communities, and the planet. You’ll contribute to this vital work while further developing your skills through our award-winning employee development programs. We are a proud corporate citizen in every city where we operate and are committed to our people, our communities, and the world at large. We take this responsibility seriously and strive to make a positive impact through every endeavor.
  
  
At Emerson, you’ll see firsthand that our people are at the center of everything we do. So, let’s go. Let’s think differently. Learn, collaborate, and grow. Seek opportunity. Push boundaries. Be empowered to make things better. Speed up to break through. Let’s go, together.
  
  
**Accessibility Assistance or Accommodation**
If you have a disability and are having difficulty accessing or using this website to apply for a position, please contact: idisability.administrator@emerson.com .
  
  
**About Emerson**
Emerson is a global leader in automation technology and software. Through our deep domain expertise and legacy of flawless execution, Emerson helps customers in critical industries like life sciences, energy, power and renewables, chemical and advanced factory automation operate more sustainably while improving productivity, energy security and reliability.
  
  
With global operations and a comprehensive portfolio of software and technology, we are helping companies implement digital transformation to measurably improve their operations, conserve valuable resources and enhance their safety.
  
  
We offer equitable opportunities, celebrate diversity, and embrace challenges with confidence that, together, we can make an impact across a broad spectrum of countries and industries. Whether you’re an established professional looking for a career change, an undergraduate student exploring possibilities, or a recent graduate with an advanced degree, you’ll find your chance to make a difference with Emerson. Join our team – let’s go!
  
  
**No calls or agencies please.**

title: Lead Developer- Python, Cloud
description:
REMOTE/HYBRID Lead Developer- Python, Cloud

**About the Role**

We build AI-powered products for startups and scale-ups — from conversational AI agents embedded in enterprise SaaS (legal tech, fintech) to parametric insurance platforms running ML on credit card transaction data. We’re Ignite Solutions, and we operate as the full technology team for our clients: not a dev shop, but a strategic engineering partner.

We’re looking for a Lead Developer who loves building as much as leading. You’ll own technical direction on client engagements, but you’ll also be in the code every day — writing it, reviewing it, and setting the standard for it. You’ll work across domains — AI agents, cloud platforms, mobile apps, and web based apps, and you’ll be as comfortable challenging a client’s assumptions as you are shipping production Python.

**What You’ll Work On**

* Architecting and building AI-native products, agents, RAG pipelines, LLM integrations, agentic tool use — that solve real business problems, not demos.
* Working directly with clients to understand their domain, define the right solution, and set realistic technical expectations
* Recommending technology stacks, cloud architectures, and API designs, and then building them yourself
* Integrating with third-party systems (industry-specific APIs, government data sources, payment platforms, lab systems, and more)
* Leading small engineering teams: hands-on coding, code reviews, mentoring, and day-to-day problem-solving
* Representing the technical capability of Ignite in client conversations, including at founder and C-suite level

**What Makes You a Strong Fit**

*Non-negotiable*

* 7+ years of software engineering experience, with meaningful time in a lead role where you were still writing code daily.
* Deep, hands-on Python experience: Flask, Django, or FastAPI; comfortable owning backend architecture and API design end to end
* Solid experience with one or more major cloud platforms (AWS preferred; Azure or GCP also relevant)
* Proficiency across SQL and NoSQL databases (MySQL, MongoDB; Redis and ElasticSearch are a plus)
* Strong communication skills: you can explain a technical decision to a non-technical founder and a senior engineer in the same conversation

*Strong differentiators:*

* **Frontend architecture fluency**
  : you don’t need to be a frontend engineer, but you understand how modern frontends are structured, what React (or React Native or Flutter) can and can’t do well, where the performance and integration constraints live, and how to make good full-stack decisions with that knowledge. This will set you apart.
* Experience building AI agents or agentic systems (LangChain, LangGraph, or equivalent)
* Working knowledge of LLMs, RAG, prompt engineering, and LLMOps (LangFuse or similar)
* DevOps competence (CI/CD, cloud infrastructure management, deployment pipelines)
* Exposure to ML or data science in applied, production settings

****About Us****

Ignite Solutions is a product engineering firm that works as the embedded technology team for startups that don’t want to – or can’t – build one in-house. Our clients span insurtech, legal tech, fintech, healthtech, and AI SaaS. In practice, we provide fractional CTO leadership, solution architecture, product engineering, AI engineering, UX design, and DevOps — often all on the same engagement.

We’re a small, experienced team. You’ll work on technically demanding problems with real client impact and meaningful autonomy. If you want to be handed a spec and told exactly what to build, this isn’t the right place. If you want to help figure out what should be built, and then build it well, it is.

Staff Software Engineers are the technology leaders of our highest impact projects. * Full understanding of Agile software development methodologies and practices.

* Strong communication skills — both verbal and written.
* Extensive experience working with technologies and concepts such:

title: Software Engineer
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Software Engineer
  
  
**Overview**
This role operates within a globally distributed delivery model, partnering closely with established onshore teams to deliver and maintain high-availability, mission-critical systems.
  
  
The successful candidate will contribute to the ongoing evolution and stability of key payment platforms within a scaled Agile (SAFe) environment.
  
  
Role
  
  
**The Software Engineer Will Be Responsible For**

* Agile Delivery (SAFe Framework): Working within an established Scrum team aligned to SAFe, contributing to sprint planning, execution, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Distributed Team Collaboration: Collaborating closely with onshore engineering teams to deliver features, resolve defects, and ensure seamless integration across the delivery lifecycle.
* Application Development & Maintenance: Designing, developing, and maintaining solutions across a multi-technology stack.
* Production Support & Reliability: Supporting critical live systems, ensuring performance, resilience, and adherence to enterprise standards and controls.
* Continuous Improvement: Contributing to engineering best practices, automation, and process enhancements to improve delivery efficiency and quality.

**All About You**
We are looking for a technically strong and collaborative Software Engineer who thrives in a complex, enterprise-scale environment.
  
  
**Key Requirements Include**

* Proven experience with Java-based backend development and relational databases (Oracle)
* Experience with Spring-Boot framework
* Knowledge of TDD and BDD testing frameworks
* Working knowledge of frontend technologies such as Angular and JavaScript
* Familiarity with SQL scripting and data handling
* Exposure to Devops tooling
* Experience working within Agile/Scrum environments, ideally within SAFe
* Strong problem-solving skills and ownership mindset
* Ability to collaborate effectively across distributed teams

**Desirable Experience**

* Experience with REST, Messaging and Event Driven frameworks/solutions
* Knowledge of security mechanisms
* Exposure to payment systems or financial services environments
* Experience supporting mission-critical, high-availability platforms

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Platform Engineer - Internal Developer Platform
description:
**Your Future Evolves Here**
Evolent partners with health plans and providers to achieve better outcomes for people with most complex and costly health conditions. Working across specialties and primary care, we seek to connect the pieces of fragmented health care system and ensure people get the same level of care and compassion we would want for our loved ones.

We believe that people do their best work when they're supported to live their best lives, and when they feel welcome to bring their whole selves to work. That's one reason why diversity and inclusion are core to our business.
  
  
Join Evolent for the mission. Stay for the culture.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing:**
Why This Role Matters
  
  
Evolent is transforming how it builds and operates infrastructure under a refreshed Platform Engineering & Operations operating model, grounded in four principles: Architecture First, Automation by Default, Reliability is a Shared Responsibility and Golden Paths Over Custom Solutions. You will turn approved designs into provisioned, automated, and documented platforms, and you will do it transparently, through formal handoffs, Office Hours reviews, and documentation your peers can actually rely on.
  
  
**Agentic AI**
: Platform Engineering is moving toward agentic AI as a standard part of how the organization works. As agentic AI transforms the way we work, we expect our engineers to be at the forefront of that change, designing and building intelligent solutions rather than simply consuming them. This builder mentality is a core attribute we assess from the first conversation.
  
  
What You'll Be Doing
  
  

* Provision and change infrastructure exclusively as code, so that every environment is reproducible, reviewable, and free of manual drift.
* Reverse engineer the applications and infrastructure you inherit: trace dependencies, integrations, and data flows end to end until you can explain how a system actually works.
* Design and build agentic AI solutions for platform, delivery, and operations work: identify the toil worth automating, then build, evaluate, and harden the agent that removes it.
* Build security and compliance into the delivery path: least-privilege access, secrets handling, policy-as-code guardrails, and audit evidence produced by design rather than assembled under deadline.
* Independently design, build, and ship platform features, self-service workflows, and APIs in TypeScript, JavaScript, React, C#, or Python, applying modularity, design patterns, and sound software design principles.
* Own your Git and GitHub workflow end to end—feature branches, meaningful commits, rebasing, and merge conflict resolution—and both author high-quality pull requests and review others' for correctness, readability, test coverage, and security.
* Design and document REST APIs, including contract and schema design, versioning, error semantics, and backward compatibility.
* Write unit and integration tests and build CI/CD pipelines as code (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps), with automated build, test, static analysis, and dependency scanning.

To ensure a secure hiring process we have implemented several identity verification steps, including submission of a government issued photo ID. We conduct identity verification during interviews, and final interviews may require onsite attendance. All candidates must complete a comprehensive background check, in-person I-9 verification, and may be subject to drug screening prior to employment. The use of artificial intelligence tools during interviews is prohibited and monitored. Misrepresentation will result in immediate disqualification from consideration.
  
  
**Mandatory Requirements:**
Employees must have a high-speed broadband internet connection with a minimum speed of
**50 Mbps**
and the ability to set up a wired connection to their home network to ensure effective remote work. These requirements may be updated as needed by the business.
  
  
**Evolent is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability status.**
**If you need reasonable accommodation to access the information provided on this website, please contact recruitingteam@evolent.com for further assistance.**

As part of our total compensation package, Evolent is proud to offer comprehensive benefits (including health insurance benefits) to qualifying employees. All compensation determinations are based on the skills and experience required for the position and commensurate with experience of selected individuals, which may vary above and below the stated amounts.

description:

At Netwrix, our mission is to revolutionize data security by placing identity at the core - providing unparalleled visibility and control. Engineered and supported by over 900 highly talented, motivated employees and hundreds of trusted partners in nearly every geography, Netwrix solutions are relied upon daily by security professionals across more than 13,500 organizations in over 100 countries around the world.
  
  
Over the past two decades, Netwrix has expanded its market presence through innovation, organic growth, and strategic acquisitions, and are proud to be backed by renowned private equity firms, TA Associates and Centerbridge Partners. Netwrix maintains a global presence, fostering a remote-first work environment while encouraging and facilitating frequent face-to-face interaction with colleagues, customers, and partners.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Own technical decision-making for the teams you support: evaluate technology options, run POCs and benchmarks, and make evidence-based recommendations on frameworks, datastores, and infrastructure —including partition strategies, migration plans, and performance validation at SaaS scale
* Shape platform-level architecture: Kubernetes (AKS) deployment topology, Kafka-based messaging, durable workflow orchestration, and multi-tenant data models
* Serve as an embedded architecture partner for .NET product teams: review technical designs, code, author/critique RFCs, guide teams through scalability and cloud-readiness problems, and help converge products toward shared platform standards
* Mentor engineers across teams and raise the bar on engineering standards (GitOps, golden pipelines, observability, supply-chain security)
* Assess established on-premises products for scaling, performance, resiliency, code quality, technology choices, supported environments, interoperability, security, and third-party dependencies, and define a realistic migration path to SaaS that does not disrupt on-premises delivery
* Partner with Product Management, Support, and Professional Services to ground architecture recommendations in real customer and field issues, and review findings with those teams before publishing
* Produce architecture artifacts — C4 diagrams, RFCs, design reviews, benchmarks — and present trade-offs to engineering leadership
* Design, build, and improve microservices and backend systems for the SaaS platform using related technologies such as Java, Spring Boot, JDK 21+, and .NET. Follow sound cloud-native development principles, including API-first design, resilience patterns, and comprehensive unit, integration, and performance testing.
* Turn recurring solutions into shared libraries, tooling, and examples that other teams can adopt.

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience
* Hands-on expertise in Java (Spring ecosystem)

* Comfortable reasoning about Windows-centric on-premises products (agents, domain controllers, customer-installed footprints) and the constraints of dual on-premises and SaaS delivery
* Production Kubernetes experience: service design, Helm/GitOps deployment, jobs, autoscaling, multi-tenant SaaS operations
* Comfortable with distributed-data fundamentals: partitioning, consistency trade-offs, high-volume ingestion/ETL, query performance tuning; hands-on with a relational database at scale (PostgreSQL, SQL Server or similar), plus exposure to at least one analytical or NoSQL store
* Event-driven architecture experience (Kafka, RabbitMQ or similar), API-first design, and modern resilience/observability practices
* Good documentation skills — comfortable producing RFCs and design docs and influencing teams you don't manage

****Nice to have****

* Go, Azure, workflow engines (e.g. Temporal)
* Experience with Spring Reactive
* Exposure to identity security, such as ITDR, privileged access management, or identity governance

The Opportunity

At Worldline, our technology addresses the persistent challenges of the payment world. We design and operate leading digital payment and transactional solutions that enable sustainable economic growth and reinforce trust and security in our societies. We are seeking a skilled and motivated Lead Developer to join our team. The successful candidate will be responsible for the maintenance, improvement, and development of features for our existing portal systems.

Experience – 5 to 15 years

Location: Pune, Hinjewadi

Day-to-Day Responsibilities

* Be the ultimate technical owner of what is delivered by your team.
* Represent your team in product and technical design sessions. Including high level estimations and planning.
* Ensure technical decisions are done in a factual manner and in agreement with the governance and architecture principles in place.
* Foster a co-construction culture within the squad and effective collegial technical decision taking.
* Participate in forums with your peers and the architecture in order to improve the development practices within the department.
* Take active part in the continuous improvement of the team by participating in lessons learned or retrospectives. Make sure non functional requirements are discussed upfront and not discovered once in production.

Who Are We Looking For

We look for big thinkers. People who can drive positive change, step up and show what’s next – people with passion, can-do attitude and a hunger to learn and grow. In practice this means:

* Technical Proficiency: A lead developer should have a deep understanding of the technologies used in the project. They should be able to write clean, efficient, and maintainable code.
* Leadership: They should be able to guide and mentor other developers in the team. They should be able to delegate tasks effectively and ensure that the team is working towards the project goals.

* Communication: A lead developer should have excellent communication skills. They should be able to clearly articulate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Problem Solving: They should be able to identify and solve problems quickly and efficiently. They should also be able to anticipate potential issues and take proactive measures to prevent them.
* Collaboration: A lead developer should be able to work well with others. They should be able to collaborate effectively with other teams and stakeholders.
* Continuous Learning: Technology is always evolving, and a lead developer should be committed to continuous learning and improvement. They should be open to new ideas and technologies.
* Quality Assurance: They should be responsible for ensuring the quality of the code produced by the team. They should enforce coding standards and best practices, and should also be involved in code reviews.
* Project Management: A lead developer should have a good understanding of project management principles. They should be able to manage resources effectively, meet deadlines, and deliver projects on time and within budget.
* Ethics: They should adhere to the ethical standards of the software development profession. They should respect intellectual property rights, maintain confidentiality, and avoid conflicts of interest.
* Innovation: A lead developer should be innovative and creative. They should be able to come up with new ideas to improve the product or the development process.

Must have

* Sense of ownership and technical responsibility on the team's software
* Technical expertise in .NET Core and practices surrounding it as well as the faculty to spread them in the team.
* Experience with SCRUM methodology and participation to the back log construction, refinement and sprint planning, in order to help estimate and plan work items.
* Contribution to the development of organizational policies, standards, and guidelines for software development.
* Experience in software designing complex, high throughput, real time and 0 downtime context aligned with architectural guidelines and documented precisely.
* Experience troubleshooting complex systems in case of bug, incident or test result failures.
* Experience with SOA and API contract definitions and preferably in a micro services architecture context.
* Experience with testing techniques and automation such as BDD, TDD, etc...allowing the lead developer to design test cases covering complex or non functional test cases.
* Continuous improvement mindset.
* Experience doing data driven and fact based technical decisions, ensure their application within the team and share the experience with peers in other teams.

Nice to have

* Experience with SQL and NON SQL database system such as MS SQL Server and Cassandra or equivalents.
* Experience with queuing technologies such as RabbitMQ or equivalent.
* Experience with GitLab, GitLab CI and Octopus Deploy or equivalent CI/CD tooling.
* Experience in participation of product design, from technicalities to functional alternatives.
* Experience in leading innovation projects or hack days within the team.
* Experience troubleshooting performance bottlenecks, provide solutions and derive best practices.

title: Senior Software Engineer Rust- Assistant Vice President
description:
**Department Overview**
The
**Equities Technology**
division is responsible for building and maintaining the high-performance, ultra-low-latency trading infrastructure that powers our global equities business. This includes market data dissemination, order routing, algorithmic execution, smart order routing (SOR), and real-time risk management systems. We operate in a highly competitive environment where microseconds matter, requiring cutting-edge software engineering practices, deep hardware-software co-design, and robust system reliability.
  
  
**Role Summary**
We are seeking an exceptional
**Senior Software Engineer**
with deep expertise in
**Rust**
and
**C++**
to join our Equities Low-Latency Trading Technology team.
  
  
In this role, you will design, develop, and optimize our next-generation trading systems. You will lead the strategic transition of legacy high-performance C++ components to modern Rust where safety and concurrency are paramount, while continuing to maintain and optimize critical ultra-low-latency C++ execution paths. This is a highly technical role requiring a strong understanding of computer architecture, operating systems, network protocols, and modern software engineering paradigms.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities And Skills**
**8+ YOE is a must have**

* System Design & Development
* Architect, build, and maintain ultra-low-latency trading systems, including exchange connectivity gateways, market data feeds, and algorithmic execution engines using Rust and C++
* Design clean, modular, and reusable APIs and libraries that can be leveraged across multiple trading desks.
* Lead the strategic migration of critical trading components from C++ to Rust, leveraging Rust's memory safety and concurrency guarantees without sacrificing performance.
* Performance Optimization
* Profile and optimize systems to achieve sub-microsecond latencies and deterministic performance.
* Apply low-latency techniques such as CPU pinning, cache-friendly data structures, lock-free programming, memory-mapped files, and custom memory allocators.
* Utilize kernel bypass technologies (e.g., Solarflare OpenOnload, DPDK, EF\_VI) to minimize network stack overhead.
* Concurrency & Reliability
* Design and implement highly concurrent, thread-safe, and lock-free algorithms to handle massive throughput with minimal jitter.
* Implement rigorous testing methodologies, including unit testing, integration testing, property-based testing (in Rust), and high-fidelity simulation/back testing environments.
* Ensure the high availability and operational resilience of trading systems through robust error handling and failover mechanisms.
* Collaboration & Support
* Work closely with quantitative researchers, traders, and product managers to translate complex trading strategies and business requirements into robust, production-ready software.
* Build real-time telemetry, monitoring, and alerting tools to ensure operational visibility.
* Provide level-3 escalation support for production systems during market hours.

**Required Technical Skills & Qualifications**
**Programming Languages**

* C++: Expert-level proficiency in C++ (C++11/14/17/20), with a deep understanding of template metaprogramming, RAII, move semantics, smart pointers, and the standard library (STL).
* Rust: Strong proficiency in Rust, including ownership/borrowing concepts, lifetimes, unsafe Rust boundaries, macro systems, and the Cargo ecosystem.

**Systems Programming & Low-Latency**

* Deep understanding of Linux operating system internals (kernel tuning, memory management, virtual memory, page faults, system calls).
* Experience with low-latency networking (TCP/IP, UDP, Multicast) and socket programming.
* Familiarity with hardware-level concepts: CPU cache hierarchies (L1/L2/L3), TLB, branch prediction, and memory barriers.

**Concurrency**

* Proven experience in multi-threaded programming, memory models (sequential consistency, acquire-release), and lock-free data structures.

**Equities Domain Knowledge**

* Solid understanding of Equities market structure, order types, exchange protocols (FIX, OUCH, ITCH), and trading lifecycles.

**Tools & Infrastructure**

* Experience with profiling and debugging tools (gdb, valgrind, perf, VTune, heaptrack).
* Proficiency with build systems (CMake, Cargo) and CI/CD pipelines (Git, Jenkins/GitHub Actions).

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with FPGA integration or hardware acceleration.
* Experience with kernel bypass technologies (Solarflare EF\_VI, OpenOnload, DPDK).
* Knowledge of market-making, smart order routing (SOR), or statistical arbitrage execution strategies.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related quantitative field.

**Core Competencies**

* Analytical Thinking: Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to analyze complex systems and identify performance bottlenecks.
* Collaboration: Excellent communication skills with the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, cross-functional team environment.
* Adaptability: Eagerness to learn new technologies and adapt to evolving business requirements and market conditions.
* Quality Focus: Commitment to writing clean, well-documented, and thoroughly tested code.

title: Product Engineer (Junior)
description:
**Product Engineer (Junior) — VenXR**
VenXR builds AdsGPT: brands plan, run and optimise their ad campaigns by talking to it. We're hiring a Product Engineer, one to two years in, who builds
*with*
LLMs rather than around them.
  
  
**What You'll Build**
Features, end to end — from a half-formed idea to production, and you own what happens after it ships. Most of what you build will have a model in the loop: campaign planning that reasons about a brand's goals, interfaces that assemble themselves from whatever the model surfaced, agents calling real tools against real ad platforms.
  
  
**Tech Stack**
Frontend: React.js
  
  
Backend: Python, Django
  
  
AI: Claude and other frontier models, LangChain / LangGraph, MCP
  
  
**AI-native, and we mean it literally**
Most job ads get this wrong, so plainly: using Claude to write code is not what we mean. Everyone does that. We mean LLMs as the material the product is built from. You'll need working knowledge of:
  
  

* Fundamentals — tokens, context windows, cost, latency, structured outputs, why a confident model is often wrong
* Orchestration — LangGraph or equivalent: state, nodes, conditional routing, persistence, interrupts. Not just prompts in a for loop
* Multi-agent patterns — when splitting work across agents helps, and the commoner case where it just multiplies failure modes
* Context engineering — what the model sees at each step: retrieval, compaction, selective injection. Where most of the quality lives
* Memory management — multi-turn state without the window or the bill growing unbounded
* MCP — connecting models to tools and APIs
* Evaluation — knowing whether what you built works, which is harder than building it

What we want is someone who has built at least one real thing with an orchestration framework — past the tutorial, into the part where it broke. Self-taught side projects count; show us.
  
  
**What You Need**

* One to two years shipping product
* React.js, Python with Django — or FastAPI plus the obvious ability to get to Django in a fortnight.
* At least one LLM-backed feature real users touched, where you owned the prompt, the orchestration and the failure modes
* REST APIs, SQL or NoSQL, and enough system design to know when your approach won't survive scale
* Strong debugging, and comfort with ambiguity and almost no hand-holding

Your work speaks louder than your degree. Share links to your GitHub, portfolio, or projects you’ve shipped. That’s what we’ll look at first.
  
  
**What Helps**
Each one moves you up the list.
  
  

* Conversational interfaces, and multi-turn state across channels
* LLM evaluation and monitoring — Ragas, LangSmith, Langfuse, or your own harness
* Working knowledge of Generative UI.
* AdTech, MarTech domain knowledge is a plus.
* Cloud infra, Docker, CI/CD
* Explainable or compliance-aware AI in a regulated domain

**How We Work**

* Customer obsession — curiosity about what your code does to someone's day
* Ownership — chase blockers rather than wait on them
* Stakeholder sense — know when to pull in Product, Design or Business
* High standards — hold your work to a bar nobody is checking
* Disagree and commit — argue the call hard, then back it fully
* Simplify relentlessly — the simplest thing that works beats the cleverest thing that works
* Solidarity — show up for teammates unasked
* Vitality — energy that holds up in month six

In practice: ship fast, test in production more than is strictly comfortable, and sit close enough to the founders that "I'll ask Product" means turning around.
  
  
**The process**
The take-home is the real filter, so here's what it's for.
  
  

* Tech screening round — 30 minutes.
* Take-home — a small orchestrated LLM system. Using AI is expected; being unable to defend what it wrote is disqualifying.
* Interview round 1 — we walk through your submission and argue about it.
* Interview round 2 - Technical + Managerial

**Baner, Pune.**
Health cover, team offsites, and a culture that's flexible in the ways that matter rather than the ways that photograph well.
  
  
Skills: mcp,django,react.js,langgraph,system design,sql,orchestration,langchain,docker

title: Software Engineer
description:
Powering the world's payments ecosystem
  
ACI powers the payments ecosystem globally, and you power ACI. You'll innovate, collaborate, and grow in an energetic technology culture with decades of proven success. ACIers at every level are empowered to make a meaningful impact while working on solutions that process billions of transactions worldwide.
  
As a Software Engineer in India, you will join a diverse and passionate engineering team responsible for delivering highly reliable card and merchant payment solutions that serve financial institutions across the globe.
  
About the Role
  
Join ACI's Card & Merchant Management (CMM) engineering team and help build, enhance and support mission-critical payment solutions used by leading financial institutions worldwide. This role combines deep Mainframe and COBOL expertise with modern software engineering practices to deliver scalable, secure and highly reliable card payment processing solutions.
  
You will work on complex payment systems that process high volumes of transactions while contributing to product innovation, quality, operational excellence and AI-driven engineering practices.
  
Key Responsibilities
  
- Design, develop, test and maintain high-quality software solutions.
  
- Develop and support COBOL, JCL, DB2 and VSAM-based applications on IBM Mainframe platforms.
  
- Participate in architecture reviews, design discussions and code reviews to ensure engineering excellence.
  
- Develop and execute automated unit, integration and regression tests.
  
- Investigate, diagnose and resolve customer-reported issues and production incidents.
  
- Collaborate closely with Product Management, Professional Services, Support and other engineering teams.
  
- Contribute to technical documentation, solution designs and product specifications.
  
- Support Agile delivery processes and actively participate in sprint planning, estimation and retrospectives.
  
- Drive continuous improvement in performance, resiliency, maintainability and operational excellence.
  
- Leverage AI-assisted engineering tools to improve development efficiency, quality and productivity.#
  
  
Required Skills & Experience
  
- 3+ years of software development experience.
  
- Strong expertise in COBOL, JCL and DB2 development.
  
- Good experience using Linux or Unix platforms.
  
- Unix shell scripting.
  
- Willingness to learn, both old and new technologies, to solve problems and take the product in new directions
  
- Experience using AI-powered development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude or similar) to improve engineering productivity, code quality, testing and problem-solving.
  
- Hands-on IBM Mainframe development experience.
  
- Experience with Git or similar source control systems.
  
- Strong debugging, analytical and problem-solving skills.
  
- Experience working in Agile software development environments.
  
- Familiarity with AI tools and their application within software development workflows.
  
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  
  
Preferred Skills
  
- Knowledge of card issuing, acquiring and/or interchange processing.
  
- Java development experience.
  
- VSAM knowledge and experience.
  
- Ability to effectively apply AI solutions to software development, testing, automation and operational workflows.
  
- Experience working with high-volume, mission-critical transaction processing systems.
  
- Experience supporting performance engineering, resiliency and operational excellence initiatives.
  
- Familiarity with cloud-hosted payment platforms and modernisation of legacy systems.
  
- Experience working within regulated financial services environments.
  
  
Core Capabilities
  
We seek colleagues who embody ACI's core capabilities and contribute to our innovative engineering culture:
  
- Ensure Accountability: Hold yourself and others accountable to meet commitments.
  
- Drives Results: Consistently achieve results, even under challenging circumstances.
  
- Customer Focus: Build strong customer relationships and deliver customer-centric solutions.
  
- Cultivate Innovation: Create new and better ways for the organization to succeed.
  
- Collaborates: Build partnerships and work effectively across teams and geographies.
  
- Courage: Step up to address difficult issues and say what needs to be said.
  
  
  
AI Readiness
  
At ACI, AI is becoming an integral part of our engineering culture. Successful candidates should demonstrate curiosity, adaptability, and practical application of AI technologies in software engineering. Candidates should be prepared to discuss:
  
- How they currently use AI tools in their development workflow.
  
- Examples of AI-assisted coding, testing, automation, or problem-solving.
  
- Their approach to responsible and effective AI adoption.
  
- Opportunities they see for leveraging AI to improve engineering productivity and software quality.
  
  
Work Authorization
  
Applicants must be currently authorized to work in India on a full-time basis. This position does not offer sponsorship for employment visa status now or in the future.
  
  
Why Join ACI?
  
In return for your expertise, we offer opportunities for growth, career development, and a competitive compensation and benefits package within an innovative and collaborative work environment.
  
Are you ready to help us transform the payments ecosystem? To learn more about ACI Worldwide, visit our web site at www.aciworldwide.com
  
ACI Worldwide is an AA/EEO employer in the United States, which includes providing equal opportunity for protected veterans and individuals with disabilities, and an EEO employer globally.
  
Important Notice About Recruitment Scams
  
Job seekers should be aware of ongoing recruitment scams where individuals or organizations impersonate legitimate companies to offer fake job opportunities. These scams often involve requests for personal information, payments, or interviews through unofficial channels. Please be cautious and verify any communications claiming to be from our company ( www.aciworldwide.com / @aciworldwide.com). The ACI Worldwide recruitment team will always follow official channels and will never request payment.
