title: Mainframe System Programmer - Part time Contractor
description:
**Mainframe System Programmer**

SailPoint Technologies is a product-based IT company in the Identity and Access Management domain. We take pride in being Leaders in this domain, competing with big giants, enabling customers to efficiently manage digital identities securely and confidently.

Our identity governance platform answers three critical questions: Who has access to what? Who should have access to what? How is that access being used?

SailPoint helps organizations meet their service delivery requirements, improve internal controls, and manage the risks associated with access to sensitive data and applications across the enterprise.

Beyond great products, SailPoint has a great culture and a fun-loving work environment that is highly motivating and productive. We have the best identity team in the world working for us and are passionate about the power of identity. You can find more information about us at
www.sailpoint.com
.

SailPoint’s Mainframe team develops Connectors for the three main security products: RACF, ACF2, and TSS. These connectors are offered as part of the SailPoint Identity Security Cloud and IdentityIQ products.

Using these Connectors, we provide our customers an efficient and reliable way to securely govern their Mainframe systems.

We have historically used zPDT environments to develop, validate, and support our connectors, and are now moving these environments to IBM’s cloud-hosted service that provides on-demand z/OS development and test environments (HDISV).

**Role Overview**

The System Programmer is responsible for providing support to critical internal mainframe-related infrastructure and system software. This is a professional-level position and requires strong execution and analytical abilities. This position is expected to interact and collaborate with Product Engineering and various groups within Information Technology. The candidate must have strong server, network,

communication, and analytical skills.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Responsible for the ongoing maintenance, security, and availability of Mainframe systems set up on IBM’s cloud-hosted service providing on-demand z/OS development and test environments.
* Applies professional-level technical skill and judgement to provide non-routine technical support for computer / data center operations.
* Installs, configures, upgrades, tunes, and troubleshoots the Mainframe z/OS operating system; applies PTFs / maintenance via SMP/E; performs Initial Program Loads (IPL); and tunes system parameters.
* Installs and configures Mainframe security products such as RACF, ACF2, and TSS.
* Monitors, tracks, and records system performance and utilization metrics.
* Provides automation solutions for manual, repetitive tasks using scripting and configuration management systems.
* Assists with the installation, configuration, and testing of newer product releases of the SailPoint Mainframe connector.
* Improves the efficiency of, and helps standardize, current processes.
* Determines and documents the root cause of an outage, its duration, and recommendations or steps to resolve issues.
* Provides assistance as required in analysing trends and suggesting long-term and short-term improvements.
* Assists in change management processes, implements change requests, and meets project deliverables within defined guidelines.
* Ability to work after hours, including weekends and nights, when required.
* Responds to general inquiries.
* Requires a dynamic, hard-working individual with excellent inter-personal, oral, and written communication skills.
* Capable of effectively communicating highly technical information to both technical and non-technical personnel.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science / Engineering or equivalent relevant experience.
* 10+ years of solid experience working as a System Administrator in an enterprise environment.
* Prior experience maintaining Mainframe z/OS environments and security products such as RACF, ACF2, and TSS.
* Experience installing and configuring the Mainframe z/OS operating system, z/VM, z/PDT and HDISV.
* Experience installing and configuring RACF, ACF2, or TSS.
* Experience in REXX, JCL, and SMP/E.
* Experience with TCP/IP programming, IBM/C, or SAS/C will be an added advantage.
* Strong understanding of Linux, networking, firewalls, etc.
* Strong ability to self-learn new technologies.
  •


  Individual should be self-motivated with the ability to work independently.
* Sound planning, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Demonstrated ability to meet deadlines and commitments in an environment that requires multitasking among concurrent projects.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**Role Overview:**

At Haber, we help industries become sustainable by turning plant data into decisions that happen in real time. Our products collect data from sensors and devices inside live plants, and turn it into actions that save water, energy and cost. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will build the web applications our customers use every day - the dashboards, the reports and the screens that show what is happening inside a plant right now. You will work across React on the frontend and Node.js on the backend, with our data coming in from AWS and IoT devices.

You will work closely with the Technical Lead and with senior engineers. This is a strong role for someone who has 3 to 6 years of solid full stack experience and now wants to work on a product where the data is real, messy and arriving every second.

**Key Responsibilities:**

• Build and maintain web applications using React.js, TypeScript, Node.js and REST APIs.

• Develop reusable and maintainable frontend components and backend services.

• Build screens and dashboards that display real-time plant and sensor data.

• Write and optimise REST APIs, and work with SQL databases.

• Work with AWS services to build and run cloud-based application features.

• Implement authentication, authorisation and role-based access control.

• Debug and fix issues across the frontend, backend and cloud layers.

• Write clean, tested code and take part in code reviews.

• Work with the Technical Lead on design and architecture decisions for the features you build.

• Collaborate with product managers, QA and other engineers to deliver features end to end.

• Take part in production support and help find the root cause when something breaks.

**Must Have:**

**Frontend**

• 3 to 6 years of experience building web applications in production.

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field.

• Strong proficiency in React.js, with JavaScript and TypeScript.

• HTML5, CSS3 and responsive UI development.• State management using Redux, React Query or similar.

**Backend**

• Strong proficiency in Node.js, with Express.js or a similar framework.

• RESTful API development.

• Asynchronous programming and understanding of event-driven architecture.

• Basic understanding of API security and authentication.

**Cloud and Data**

• Working knowledge of AWS - services such as Lambda, S3, API Gateway and CloudWatch.

• Good SQL knowledge and experience with PostgreSQL or MySQL.

• Git and Git-based workflows.

**Good to Have:**

• WebSocket and real-time communication.

• Experience with data visualisation libraries such as Highcharts, Chart.js or ECharts.

• Experience with AWS IoT Core, MQTT or any device-to-cloud communication.

• Experience with time-series databases such as InfluxDB, or NoSQL databases and Redis.

• Docker, CI/CD pipelines and Linux fundamentals.

• Understanding of frontend performance optimisation.

• Exposure to IoT, manufacturing, or other industrial and process environments.

• Experience working in a product company or a startup.

**What We Offer:**

• Real-World Impact: What you build is used every day by engineers running real plants

• Learn Across the Stack: Frontend, backend, cloud and IoT - not just one narrow layer

• Strong Mentorship: Work directly with senior engineers who will review your code and help

you grow

• Ownership: You will own features end to end, not just small tickets

• Fast-Track Learning: A startup where learning never stops and innovation is constant

• Collaborative Culture: A team that supports initiative, experimentation and personal growth

• Product-Minded Thinking: Your work will be closely tied to product and business decisions

**About Haber:**

With a mission to help industries become sustainable by converting data to actionable intelligence, our AI+IoT based technology helps our customers spend less time collecting and analysing data by predicting results and driving value in real-time. Our technology has been assuring performance and significantly reducing operating costs, as well as, reducing water and energy footprints for our customers.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**Job title: Senior Software Engineer**

**About SailPoint:**

SailPoint is the leader in identity security for the cloud enterprise. Our identity security solutions secure and enable thousands of companies worldwide, giving our customers unmatched visibility into the entirety of their digital workforce, ensuring workers have the right access to do their job – no more, no less.
  
  
**About the role:**

Want to be on a team that full of results-driven individuals who are constantly seeking to innovate? Want to make an impact? At SailPoint, our Engineering team does just that. Our engineering is where high-quality professional engineering meets individual impact. Our team creates products are built on a mature, cloud-native event-driven microservices architecture hosted in AWS.

SailPoint is seeking a Backend Software Engineer with a strong API(REST/GraphQL) development/design background with a flair for programming in java (and Go desired) with a demonstrated history of learning, passionate about building and delivering reliable, scalable, observable microservices for enterprise-grade, multi-tenant SaaS products. The position will be part of Identity Security Cloud Business Services group that develops governance features - Access Certifications, Access Request & Approvals, Password Management, Separation of Duties, Identity/Account Refresh and Provisioning to connect and centrally control access to every application. As part of this team, we are defining the API management strategy for the range of SaaS products, and bring uniformity to the API creation across all teams, adopting diverse cloud-native technologies (persistence, messaging, analytical processing – to name a few) and enabling the product to scale seamlessly while providing a performant user experience. You'll work with teams that are passionate about continuous improvement and agility in a fast-paced environment.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Drive the planning, design, construction, and reviewing the construction of APIs.
* Drive the design, implementation, and deployment of efficient, maintainable, robust microservices to deliver medium-to-high complexity features.
* As a member of the API strategy team, you will collaborate with the services team and help your stakeholders follow the organization's strategy for designing, building, and maintaining APIs.
* Produce designs and rough estimates, and implement features based on product requirements.
* Collaborate with peers on designs, code reviews, and testing.
* Produce unit and end-to-end tests to improve code quality and maximize code coverage for new and existing features.

**Requirements**

* **6+ years**
  of experience in
  **Java**
  -based backend development.
* Strong knowledge in developing server-side, Object-Oriented Programming and Spring Boot framework
* Experience in designing, implementing RESTful/GraphQL APIs for an API-first application architecture.
* Experience using cloud-native technologies from AWS/other cloud providers.
* Experience developing microservices in multi-tenant SaaS application.
* Experience using SQL/NoSQL, EKS, Kafka, Redis
* Experience using monitoring, alerting, visualization tools like Prometheus, Grafana
* Experience with AI development tools such as Cursor or Claude.
* Experience working with remote teams
* Great communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills

**Desired**

* Professional experience in design/implementation of event-driven architecture.
* Experience writing software applications in Go

**What success looks like in the role**

**Within the first 30 days you will:**

* Onboard into your new role, get familiar with our product offering and technology, proactively meet peers and stakeholders, set up your development environment.

* Seek to deeply understand business problems or common engineering challenges and develop feature and unit test it.

**By 90 days:**

* Proactively implement different enhancements, defect fixes by interacting independently with different (sometimes 
  *many*
  ) stakeholders, architects and members of your team.
* Take a committed approach to contributing to different projects development alongside less experienced engineers on your team—there’s no room for ivory towers here.
* Is able to provide 12x7 on-call support during their day.

**By 6 months:**

* Collaborates with Product Management and Engineering Manager to estimate and develop small to medium complexity features more independently.
* Lead projects with small group of 3-4 members. Participate in resource planning, backlog refinement activity.
* Occasionally serve as an analysis expert during escalations of systems issues that have evaded the ability of less experienced engineers to solve in a timely manner.
* Share support of critical team systems by participating in calls with customers, learning the characteristics of currently running systems, and participating in improvements.

**About SailPoint India and our Benefits:**

Nestled in the heart of Pune, a bustling hub of technology and culture, the office exemplifies SailPoint's commitment to excellence. Surrounded by a vibrant atmosphere, the Pune office serves as a strategic center for the company, where cutting-edge solutions are crafted and implemented to address the ever-evolving challenges in identity security. With a team of highly skilled professionals, the office embodies SailPoint's values of Integrity, Innovation, Impact and Individuals. 
  
 
  
Our Pune team works under a hybrid model enjoying the office 3 days a week (unless otherwise specified). We provide excellent office amenities, competitive salaries and strong benefits:

* Our benefits program offers medical insurance for employees and their dependents, accident insurance and term life insurance for all employees. All premiums are paid by SailPoint.
* Company sponsored health-checkups for employees and discounted rates for dependents
* Annual performance bonus
* 24 Leaves every year in addition, 10 holidays
* Flexible Work hours

SailPoint is an equal opportunity employer and we welcome all qualified candidates to apply to join our team.  All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other category protected by applicable law.  

Alternative methods of applying for employment are available to individuals unable to submit an application through this site because of a disability. Contact applicationassistance@sailpoint.com or mail to 11120 Four Points Dr, Suite 100, Austin, TX 78726, to discuss reasonable accommodations.  NOTE: Any unsolicited resumes sent by candidates or agencies to this email will not be considered for current openings at SailPoint.

title: Sr Lead - Informatica IDMC Developer
description:
Area(s) of responsibility
  
  
Empowered By Innovation
  
  
Birlasoft, a global leader at the forefront of Cloud, AI, and Digital technologies, seamlessly blends domain expertise with enterprise solutions. The company’s consultative and design-thinking approach empowers societies worldwide, enhancing the efficiency and productivity of businesses. As part of the multibillion-dollar diversified CKA Birla Group, Birlasoft with its 12,000+ professionals, is committed to continuing the Group’s 170-year heritage of building sustainable communities.
  
  
Job Title / Position:
**Informatica IDMC Lead**
Experience: 8-10 years
  
  
Location: Bengaluru / Pune / Noida / Hyderabad / Chennai / Mumbai
  
  
Shift: 12:00 PM to 9:00 PM IST
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
**IDMC Development and Integration**

* Develop, configure, and maintain data integration mappings, mapping tasks, taskflows, and schedules using Informatica Cloud Data Integration (CDI).
* Build ETL and ELT pipelines to ingest, transform, and load data across cloud and on-premises sources and targets.
* Configure and support Secure Agents, runtime environments, connections, parameterization, and deployment activities under architectural guidance.
* Develop reusable objects, templates, error-handling routines, logging, and restart mechanisms to improve solution maintainability.
* Create and consume REST and SOAP APIs, and support file-based, database, application, and event-driven integration patterns.

**Data Quality and MDM Support**

* Develop data quality rules, profiles, scorecards, standardization, cleansing, and validation logic using Cloud Data Quality (CDQ).
* Implement data matching, duplicate identification, reference data checks, and exception-handling workflows.
* Support MDM SaaS implementations such as Customer 360, Supplier 360, or Product 360 by configuring data loads, business rules, and integrations.

**Migration and Modernization**

* Assist in assessing and migrating Informatica PowerCenter or IICS assets to IDMC.
* Rebuild or refactor mappings, workflows, data quality assets, and interfaces based on approved migration designs.

**Testing, Support, and Delivery**

* Prepare unit test cases and test evidence; support system integration testing, user acceptance testing, regression testing, and performance testing.
* Troubleshoot mapping failures, connectivity issues, data quality defects, and performance bottlenecks.

**Collaboration and Documentation**

* Work with solution architects, business analysts, source-system teams, database administrators, and QA teams to translate requirements into technical deliverables.
* Create and maintain technical design documents, mapping specifications, runbooks, deployment checklists, and support documentation.
* Participate in design reviews and recommend practical improvements to performance, reliability, and maintainability.

**Required Skills**
**Informatica and Integration**

* Hands-on experience with mappings, taskflows, parameter files, scheduling, monitoring, error handling, and Secure Agents.
* Good understanding of ETL/ELT concepts, data warehousing, dimensional modeling, and integration design patterns.
* Experience with REST APIs, SOAP, JSON, XML, CSV, and secure file-transfer mechanisms. Exposure to Kafka or event streaming is a plus.

**Databases, Cloud, and Engineering Tools**

* Strong SQL skills and experience with at least two platforms such as Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Snowflake, or Databricks.
* Exposure to one or more cloud platforms: Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services, or Google Cloud Platform.

title: Senior System Software Engineer - Local AI Automation
description:
The Local AI Automation team is seeking a Senior System Software Engineer passionate about building and maintaining robust system-level software and infrastructure for deploying, benchmarking, and qualifying high-quality AI applications and models. You will collaborate with a team of highly qualified engineers dedicated to creating top-tier infrastructure for Local AI automation. If you have a real passion for building reliable, scalable automation systems in the AI ecosystem, this could be an excellent opportunity for us to work together!
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Design, implement, and maintain robust system software and infrastructure to efficiently run various AI workloads through different inference backends such as Llama.cpp, Ollama, PyTorch, vLLM, WinML, TRT-RTX, and others.
* Scope out system requirements for deploying various AI applications, benchmarks, and models in automation, and develop solutions to measure correctness, functionality, reliability, and overall system performance.
* Develop infrastructure to download AI models from various sources, efficiently manage a local model repository, and create automated synchronization mechanisms to keep the repository up to date.
* Analyze large datasets and system workload metrics, implement data processing infrastructure to transform raw data into actionable information for developers, and design useful visualizations.
* Collaborate with internal Local AI developers to identify and implement system-level instrumentation, diagnostics, and debugging capabilities that help quickly debug and isolate issues.
* Design, implement, and maintain robust infrastructure for automated build, integration, deployment, and qualification across different inference frameworks and environments.
* Understand existing infrastructure and system software architecture, debug issues in current frameworks, identify performance bottlenecks, and devise solutions to enhance system efficiency and scalability.

**What We Need To See**

* 5+ years of experience with a B.Tech or higher degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* Strong analytical, systems debugging, and problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to multitask effectively in a dynamic environment.
* 5+ years of software development experience with strong programming skills in C/C++, C#, Java, or another systems programming language, along with exposure to at least one scripting language such as Python.
* Experience with system APIs, multithreaded software, process and resource management, debugging, or performance analysis.
* Familiarity with databases and SQL, source control systems, and CI/CD infrastructure such as Git, Perforce, and Jenkins.
* Outstanding written and oral communication skills, enabling effective collaboration with management and engineering teams.

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Experience building robust system software, runtime infrastructure, or scalable backend components.
* Experience with system profiling, performance optimization, debugging, and telemetry/observability infrastructure, including analysis of Nsight Systems traces to understand system state and kernel performance.
* Hands-on background with Linux/Windows system programming, Git CI/CD, databases/SQL, Kubernetes, Docker, and observability tools such as Grafana or Kibana.
* Hands-on experience integrating or debugging inference frameworks such as Llama.cpp, Ollama, PyTorch, vLLM, WinML, or TRT-RTX.
* Experience understanding CPU/GPU resource utilization, memory management, concurrency, and performance characteristics of AI workloads.

If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
  
  
Role: Sr. Associate Director, Software Engineering
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Design and implement business-critical workflow orchestration using Flowable BPMN/DMN engine — including Java delegates, task listeners, and decision tables
* Build and maintain RESTful microservices in a hexagonal (ports & adapters) architecture with CQRS read/write service separation
* Implement complex multi-step approval workflows (1LoD/2LoD review chains, auto-approval logic, scope manager integration)
* Work with PostgreSQL databases across multiple schemas, JPA/Hibernate entity mappings, and Spring Data repositories Integrate with GCP Pub/Sub for audit event publishing and asynchronous communication

To be successful in this role, you should meet the following requirements:
  
  

* 8+ years Java (Java 21, records, pattern matching, sealed classes)
* 5+ years Spring Boot (3.x/4.x, auto-configuration, profiles, actuator, security) Spring Cloud — Feign clients, service discovery patterns, distributed configuration
* Flowable or Activiti — BPMN process design, DMN decision tables,
* JavaDelegate/TaskListener implementation, process variable management, history service queries
* JPA/Hibernate — entity relationships, derived queries, custom JPQL, schema migration strategies PostgreSQL — query optimization, indexing, understanding of N+1 query patterns RESTful API design — pagination, filtering, CQRS patterns, DTO mapping Testing — JUnit 5, Mockito, integration testing with embedded databases,
* REST Assured Git — branching strategies, code review, merge conflict resolution

**Preferred Skills**

* GCP — Pub/Sub, Cloud Build, GKE deployment, Cloud SQL
* Hexagonal architecture — ports & adapters, domain-driven design
* Helm/Kubernetes — chart authoring, Skaffold, container lifecycle
* CI/CD pipelines — Cloud Build, automated testing, environment promotion
* Performance optimization — identifying N+1 Feign/query problems, batch endpoint design, caching strategies
* Lombok, MapStruct — code generation, DTO mapping
* OpenAPI/Swagger — API documentation, contract-first design

What We Value
  
  

* Engineers who read existing code before writing new code
* Clean, minimal changes — no speculative abstractions or premature generalization

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.
  
  
www.hsbc.com/careers
  
  
HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

description:

* **Exposure to automation frameworks or tools for validating AI/ML model behavior.**

title: Linux Kernel Driver Engineer (Filesystems/vfs)
description:
About the job
 
  





  





**Job description** 
 :Linux Kernel Driver Engineer (Filesystem / VFS)
 



**Location** 
 : Pune, MH or Gandhinagar, GJ
 



**Experience** 
 : 5–10 years
 



**Employment Type** 
 : Full\-time
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a Linux Kernel Engineer to develop and maintain kernel\-mode driver (KMD), a DKMS\-packaged loadable kernel module that hooks the VFS layer to transparently intercept file operations, manage stub files, and enable seamless cloud tiering of surveillance video — without modifying the VMS or requiring embedded NVR/DVR hardware.
 



  




* **Key Responsibilities**



  




* Design, implement, and maintain a Linux kernel module (LKM) built and distributed via DKMS across supported Ubuntu Server kernel versions
* Implement and evolve VFS\-layer hooks covering inode, dentry, and superblock operations, and core filesystem entry points (open, read, getattr, etc.)
* Use kprobes/kretprobes (e.g. on vfs\_getattr\_nosec) to intercept and modify kernel behavior for stub\-file size reporting without breaking VMS retention logic
* Own kernel\-side synchronization (spinlocks, mutexes, RCU where applicable) across concurrent file access paths
* Debug kernel\-level issues using dmesg, ftrace, crash/kdump, and /proc / /sys inspection; verify module identity via srcversion after every change
* Coordinate the kernel/userspace boundary (shared memory, ring buffers) with the Linux Systems Programming team
* Maintain strict versioning discipline (module version, module params) and produce round\-numbered RCA design docs for significant fixes



  




* **Mandatory Skills Must\-Have**



  




* Linux kernel module (LKM) development in C, packaged and distributed via DKMS
* Deep working knowledge of the VFS layer: inode, dentry, superblock, file\_operations
* Experience with kprobes/kretprobes or equivalent dynamic kernel instrumentation techniques
* Filesystem driver / stackable filesystem concepts and standard entry points (open, read, write, getattr, release)
* Kernel debugging proficiency: dmesg, ftrace, crash/kdump, /proc and /sys inspection
* Solid grasp of kernel\-space synchronization primitives (spinlocks, mutexes, RCU) and IRQ/atomic\-context constraints
* Familiarity with kernel module versioning, signing, and safe load/unload lifecycle management



  




* **Nice\-to\-Have Skills Good\-to\-Have**



  




* FUSE internals knowledge, to reason about the kernel/userspace split cleanly
* eBPF programming experience
* Familiarity with mainstream filesystem internals (ext4, overlayfs, btrfs)
* Prior experience on backup, antivirus, or hierarchical\-storage\-management (HSM) kernel drivers

title: Senior Cloud Platform Engineer
description:
**Brief Description**
 Zywave is a leading provider of InsurTech solutions, empowering insurance brokers and agencies with innovative software tools to grow and manage their business. We are building a secure and scalable cloud infrastructure to support our enterprise applications and cloud\-native solutions.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 We are looking for a
 **Senior Cloud Platform Engineer** 
 to lead the design, implementation, and management of our
 **hybrid cloud infrastructure across AWS and Azure** 
 . This role is critical in ensuring the
 **scalability, security, and performance** 
 of Zywave’s cloud\-native and enterprise applications.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design and implement secure, scalable, and highly available infrastructure on AWS and Azure.
* Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using tools like Terraform, ARM templates, or CloudFormation.
* Collaborate with DevOps, security, and application teams to support CI/CD pipelines and cloud\-native deployments.
* Monitor cloud environments for performance, cost optimization, and compliance.
* Implement and manage cloud networking, IAM, and resource provisioning.
* Lead cloud migration and modernization initiatives.
* Troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues and provide root cause analysis.
* Stay updated with the latest cloud technologies and recommend improvements.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
* 8\+ years of experience in cloud engineering or infrastructure roles.
* Strong hands\-on experience with AWS and Azure services (e.g., EC2, S3, VPC, Lambda, Azure VMs, Azure Functions, Azure Networking).
* Proficiency in scripting languages such as PowerShell, Python, or Bash.
* Expertise with IaC tools like Terraform, CloudFormation, or Bicep.
* Solid understanding of cloud security, networking, and cost management.
* Familiarity with containerization (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes, AKS, EKS).
* Certifications such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect or Azure Solutions Architect Expert preferred.
* Experience with hybrid cloud or multi\-cloud environments.
* Knowledge of monitoring and logging tools (CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, Datadog).
* Exposure to DevOps practices and tools (e.g., GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Azure DevOps).


**Skills**
**Mandatory:** 
 Git, AWS, Terraform, Kubernetes, Networking (DNS, Firewall), Bash
   

  

**Good to Have:** 
 Azure, CloudWatch, Prompt Engineering
   

  

**Domain Knowledge:** 
 Insurance domain exposure preferred
   

  

 Why Work at Zywave?
   

  

 Zywave empowers insurers and brokers to drive profitable growth and thrive in today’s escalating risk landscape. Only Zywave delivers a powerful Performance Multiplier, bringing together transformative, ecosystem\-wide capabilities to amplify impact across data, processes, people, and customer experiences. More than 15,000 insurers, MGAs, agencies, and brokerages trust Zywave to sharpen risk assessment, strengthen client relationships, and enhance operations. Additional information can be found at www.zywave.com.

 Slb has an opening in Coimbatore / Pune, India and Bogota, Columbia for a Technical Lead who will work on the Development / configuration for all modules / capabilities, changes and bug fixes related to Planisware and Microsoft .Net suite of applications in the Product and Service Delivery Function under Enterprise Solutions.
   

  

 The end users supported are the global community in Slb using these systems. Both L1 support and L2 support is provided in\-house while L3 Development and Support is outsourced to vendors.
   

  

 This role will work closely with the Scrum team on defining / change requirements and align with the development team (L3, vendors) for technical design and effort validation. Further, he/she will define periodic release plans and release schedules in coordination with the domain teams and the L3 vendor while being supervised by the Chief Scrum Master. He / she would manage the execution of release activities and co\-ordinate with the L3 development teams to ensure releases are delivered on time and within budget.
   

  

 Key responsibilities
   

  

 Technical Responsibilities
   

  

* Solution Design \& Architecture: Lead the design and architecture of standard as well as customized Planisware solution to address Project Management needs/Stakeholders
* Strategic Alignment: Work with product management and IT leadership to align Planisware functionality with business strategies and project goals.
* Obtain business requirements and use cases / user stories from Product and Service Delivery, Supply, Distribution and Operation Planning Domains for all enhancements. Validate all such requirements and articulate to the L3 teams
* Customization Framework: Define best practices and frameworks for customizing Planisware to meet the evolving needs of the business.
* Integration Strategy: Develop and implement integration strategies to connect Planisware with other enterprise systems. Optimizing the API calls to minimize the performance issues \& Cost.
* Governance \& Best Practices: Establish governance around Planisware usage, ensuring the platform is optimized for scalability, security, and performance.
* Performance Tuning: Monitor system performance, ensuring efficient use of resources, and troubleshoot issues as they arise.
* Technical Leadership: Provide guidance and mentorship to development teams, ensuring high\-quality deliverables Serve as a SPOC to the L3 inhouse / vendor development team and coordinate all development and testing activities. Help development team to understand the error causes on production environment
* Review and get technical feasibility validation of the technical design provided by L3 for the change requests.
* Ensure adoption of Scrum in the development process. Also ensure DevOps is adopted within the team efficiently
* Work on roll\-back scenarios and identify cases where roll\-backs are necessary


 Release Management
   

  

* Assist the Technical Team in the design and development of the release management process
* Expertise in various PLW modules, including Oscar and PMGo modules.
* Proven experience in designing and deploying Planisware for large\-scale organizations, particularly in product or project management. Familiarity with enterprise architecture and software development life cycle (SDLC) methodologies
* Manage risks and resolves issues that affect release scope, schedule and quality
* Ensure technical documentation is kept up to date by the development team
* Proactively identify and implement procedures to streamline the build process which may drive the development and maintenance of an automated build process
* Periodically reports performance metric dashboard for releases handled. Communicate release details and schedules to the Domains as required


**Essential Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or related field
* 10\+ years of overall support/development experience, of which 5 \+ years on Planisware.
* Planisware Certification – Specialist OR Expert
* 4\+ years in Change and Release Management
* 3 to 4 years of experience building on Web apps / Desktop Apps using technologies like React, Angular, Java ASP.NET, etc.
* Good understanding of consuming APIs through Single Page Application (SPA).
* Good exposure to database technologies like Oracle, MS SQL Server, etc.


**Key competencies**

* Should have a thorough understanding and working knowledge of ITIL processes including Application Change and Release Management
* Experience working on multiple releases/projects as a subject matter expert and as a technical leader. Should have worked on complex projects that require expertise across multiple disciples and environments
* Very good understanding around building Planisware based solution and Integration / data migration processes
* Experience working in an Agile/Scrum/Kanban environment
* Good knowledge of Azure IaaS / PaaS
* Very good experience of version management.
* Experience of providing overall process improvements adopting to the release process
* Advanced knowledge of Software Development Lifecycle
* Preferred experience in Oil \& Gas industry (though not mandatory)


**Other Skills And Abilities**

* Open to travel abroad and in India

 Understanding of security controls, forensics, kill chain analysis, risk assessment and security metrics.
   

  

 Ability to perform initial static and dynamic malware analysis.
   

  

 Understanding of reverse engineering techniques.
   

  

 Knowledge of networking and the TCP/IP stack.
   

  

 Knowledge of programming or scripting languages.
   

  

 Knowledge of networking protocols and application file formats like PDF, Office files, and operating system internals.Soft Skills:

title: Patch Research Engineer
description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!
   

  

**About The Role**
 Qualys is looking for a detail\-oriented Windows Patch Management Catalog Researcher to join the Patch Management product team. In this role, you will be responsible for building and maintaining a comprehensive, accurate patch catalog covering a wide range of third\-party Windows software.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Patch Catalog Research \& Authoring**
* Research, author, and maintain patch metadata for third\-party Windows applications across a broad software catalog.
* Identify new software releases, security updates, and version changes from vendor sources, changelogs, and security advisories (CVE/NVD).
* Map vendor releases to structured metadata schemas, including version strings, download URLs, detection logic, and installation parameters.
* Track software End\-of\-Life (EOL) dates and update catalog entries accordingly.


**Windows Patching \& Installation Knowledge**
* Document and validate silent installation parameters for diverse installer types (MSI, NSIS EXE, InnoSetup, WiX, etc.).
* Research and verify correct msiexec.exe flags, NSIS /S switches, and equivalent silent/unattended arguments per software.
* Determine accurate reboot behavior (Yes / No / Maybe) per installer type and document exit codes (success, reboot\-required).
* Manually test patch installation in sandbox environments and verify detection logic post\-install.


**Detection Logic \& Registry Research**
* Research and validate Windows registry keys used to detect installed software versions (Uninstall hive, vendor\-specific keys, DisplayVersion, etc.).
* Identify and document file\-based detection paths (FileVersion, ProductVersion attributes on key executables).
* Understand the difference between 32\-bit and 64\-bit registry views (WOW6432Node) and apply the correct detection architecture per installer variant.
* Validate detection logic against fresh installs and upgrades across supported Windows versions.


**Backend Patch Tool Understanding**
* Understand how enterprise patch management platforms (e.g., Qualys Patch Management, SCCM, Ivanti, Adaptiva) discover, deploy, and verify patches.
* Familiarity with how catalogs are consumed by patch engines — detection\-before\-install logic, supersedence evaluation, and deployment policy enforcement.


**Required Skills \& Qualifications**
* 4\-5 years of experience in Windows systems administration, patch management, or software packaging.
* Strong understanding of Windows OS internals — registry structure, file system, user vs. system installation scopes, environment variables, and PATH management.
* Hands\-on experience with Windows patching tools (WSUS, SCCM/ConfigMgr, Ivanti, Qualys, Chocolatey, or equivalent).
* Experience with manual patch installation — running MSI/EXE installers, using msiexec.exe with switches, repackaging software.
* Solid understanding of installer technologies: MSI/WiX, NSIS, InnoSetup, Squirrel, and their silent install mechanisms.
* Familiarity with the Windows registry and the ability to trace installation artifacts to their registry keys.


**Nice to Have**
* Experience building or maintaining a software patch catalog (Adaptiva, Chocolatey, ManageEngine, or similar).
* Experience with Windows Installer (MSI) internals — product codes, upgrade codes, component tables.
* Knowledge of ARM64 Windows platform nuances and multi\-architecture software distribution.
* Good understanding of Windows Update infrastructure (WUA, WSUS, CBS/SFC).
* Scripting experience in Python or PowerShell.

 About the team:
   

  

 The Mendix Cloud Logging \& Monitoring team is responsible for building and maintaining the complete solution which provides our customers with logs, metrics and alerts of their applications running on our infrastructure at any point. The team is responsible for this infrastructure and the underlying services, spread across 30\+ production deployments across the globe, 24/7, with 4 nines of uptime
   

  

 The role
   

  

 In the role of a Software engineer in the Mendix Cloud Logging \& Monitoring team you will play a pivotal role in designing, developing, and operating the backend applications that help customers understand their apps better.
   

  

 Your expertise will be instrumental in ensuring the reliability, scalability, and efficiency of our logging \& monitoring infrastructure, enabling seamless data protection for our diverse application ecosystem.
   

  

 As part of our continuous effort to innovate and improve our offerings, we are seeking a talented software engineer to join our dynamic team responsible for building and maintaining the logging and monitoring services, a critical component of our Cloud product.
   

  

**We're looking for you if you have:**
* 5 plus years of experience in software development
* Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Java, or Go, with a strong emphasis on building scalable, distributed systems.
* Strong understanding of cloud computing concepts, with hands\-on experience in AWS services and Unix/Linux fundamentals.
* Experience with running applications at scale with cloud orchestration technologies like Kubernetes and/or Cloud Foundry and understanding of Kubernetes observability including container logs, events, and cluster
* monitoring.
* Familiarity with infrastructure as code (IaC) principles and tools, such as Terraform, Spacelift, for provisioning and managing cloud infrastructure.
* Knowledge of distributed tracing and trace propagation across microservices.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to articulate technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to make critical decisions under pressure, prioritize tasks effectively, and meet tight deadlines.
* Experience working in Agile environments, utilizing methodologies like Scrum or Kanban.
* Passion for code quality and know how to lead by example: from a clean Git history to well thought\-out unit and integration tests


**Even better (but not essential!) if you have experience with:**
* Python for scripting and automation tasks.
* Understanding of OpenTelemetry (OTel) and telemetry instrumentation.
* Experience with integrating applications with APM platforms such as Datadog, New Relic, Splunk, AppDynamics, Grafana, etc.
* CI/CD tooling such as Jenkins, Spacelift, etc.
* Mendix low\-code application development.
* Relevant certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Developer Associate) are a plus.


**You’ll help drive digital innovation by:**
* Collaborating with cross\-functional teams to understand requirements, prioritize tasks, and deliver solutions that meet business objectives.
* Driving continuous improvement initiatives to optimize processes, nhance automation, and increase efficiency in managing backups across our Cloud product.
* Staying updated on industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices to incorporate them into the development roadmap of the backups service.

* Amazon Web Services: EC2, RDS, S3, ECS, CloudWatch, Lambda, IAM, Opensearch, Bedrock and more!

* Monitoring: Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana
* CI/CD: GitLab CI, ArgoCD
* Automation: Terraform, Spacelift, Helm
* Programming languages and frameworks: Python, Go, Java
* Scripting: Bash, Python

* Database: PostgreSQL, Aurora

title: Senior Engineer- Software Development
description:
For more than 40 years, Accelya has been the industry’s partner for change, simplifying airline financial and commercial processes and empowering the air transport community to take better control of the future. Whether partnering with IATA on industry\-wide initiatives or enabling digital transformation to simplify airline processes, Accelya drives the airline industry forward and proudly puts control back in the hands of airlines so they can move further, faster.
   

  

 We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Software Engineer with 5\+ years of experience building full\-stack solutions using .NET Core for backend services and TypeScript with ReactJS/Next.js for modern web frontends, paired with deep expertise in AWS technologies — including DynamoDB, EventBridge, Lambda, and S3\. The ideal candidate has a proven track record of leading projects, actively contributing to sprint design, and mentoring team members, with a passion for delivering high\-quality, scalable, and efficient software across the full stack.
   

  

**What will you do?**
**Software Development**
 Design, code, and implement full\-stack software solutions using .NET Core (backend/APIs) and TypeScript\-based ReactJS/Next.js (frontend). Develop high\-quality, scalable, and maintainable applications end to end.
   

  

**Technical Design and Architecture**
 Collaborate with architects and senior engineers to define technical vision, system architecture, and integration of AWS services and frontend frameworks. Contribute to the design of software components, ensuring scalability, performance, and adherence to best practices — including serverless\-first patterns where appropriate.
   

  

**AWS Services Integration**
 Utilize AWS services such as DynamoDB, EventBridge, Lambda, S3, and others to design and implement robust, efficient, serverless solutions. Integrate applications with these services, ensuring optimal performance, scalability, and cost efficiency.
   

  

**Frontend Engineering**
 Build responsive, performant, type\-safe user interfaces with TypeScript, React, and Next.js (SSR/SSG, App Router, API routes). Ensure clean integration between frontend applications and .NET Core/serverless backends.
   

  

**Database Integration**
 Design and optimize database schemas and queries for efficient data storage and retrieval in DynamoDB. Integrate and synchronize data across databases and AWS services.
   

  

**Testing and Quality Assurance**
 Write unit and integration tests, conduct code reviews, and enforce coding standards across backend and frontend code. Build and maintain automated test coverage. Collaborate with QA teams to identify and resolve issues.
   

  

**CI/CD and DevOps**
 Build and maintain GitLab CI pipelines for automated build, test, and deployment across environments, supporting serverless deployments (Lambda, S3, CloudFormation/CDK/Serverless Framework).
   

  

**Continuous Improvement**
 Stay current with .NET Core, TypeScript, React/Next.js, AWS, and AI\-assisted development tooling. Identify opportunities for process improvement, code optimization, and enhanced developer workflows — including adopting AI coding assistants to boost team velocity and code quality.
   

  

**Collaboration and Leadership**
 Work closely with product managers, designers, and engineers to align development efforts with requirements. Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and guidance to junior engineers across both backend and frontend disciplines.
   

  

**Troubleshooting and Support**
 Investigate and resolve complex technical issues in development and production. Support end users/clients to ensure smooth operation of applications.
   

  

**What do you need to know?**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* 5\+ years of hands\-on software development experience with .NET Core, with strong AWS\-based project experience.
* Working experience with TypeScript, ReactJS, and Next.js for building production frontend applications.
* Expertise in AWS services, including DynamoDB, EventBridge, and Lambda; solid understanding of S3 and serverless architectures.
* Experience with test automation frameworks and CI/CD pipelines, ideally with GitLab CI.
* Proven track record of leading projects and delivering high\-quality software solutions end to end.
* Deep understanding of software development best practices, coding standards, and design patterns across full\-stack applications.
* Strong problem\-solving and troubleshooting skills across distributed, serverless systems.
* Excellent mentoring and leadership abilities, with a passion for developing junior engineers.
* Proficiency in Agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban) and experience working in an Agile environment.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, able to work effectively with cross\-functional teams and stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to work in a fast\-paced environment, manage multiple priorities, and meet deadlines.


**Good to have**
* Familiarity with AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or similar) to accelerate coding, code review, and testing workflows.
* Experience designing and maintaining GitLab CI/CD pipelines for serverless and containerized deployments.
* Experience with Playwright (or similar) for end\-to\-end and browser automation testing.
* AWS certifications, such as AWS Certified Developer – Associate or AWS Certified Solutions Architect, are highly desirable.

**Position Summary**
 SAP Business AI (Joule and Basic ABAP) \- Senior, Tax Technology Services

 Work you’ll do
   

  

 We are looking for an innovative Technical SAP ABAP on HANA, CDS, OData, RAP Plus Gen AI develop and implement systems architecture that meet business needs, along with ensuring that our clients’ can keep pace with the changing tax and legal landscape.
   

  

 Design, build, and support performance SAP S/4HANA extensions and services using ABAP on HANA, RESTful ABAP Programming Model (RAP), Core Data Services (CDS), and OData to enable modern Fiori/UI and integration scenarios.
   

  

 To be successful in this role, you should be able to align the global Tax and Legal landscape with the business’ activities and proposed wider business processes. You will be the lynchpin between the Tax Function and IT Function, ensuring that we build the best SAP Tax design for the client. This will require the ability to explain complex terms to a variety of different stakeholders, and in a way that is relevant to each stakeholder group. You will also need to continually assess the SAP product suite and development roadmap to integrate any updated specifications and requirements into SAP system architecture.
   

  

 You will also need to integrate with the wider client project team (whether that is delivered by Deloitte Consulting or another Systems Integration partner). This will involve an understanding of how the tax design interacts with other process flows and also the inter\-personal skills to build the required relationships.
   

  

 Key responsibilities \-
   

  

 ü Develop and enhance ABAP solutions on SAP S/4HANA using clean, modular, and testable patterns.
   

  

 ü Build Gen AI applications and AI Agents.
   

  

 ü Code Python is a plus.
   

  

 ü Ability to navigate fragmented landscapes through API\-calls and MCP\- servers is key.
   

  

 ü Build end\-to\-end RAP artifacts (behavior definitions/implementations, validations, determinations, actions, draft handling, locking, authorization concepts).
   

  

 ü Create and optimize CDS views (interface/consumption views, associations, annotations) with strong focus on pushdown and performance.
   

  

 ü Design, expose, and support OData services (preferably OData V4 via RAP; maintain OData V4 where required).
   

  

 ü Implement Fiori\-enablement via CDS annotations and support UI integration with SAP Fiori elements (as applicable).
   

  

 ü Integrate with SAP and non\-SAP systems using SAP\-recommended patterns (e.g., APIs, events, messaging where applicable).
   

  

 ü Apply performance tuning (SQL optimization, buffering strategy, ST05/SAT/SQLM analysis, CDS performance best practices).
   

  

 ü Follow SAP extensibility guidelines (in\-app/extensibility, key\-user vs developer extensibility, released APIs, clean\-core approach where applicable).
   

  

 ü Produce technical designs, code documentation, unit tests, and participate in code reviews.
   

  

 ü Support testing cycles, defect triage, hyper care, and production support with strong root\-cause analysis
   

  

**Qualification And Experience Required \-**
 ü Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience).
   

  

 ü 2\-5 years of Experience in SAP or SAP4HANA.
   

  

 ü Hands\-on experience in building Gen AI applications, AI Agents.
   

  

 ü SAP Business AI certification is a plus.
   

  

 ü SAP certifications (ABAP for S/4HANA, RAP, BTP) are a plus.
   

  

 ü Strong hands\-on experience with ABAP in SAP S/4HANA / ABAP on HANA environments.
   

  

 ü Proven delivery experience with:
   

  

 ü RAP (managed/unmanaged as needed, behavior implementation, draft, authorization)
   

  

 ü CDS (views, annotations, associations, table functions if needed)
   

  

 ü OData service exposure and troubleshooting (RAP/OData V4 strongly preferred)
   

  

 ü Strong understanding of HANA\-optimized development: SQL/CDS pushdown, avoiding SELECT\-in\-loops, efficient joins, pagination, etc.
   

  

 ü Familiarity with modern ABAP practices (e.g., ABAP OO, clean code, exception handling, unit testing mindset).
   

  

 ü Experience working in Agile delivery (user stories, estimation, sprint ceremonies).
   

  

**ü Preferred / Nice To Have**

**Preferred \-**
 ü BTP, Joule and SAP business AI certification.
   

  

 ü Proven knowledge of Tax touchpoints within SAP.
   

  

 How you’ll grow
   

  

 At Deloitte, we’ve invested a great deal in creating a rich environment in which our professionals can grow. We want all our people to develop in their own way, playing to their own strengths as they hone their leadership skills. And, as a part of our efforts, we provide our professionals with a variety of learning and networking opportunities—including exposure to leaders, sponsors, coaches, and challenging assignments—to help accelerate their careers along the way. No two people learn in exactly the same way. So, we provide a range of resources including live classrooms, team\- based learning, and eLearning. title: Sharepoint Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Power Apps \& SQL , Altreyx**
**Position Details**
 EY’s GDS Assurance Digital team’s mission is to develop, implement and integrate technology solutions that better serve our audit clients and engagement teams. As a member of EY’s core Assurance practice, you’ll develop a deep Audit related technical knowledge and outstanding database, data analytics and programming skills.
   

  

 Ever\-increasing regulations require audit departments to gather, organize and analyses more data than ever before. Often the data necessary to satisfy these ever\-increasing and complex regulations must be collected from a variety of systems and departments throughout an organization. Effectively and efficiently handling the variety and volume of data is often extremely challenging and time consuming for a company.
   

  

 EY's GDS Assurance Digital team members work side\-by\-side with the firm's partners, clients and audit technical subject matter experts to develop and incorporate technology solutions that enhance value\-add, improve efficiencies and enable our clients with disruptive and market leading tools supporting Assurance.
   

  

 GDS Assurance Digital provides solution architecture, application development, testing and maintenance support to the global Assurance service line both on a pro\-active basis and in response to specific requests.
   

  

**Requirements (including Experience, Skills And Additional Qualifications)**
* A bachelor’s degree (BE/BTech/MCA \& MBA) in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems Management, Accounting, Finance or a related field with adequate industry experience.


**Technical Skills Requirements**
* Minimum of 5 years of experience in SharePoint development, including experience with SharePoint Online and SPFx.
* Strong experience with Power Apps, Power Automate, and the broader Power Platform.
* Proficiency in web development technologies, including React, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
* Design and develop robust, scalable Power Apps and SharePoint Online solutions using the SharePoint Framework (SPFx) and other modern development practices.
* Lead the technical design sessions, architecting solutions that fulfill business requirements while aligning with EY's technology standards and best practices.
* Develop custom web parts, extensions, and applications using SPFx, React, TypeScript, and other modern web technologies.
* Implement complex workflows and business processes using Power Automate and integrate them with Power Apps and SharePoint Online.
* Ensure seamless integration of Power Apps and SharePoint solutions with other Microsoft 365 services and third\-party systems.
* Conduct code reviews, enforce coding standards, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.
* Provide expert guidance and support to project teams, stakeholders, and end\-users, including documentation, training, and troubleshooting.
* Stay abreast of the latest developments in Microsoft 365, Power Platform, and SharePoint technologies to drive innovation and thought leadership within EY.
* Experience with Azure services, REST APIs, and external data sources integration.
* Excellent problem\-solving, analytical, and communication skills.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Strong understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) and Agile methodologies.


**Good To Have Skills**
* Microsoft certifications in Power Platform and/or SharePoint.
* Experience with Microsoft Graph API.
* Knowledge of SharePoint PnP (Patterns and Practices).
* Prior consulting experience or experience working in a professional services firm.


**Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities:**
* An ability to quickly understand complex concepts and use technology to support data modeling, analysis, visualization or process automation
* Selects appropriately from applicable standards, methods, tools and applications and uses accordingly
* Ability to work within a multi\-disciplinary team structure, but also independently
* Demonstrates analytical and systematic approach to problem solving
* Communicates fluently orally and in writing and can present complex technical information to both technical and non\-technical audiences
* Able to plan, schedule and monitor work activities in order to meet time and quality targets
* Able to absorb rapidly new technical information, business acumen, and apply it effectively
* Ability to work in a team environment with strong customer focus, good listening, negotiation and problem\-resolution skills


**Additional skills requirements:**
* The expectations are that a Senior will be able to maintain long\-term client relationships and network and cultivate business development opportunities
* Provide high quality client services by directing daily progress of engagement work, informing engagement manager of engagement status, and managing staff performance.
* Must have presentation skills ' ability to create PowerPoint deck to communicate solution architecture to various stakeholders.
* Should have understanding and experience of software development best practices
* Excellent business communication, Consulting, Quality process skills
* Must be a team player


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

**Join us on our journey for a better tomorrow.**
**Introduction**
**What is Atlas Copco Group:**
 Atlas Copco Group is a global industrial company headquartered in Nacka, Sweden. Founded in 1873, it operates in over 180 countries with more than 70,000 employees worldwide. Our vision is to be
 ***First in Mind— First in Choice***
 .
   

  

 We manufacture industrial tools and equipment through four Business Areas: Compressor Technique (CT), Industrial Technique (IT), Vacuum Technique (VT), Power Technique (PT), and Corporate (CO). These are further organized into divisions, and then into Product Companies (PCs), Customer Centres (CCs), and Distribution Centres (DCs) to serve customer needs.
   

  

**About Global IT Hub, India**
 Launched in July 2025,
 **Global IT Hub, India** 
 is a strategic initiative of highly motivated IT/Software Engineers focused on non\-engineering capabilities to strengthen Atlas Copco’s Global IT Hub through scalable, secure, and innovative digital solutions.
   

  

 Our vision is to be a
 **strategic partner for next\-generation digital transformation** 
 , delivering sustainable, scalable, and value\-driven technology solutions for long\-term business success.
   

  

 Atlas Copco Group seeks an experienced Salesforce developer to empower our business operations team.
   

  

 You will be responsible for creating custom software applications on the Salesforce platform that meet our specific requirements for client management and other daily operations. You will also integrate Salesforce with existing systems, ensuring data accuracy and security and providing technical support whenever required.
   

  

 The ideal candidate must possess a strong background in developing and customising Salesforce applications, as well as experience in designing and implementing complex solutions.
   

  

 We offer competitive pay packages, health benefits, plenty of learning opportunities and advancements within the company. We invite you to become a valuable part of our team!
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 A Salesforce developer has a range of responsibilities essential to optimizing CRM platforms and ensuring their functionality. These include:
   

  

* Designing and building Salesforce applications. Developing scalable, secure, and customized solutions using tools such as Apex, Visualforce, and Lightning Web Components to meet business requirements.
* Customizing Salesforce workflows. Creating and configuring custom objects, automation tools, and workflows tailored to streamline organizational processes.
* Integrating Salesforce with external systems. Designing and developing APIs and web services to ensure seamless communication between Salesforce and other applications.
* Troubleshooting and debugging issues. Diagnosing, resolving, and documenting technical problems to ensure system reliability and optimal performance.
* DevOps and CI/CD: Knowledge of development practices for continuous integration and delivery.
* Design Patterns: Understanding of reusable design solutions for building complex applications.
* Collaborating with stakeholders. Partnering with project managers, business analysts, and other team members to deliver on project objectives and timelines.
* Enhancing user experience. Using tools like Salesforce Lightning to improve the user interface and ensure ease of use for end\-users.
* Optimizing data workflows. Implementing efficient data modeling, data processing pipelines, and reporting mechanisms for streamlined data management.
* Developing dashboards and analytics tools. Building insightful dashboards to track key metrics and inform decision\-making processes.
* Staying current with Salesforce technologies. Continuously learn and adopt new features, tools, and Salesforce solutions to deliver innovative, cutting\-edge services.
* Communication: Ability to clearly explain technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Teamwork: Ability to collaborate effectively with development teams and stakeholders.
* Adaptability: Willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies and methodologies.
* Time Management: Effective management of multiple tasks and deadlines.
* Leadership: Ability to guide and mentor team members, provide technical direction, and build consensus.
* Business Acumen: Understanding of business processes and how Salesforce can support them.


**Preferred Skills And Qualifications**
* Salesforce certifications, like Platform Developer I or II, App Builder or Administrator.
* Proficiency in Apex, JavaScript, SOQL, HTML, and CSS, and familiarity with Python, MySQL, or other database tools.
* Ability to work with Salesforce Community Cloud or other collaboration tools.
* Knowledge of DevOps and continuous integration/deployment (CI/CD) processes.
* Expertise in data modelling, debugging, and implementing salesforce solutions that align with business needs.
* Hands\-on experience with tools like Salesforce Lightning, Visualforce pages, automation tools, and dashboards.

* We let people challenge the "Status Quo" and further take initiatives in developing new tools, framework, and applications

**Title And Summary**
 Lead Software Integration Engineer
   

  

**Overview**
 The SME team is looking for a Lead Software Integration Engineer who can independently contribute in complex situations while supporting quality, engineering, and delivery goals. This role requires strong experience in agile work management, collaboration, integration testing, quality assurance, requirements management, SDLC practices, systems integration, troubleshooting, web services, and workflow management.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will plan, prioritize, and manage work using agile practices that enable iterative delivery, collaboration, adaptability, and continuous improvement. The role also involves partnering with engineering teams to evaluate source code, identify issues, improve quality, and promote maintainability and coding best practices.
   

  

 This position designs, executes, and maintains tests that validate interactions across integrated components, systems, services, data flows, interfaces, and dependencies. The candidate will help maintain QA processes and standards that prevent defects, optimize performance, enhance customer satisfaction, and support compliance.
   

  

 The role requires strong understanding of requirements management, SDLC practices, systems integration, web services, troubleshooting, and workflow management. The candidate should be a key contributor who can informally coach others and help teams deliver reliable, maintainable solutions.
   

  

 Role
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Lead QE activities across assigned projects, including test planning, strategy, validation, automation, and release readiness.
* Design and maintain integration tests for systems, services, APIs, data flows, interfaces, and dependencies.
* Apply agile work management practices to plan, prioritize, and manage work effectively in iterative delivery environments.
* Partner with product owners, developers, and delivery teams to clarify requirements, manage changes, identify risks, and ensure testability.
* Lead UI, API, backend, integration, and performance automation using tools such as Playwright, Cypress, Gatling, and BlazeMeter.
* Troubleshoot complex technical issues across systems, applications, services, integrations, environments, and networks.
* Analyze workflows, remove bottlenecks, streamline procedures, monitor progress, and adapt processes to improve delivery.
* Communicate status, risks, dependencies, and quality insights clearly to stakeholders and leadership while promoting continuous improvement.


**All About You / Experience**
 The ideal candidate for this position should have:
   

  

* Strong experience in quality engineering, test strategy, planning, automation, QA, and validation across complex technology programs.
* Hands\-on experience with UI, API, backend, and integration automation tools such as Playwright, Cypress, and API automation frameworks.
* Strong experience in API integration testing, backend validation, web services, and system interoperability.
* Experience with API performance testing and tools such as Gatling and BlazeMeter.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills across systems, applications, services, environments, and networks.
* Working knowledge of Git, Jira, XRay, Insomnia, and cloud platforms, preferably Azure.
* Ability to lead teams, support proof\-of\-concepts, mentor others, and influence scalable quality practices.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a proactive, adaptable, continuous\-improvement mindset.


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

description:

**Infrastructure Automation Engineer (DevSecOps) – Azure, Kubernetes \& Terraform**
**Experience:** 
 6–9 years
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We are seeking experienced and hands\-on Senior Infrastructure Automation Engineers (DevSecOps) with strong proficiency in Azure and Kubernetes to design, provision, automate, secure, and support scalable multicloud infrastructure for enterprise workloads.
   

  

 The role requires deep expertise in Infrastructure as Code with Terraform, container orchestration on Kubernetes, automated CI/CD pipeline engineering, Python\-based infrastructure automation, and embedding security controls across the build, deploy, and run lifecycle, with a strong focus on reliability, compliance, cost\-awareness, and delivery quality.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design, provision, and manage scalable multicloud infrastructure with Azure as the primary platform and AWS as the secondary platform.
* Architect and operate production\-grade Kubernetes clusters (AKS / EKS / self\-managed) covering deployments, scaling, networking, ingress, secrets, RBAC, upgrades, and operational troubleshooting.
* Implement and govern Infrastructure as Code using Terraform — module design, remote state, workspaces, policy\-as\-code, and reusable platform components for repeatable, secure, and auditable deployments.
* Build, maintain, and optimize end\-to\-end CI/CD pipelines for application and infrastructure delivery, including build, test, scan, approval, and progressive deployment workflows.
* Develop Python\-based automation, tooling, and operators to streamline provisioning, configuration, remediation, and day\-2 operations across cloud platforms.
* Embed DevSecOps practices across the SDLC — SAST, DAST, SCA, container image scanning, IaC scanning, secrets management, and policy\-as\-code (OPA / Sentinel / Kyverno).
* Integrate cloud infrastructure with enterprise networking, IAM, security, monitoring, logging, and DevOps toolchains in line with enterprise standards.
* Monitor platform health, lead incident response, perform root cause analysis, and drive continuous service and reliability improvements.
* Ensure infrastructure is resilient, secure, compliant, cost\-aware, and aligned with enterprise architecture, security baselines, and operational standards.
* Mentor junior engineers, lead technical reviews, and contribute to platform engineering standards, runbooks, and reference architectures.


**Required Skills And Experience**
* 6\+ years of overall experience in cloud infrastructure engineering, DevOps, DevSecOps, or platform engineering, with at least 3\+ years in a senior or lead capacity.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Azure services (AKS, VNet, Azure AD / Entra ID, Key Vault, Storage, Monitor, Policy, Azure DevOps); working knowledge of AWS services (EKS, EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, CloudWatch) as the secondary platform.
* Deep, production\-grade experience with Kubernetes and the broader container ecosystem (Docker, Helm, Istio / service mesh, ingress controllers, operators).
* Strong expertise in Terraform — module development, state management, multi\-environment patterns, and integration with policy\-as\-code frameworks.
* Proven experience designing and operating CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent, including pipeline security and supply\-chain controls.
* Strong proficiency in Python for infrastructure automation, tooling, and integration; working knowledge of Bash / Shell scripting.
* Solid grounding in cloud security — IAM, network segmentation, encryption, secrets management, vulnerability management, and DevSecOps tooling (e.g., Trivy, Checkov, tfsec, SonarQube, Snyk, Aqua / Prisma Cloud).
* Good understanding of cloud networking, hybrid connectivity, load balancing, observability, logging, and access controls.
* Demonstrated experience troubleshooting complex infrastructure issues, deployment failures, distributed systems, and performance bottlenecks.
* Strong awareness of cloud governance, compliance frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2, CIS Benchmarks), cost optimization, and operational best practices.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, documentation, collaboration, and stakeholder communication skills.


**Qualification and Certifications**
* B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* One or more relevant certifications strongly preferred — Microsoft Azure (AZ\-104 / AZ\-305 / AZ\-400\), CKA / CKAD / CKS, HashiCorp Terraform Associate, AWS Solutions Architect / DevOps Engineer, or recognized security certifications (CCSK, CompTIA Security\+).
* Strong commitment to continuous learning and staying current with cloud, DevSecOps, Kubernetes, and platform engineering practices.


**Good\-to\-Have Skills**
* Exposure to GCP and broader multi\-cloud operating models.
* Experience with policy\-as\-code and guardrails (OPA / Gatekeeper, Kyverno, Azure Policy, Sentinel).
* Experience with service mesh, GitOps tooling (ArgoCD, Flux), and progressive delivery patterns.
* Experience with monitoring and observability stacks such as Prometheus, Grafana, Azure Monitor, CloudWatch, ELK, Datadog, or Dynatrace.
* Experience with Azure Cost Management, AWS Cost Explorer, tagging strategies, and FinOps practices.
* Exposure to platform engineering, internal developer platforms (IDP), release management, and SRE practices.


**Working Expectations**
* Collaborate effectively with architecture, engineering, security, application, and operations teams across geographies.
* Maintain clear, version\-controlled documentation for infrastructure design, deployment steps, SOPs, runbooks, and automation scripts.
* Demonstrate strong ownership in resolving issues, improving reliability, hardening security posture, and enhancing automation across cloud platforms.
* Follow enterprise delivery standards, security controls, change and operational procedures, and quality expectations.
* Provide technical mentorship and act as an escalation point for complex infrastructure, automation, and security challenges.

title: Principal Software Engineer
description:

**Principal Software Engineer**

 Hybrid, Pune
   

  

**Position Summary**
 We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer to spearhead the architecture, evolution, and delivery of iModel Cloud Sync Services, enabling high\-volume data ingestion, transformation, and synchronization from heterogeneous engineering sources into the iTwin platform.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on technical leadership role requiring
 **deep expertise in cloud\-native architecture, distributed systems, orchestration frameworks, state\-machine\-driven workflows, and enterprise\-grade reliability.** 
 As a Principal, you will define architectural direction, mentor teams, and ensure that the platform is engineered for scale, resilience, and long\-term sustainability.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Architectural Leadership**
* Evolve end\-to\-end architecture for cloud\-based ETL workflows and engineering data synchronization.
* Architect event\-driven systems using microservices, container orchestration, and state\-machine\-driven execution.
* Lead design of multi\-tenant services optimized for global scale, performance, and cost\-efficiency.


**Cloud Platform \& Distributed Systems**
* Design cloud\-native pipelines using Kubernetes, focusing on zero\-downtime rollouts and secure configuration management.
* Implement distributed locking and conflict\-resolution mechanisms for high\-concurrency data sync.
* Ensure robust observability through distributed tracing, automated diagnostics, and structured logging.


**Data \& ETL Workflow Architecture**
* Drive ETL design for engineering data, focusing on schema management, versioning, and domain\-model mapping.

**Reliability, Resilience \& Operational Excellence**
